question: Across all T20 World Cup editions, which team has used the most bowlers in a single innings and did that strategy result in a win or loss?
gold_sql: SELECT d.bowling_team, COUNT(DISTINCT d.bowler_id) AS total_bowlers_used, CASE WHEN d.bowling_team = m.match_winner THEN 'Win' WHEN m.match_winner IS NULL AND m.result_type IN ('tie', 'no result') THEN 'Tie/No Result' ELSE 'Loss' END AS match_result FROM Deliveries d JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id GROUP BY d.match_id, d.inning, d.bowling_team, m.match_winner, m.result_type ORDER BY total_bowlers_used DESC LIMIT 1;
generated_sql:
WITH innings_bowlers AS (
  SELECT
    d.match_id,
    d.inning,
    d.bowling_team,
    COUNT(DISTINCT d.bowler_id) AS total_bowlers_used,
    m.match_winner
  FROM Deliveries d
  JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
  WHERE m.season LIKE '%T20 World Cup%'
    AND d.wides = 0
    AND d.noballs = 0
  GROUP BY d.match_id, d.inning, d.bowling_team
)
SELECT
  ib.bowling_team AS bowling_team,
  ib.total_bowlers_used AS total_bowlers_used,
  CASE WHEN ib.match_winner = ib.bowling_team THEN 'win' ELSE 'loss' END AS match_result
FROM innings_bowlers ib
WHERE ib.total_bowlers_used = (SELECT MAX(total_bowlers_used) FROM innings_bowlers);

question: T20 ఇతిహాసలో Australia కి వ్యతిరేకంగా ఏ బ్యాట్స్మ్యాన్ దగ్గర అన్నిటికన్నా పెద్ద బ్యాటింగ్ ఆవెరేజ్ ఉన్నది?
gold_sql: SELECT p.player_name, SUM(d.runs_scored) AS total_runs, SUM(CASE WHEN d.player_out_id = d.striker_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS times_dismissed, ROUND(CAST(SUM(d.runs_scored) AS FLOAT) / CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN d.player_out_id = d.striker_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE SUM(CASE WHEN d.player_out_id = d.striker_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) END, 2) AS batting_average FROM Deliveries d JOIN Players p ON d.striker_id = p.player_id WHERE d.bowling_team = 'Australia' GROUP BY d.striker_id, p.player_name HAVING SUM(d.runs_scored) > 50 ORDER BY batting_average DESC LIMIT 1;
generated_sql:
SELECT p.player_name AS player_name,
       agg.total_runs AS total_runs,
       agg.times_dismissed AS times_dismissed,
       CASE WHEN agg.times_dismissed = 0 THEN CAST(agg.total_runs AS REAL) ELSE CAST(agg.total_runs AS REAL) / agg.times_dismissed END AS batting_average
FROM (
  SELECT d.striker_id AS player_id,
         SUM(d.runs_scored) AS total_runs,
         SUM(CASE WHEN d.player_out_id = d.striker_id AND d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out','retired hurt','obstructing the field') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS times_dismissed
  FROM Deliveries d
  JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
  WHERE d.wides = 0
    AND d.noballs = 0
    AND d.bowling_team = 'Australia'
  GROUP BY d.striker_id
) AS agg
JOIN Players p ON p.player_id = agg.player_id
ORDER BY batting_average DESC, total_runs DESC
LIMIT 1;

question: Which Batsmen has the highest batting average against Australia in T20 history?
gold_sql: SELECT p.player_name, SUM(d.runs_scored) AS total_runs, SUM(CASE WHEN d.player_out_id = d.striker_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS times_dismissed, ROUND(CAST(SUM(d.runs_scored) AS FLOAT) / CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN d.player_out_id = d.striker_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE SUM(CASE WHEN d.player_out_id = d.striker_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) END, 2) AS batting_average FROM Deliveries d JOIN Players p ON d.striker_id = p.player_id WHERE d.bowling_team = 'Australia' GROUP BY d.striker_id, p.player_name HAVING SUM(d.runs_scored) > 50 ORDER BY batting_average DESC LIMIT 1;
generated_sql:
SELECT p.player_name AS player_name,
       COALESCE(r.total_runs, 0) AS total_runs,
       COALESCE(d.times_dismissed, 0) AS times_dismissed,
       CASE WHEN COALESCE(d.times_dismissed, 0) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE CAST(COALESCE(r.total_runs, 0) AS REAL) / d.times_dismissed END AS batting_average
FROM Players p
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT striker_id AS player_id, SUM(runs_scored) AS total_runs
    FROM Deliveries
    WHERE bowling_team = 'Australia' AND wides = 0 AND noballs = 0
    GROUP BY striker_id
) r ON p.player_id = r.player_id
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT player_out_id AS player_id, SUM(CASE WHEN wicket_type != 'retired hurt' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS times_dismissed
    FROM Deliveries
    WHERE bowling_team = 'Australia' AND wides = 0 AND noballs = 0 AND player_out_id IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY player_out_id
) d ON p.player_id = d.player_id
WHERE r.total_runs IS NOT NULL OR d.times_dismissed IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY batting_average DESC
LIMIT 1;

question: सभी टी20 विश्व कप संस्करणों में, एक पारी में सबसे ज़्यादा गेंदबाज़ों का उपयोग किस टीम ने किया और क्या उस रणनीति का परिणाम जीत रहा या हार?
gold_sql: SELECT d.bowling_team, COUNT(DISTINCT d.bowler_id) AS total_bowlers_used, CASE WHEN d.bowling_team = m.match_winner THEN 'Win' WHEN m.match_winner IS NULL AND m.result_type IN ('tie', 'no result') THEN 'Tie/No Result' ELSE 'Loss' END AS match_result FROM Deliveries d JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id GROUP BY d.match_id, d.inning, d.bowling_team, m.match_winner, m.result_type ORDER BY total_bowlers_used DESC LIMIT 1;
generated_sql:
WITH innings_bowlers AS (
  SELECT d.match_id,
         d.inning,
         d.bowling_team,
         COUNT(DISTINCT d.bowler_id) AS total_bowlers_used
  FROM Deliveries d
  JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
  WHERE d.wides = 0
    AND d.noballs = 0
    AND m.season LIKE '%T20 World Cup%'

question: T20 ਇਤਿਹਾਸ ਵਿੱਚ Australia ਦੇ ਖਿਲਾਫ਼ ਕਿਸ ਬੱਲੇਬਾਜ਼ ਦੀ ਬੱਲੇਬਾਜ਼ੀ ਔਸਤ ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਵੱਧ ਹੈ?
gold_sql: SELECT p.player_name, SUM(d.runs_scored) AS total_runs, SUM(CASE WHEN d.player_out_id = d.striker_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS times_dismissed, ROUND(CAST(SUM(d.runs_scored) AS FLOAT) / CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN d.player_out_id = d.striker_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE SUM(CASE WHEN d.player_out_id = d.striker_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) END, 2) AS batting_average FROM Deliveries d JOIN Players p ON d.striker_id = p.player_id WHERE d.bowling_team = 'Australia' GROUP BY d.striker_id, p.player_name HAVING SUM(d.runs_scored) > 50 ORDER BY batting_average DESC LIMIT 1;
generated_sql:
WITH T20Matches AS (
  SELECT m.match_id
  FROM Matches m
  JOIN Deliveries d ON m.match_id = d.match_id
  GROUP BY m.match_id
  HAVING MAX(d.over_number) <= 20
),
PlayerStats AS (
  SELECT
    p.player_name AS player_name,
    COALESCE(SUM(d.runs_scored), 0) AS total_runs,
    SUM(CASE WHEN d.player_out_id = d.striker_id AND d.wicket_type IS NOT NULL AND d.wicket_type != 'retired hurt' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS times_dismissed
  FROM Deliveries d
  JOIN Players p ON p.player_id = d.striker_id
  WHERE d.bowling_team = 'Australia'
    AND d.wides = 0
    AND d.noballs = 0
    AND d.match_id IN (SELECT match_id FROM T20Matches)
  GROUP BY p.player_id
)
SELECT
  player_name,
  total_runs,
  times_dismissed,
  CASE WHEN times_dismissed = 0 THEN total_runs ELSE ROUND(CAST(total_runs AS REAL) / times_dismissed, 2) END AS batting_average
FROM PlayerStats
WHERE (CASE WHEN times_dismissed = 0 THEN total_runs ELSE ROUND(CAST(total_runs AS REAL) / times_dismissed, 2) END) =
      (SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN times_dismissed = 0 THEN total_runs ELSE ROUND(CAST(total_runs AS REAL) / times_dismissed, 2) END) FROM PlayerStats);

question: टी20 इतिहास में ऑस्ट्रेलिया के खिलाफ सबसे अधिक बल्लेबाजी औसत किस बल्लेबाज़ का है?
gold_sql: SELECT p.player_name, SUM(d.runs_scored) AS total_runs, SUM(CASE WHEN d.player_out_id = d.striker_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS times_dismissed, ROUND(CAST(SUM(d.runs_scored) AS FLOAT) / CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN d.player_out_id = d.striker_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE SUM(CASE WHEN d.player_out_id = d.striker_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) END, 2) AS batting_average FROM Deliveries d JOIN Players p ON d.striker_id = p.player_id WHERE d.bowling_team = 'Australia' GROUP BY d.striker_id, p.player_name HAVING SUM(d.runs_scored) > 50 ORDER BY batting_average DESC LIMIT 1;
generated_sql:
SELECT
  p.player_name AS player_name,
  SUM(CASE WHEN d.striker_id = p.player_id THEN d.runs_scored ELSE 0 END) AS total_runs,
  SUM(CASE WHEN d.player_out_id = p.player_id AND d.wicket_type != 'retired hurt' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS times_dismissed,
  CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN d.striker_id = p.player_id THEN d.runs_scored ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN d.player_out_id = p.player_id AND d.wicket_type != 'retired hurt' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS batting_average
FROM Players p
JOIN Deliveries d ON (d.striker_id = p.player_id OR d.player_out_id = p.player_id)
JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
WHERE d.wides = 0
  AND d.noballs = 0
  AND d.bowling_team = 'Australia'
  AND (m.stage LIKE '%T20%' OR m.season LIKE '%T20%')
GROUP BY p.player_id
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN d.player_out_id = p.player_id AND d.wicket_type != 'retired hurt' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0
ORDER BY batting_average DESC
LIMIT 1;

question: ਸਾਰੇ T20 ਵਿਸ਼ਵ ਕੱਪ ਐਡੀਸ਼ਨਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ, ਕਿਸ ਟੀਮ ਨੇ ਇੱਕੋ ਪਾਰੀ ਵਿੱਚ ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਵੱਧ ਗੇਂਦਬਾਜ਼ਾਂ ਦੀ ਵਰਤੋਂ ਕੀਤੀ ਅਤੇ ਕੀ ਉਹ ਰਣਨੀਤੀ ਜਿੱਤ ਜਾਂ ਹਾਰ ਵਿੱਚ ਬਦਲੀ?
gold_sql: SELECT d.bowling_team, COUNT(DISTINCT d.bowler_id) AS total_bowlers_used, CASE WHEN d.bowling_team = m.match_winner THEN 'Win' WHEN m.match_winner IS NULL AND m.result_type IN ('tie', 'no result') THEN 'Tie/No Result' ELSE 'Loss' END AS match_result FROM Deliveries d JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id GROUP BY d.match_id, d.inning, d.bowling_team, m.match_winner, m.result_type ORDER BY total_bowlers_used DESC LIMIT 1;
generated_sql:
WITH innings_bowlers AS (
  SELECT d.match_id,
         d.inning,
         d.bowling_team,
         COUNT(DISTINCT d.bowler_id) AS total_bowlers_used
  FROM Deliveries d
  JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
  WHERE d.wides = 0
    AND d.noballs = 0
    AND (
      (m.season LIKE '%T20%' AND m.season LIKE '%World Cup%')
      OR (m.stage LIKE '%T20%' AND m.stage LIKE '%World Cup%')
      OR m.season LIKE '%T20 World Cup%'
      OR m.stage LIKE '%T20 World Cup%'
      OR m.season LIKE '%World Cup%'
    )
  GROUP BY d.match_id, d.inning, d.bowling_team
),
max_bowlers AS (
  SELECT MAX(total_bowlers_used) AS mx FROM innings_bowlers
)
SELECT ib.bowling_team AS bowling_team,
       ib.total_bowlers_used AS total_bowlers_used,
       CASE WHEN m.match_winner = ib.bowling_team THEN 'win' ELSE 'loss' END AS match_result
FROM innings_bowlers ib
JOIN max_bowlers mb ON ib.total_bowlers_used = mb.mx
JOIN Matches m ON ib.match_id = m.match_id;

question: सभी टी20 विश्व कपों में, 17-20 ओवरों में कम-से-कम 100 वैध गेंदें फेंकने वालों में सबसे बेहतरीन इकॉनमी रेट किस गेंदबाज़ का है?
gold_sql: SELECT p.player_name FROM Players p JOIN Deliveries d ON p.player_id = d.bowler_id WHERE d.over_number BETWEEN 17 AND 20 GROUP BY p.player_id, p.player_name HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 100 ORDER BY (SUM(d.runs_scored + d.wides + d.noballs) * 6.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) ASC LIMIT 1;
generated_sql:
WITH bowler_stats AS (
  SELECT
    bowler_id,
    SUM(runs_scored + wides + noballs) AS runs_conceded,
    COUNT(*) AS legal_balls
  FROM Deliveries
  WHERE over_number BETWEEN 17 AND 20
    AND wides = 0
    AND noballs = 0
  GROUP BY bowler_id
),
qualified AS (
  SELECT
    bowler_id,
    runs_conceded,
    legal_balls,
    (runs_conceded * 6.0) / legal_balls AS economy
  FROM bowler_stats
  WHERE legal_balls >= 100
)
SELECT p.player_name AS player_name
FROM qualified q
JOIN Players p ON p.player_id = q.bowler_id
WHERE q.economy = (SELECT MIN(economy) FROM qualified)
LIMIT 1;

question: Which bowler has the best economy rate in overs 17-20 across all T20 World Cups, with a minimum of 100 balls bowled in that phase?
gold_sql: SELECT p.player_name FROM Players p JOIN Deliveries d ON p.player_id = d.bowler_id WHERE d.over_number BETWEEN 17 AND 20 GROUP BY p.player_id, p.player_name HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 100 ORDER BY (SUM(d.runs_scored + d.wides + d.noballs) * 6.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) ASC LIMIT 1;
generated_sql:
SELECT p.player_name AS player_name
FROM Deliveries d
JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
JOIN Players p ON d.bowler_id = p.player_id
WHERE d.over_number BETWEEN 17 AND 20
  AND upper(m.season) LIKE '%T20 WORLD CUP%'
GROUP BY p.player_name
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 100
ORDER BY (SUM(d.runs_scored + d.wides + d.noballs) * 6.0) / SUM(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) ASC, p.player_name ASC
LIMIT 1;

question: T20 వరల్డ్ కప్పు ఎడిషన్లలో ఒక ఇన్నింగ్స్లో ఏ టీం అన్నిటికన్నా ఎక్కువ బౌలర్లని వాదింది? అప్పుడు వాళ్ళు ఒడిపోయారా లేదా గెలిచారా?
gold_sql: SELECT d.bowling_team, COUNT(DISTINCT d.bowler_id) AS total_bowlers_used, CASE WHEN d.bowling_team = m.match_winner THEN 'Win' WHEN m.match_winner IS NULL AND m.result_type IN ('tie', 'no result') THEN 'Tie/No Result' ELSE 'Loss' END AS match_result FROM Deliveries d JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id GROUP BY d.match_id, d.inning, d.bowling_team, m.match_winner, m.result_type ORDER BY total_bowlers_used DESC LIMIT 1;
generated_sql:
WITH legal AS (
  SELECT match_id, inning, bowling_team, bowler_id
  FROM Deliveries
  WHERE wides = 0 AND noballs = 0
),
bowlers_per_inning AS (
  SELECT match_id, inning, bowling_team, COUNT(DISTINCT bowler_id) AS total_bowlers_used
  FROM legal
  GROUP BY match_id, inning, bowling_team
),
filtered_matches AS (
  SELECT b.match_id, b.inning, b.bowling_team, b.total_bowlers_used, m.match_winner
  FROM bowlers_per_inning b
  JOIN Matches m ON b.match_id = m.match_id
  WHERE m.season LIKE '%T20 World Cup%'
)
SELECT
  bowling_team AS bowling_team,
  total_bowlers_used AS total_bowlers_used,
  CASE
    WHEN match_winner IS NULL THEN 'no result'
    WHEN match_winner = bowling_team THEN 'won'
    ELSE 'lost'
  END AS match_result
FROM filtered_matches
WHERE total_bowlers_used = (SELECT MAX(total_bowlers_used) FROM filtered_matches);

question: ਸਾਰੇ T20 ਵਿਸ਼ਵ ਕੱਪਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ 17-20 ਓਵਰਾਂ ਦੌਰਾਨ ਕਿਸ ਗੇਂਦਬਾਜ਼ ਦੀ ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਵਧੀਆ ਇਕਾਨਮੀ ਰੇਟ ਹੈ, ਜਿਸ ਨੇ ਉਸ ਪੜਾਅ ਵਿੱਚ ਘੱਟੋ-ਘੱਟ 100 ਗੇਂਦਾਂ ਸੁੱਟੀਆਂ ਹੋਣ?
gold_sql: SELECT p.player_name FROM Players p JOIN Deliveries d ON p.player_id = d.bowler_id WHERE d.over_number BETWEEN 17 AND 20 GROUP BY p.player_id, p.player_name HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 100 ORDER BY (SUM(d.runs_scored + d.wides + d.noballs) * 6.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) ASC LIMIT 1;
generated_sql:
SELECT p.player_name AS player_name
FROM Deliveries d
JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
JOIN Players p ON d.bowler_id = p.player_id
WHERE d.wides = 0
  AND d.noballs = 0
  AND d.over_number BETWEEN 17 AND 20
  AND (
       m.season LIKE '%T20 World Cup%' OR
       m.season LIKE '%World T20%' OR
       m.season LIKE '%T20%' OR
       m.stage LIKE '%T20%' OR
       m.stage LIKE '%World Cup%' OR
       m.venue LIKE '%T20%' OR
       m.venue LIKE '%World Cup%'
  )
GROUP BY d.bowler_id, p.player_name
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 100

question: అన్నీ T20 వరల్డ్ కప్పులలో ఏ బౌలర్ దగ్గర 17-20 ఓవర్లలో అన్నిటికన్నా మంచి ఎకానమీ రేట్ ఉన్నది? (కనీసం 100 బంతులు విసిరిన)
gold_sql: SELECT p.player_name FROM Players p JOIN Deliveries d ON p.player_id = d.bowler_id WHERE d.over_number BETWEEN 17 AND 20 GROUP BY p.player_id, p.player_name HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 100 ORDER BY (SUM(d.runs_scored + d.wides + d.noballs) * 6.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) ASC LIMIT 1;
generated_sql:
SELECT p.player_name AS player_name
FROM Players p
JOIN (
  SELECT d.bowler_id,
         SUM(d.runs_scored) AS runs_conceded,
         COUNT(*) AS legal_balls,
         (SUM(d.runs_scored) * 6.0) / COUNT(*) AS economy
  FROM Deliveries d
  JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
  WHERE d.wides = 0
    AND d.noballs = 0
    AND d.over_number BETWEEN 17 AND 20
    AND (m.stage LIKE '%World Cup%' OR m.season LIKE '%World Cup%')
  GROUP BY d.bowler_id
  HAVING COUNT(*) >= 100
) t ON p.player_id = t.bowler_id
ORDER BY t.economy ASC, p.player_name ASC
LIMIT 1;

question: T20I ਵਿੱਚ, 10 ਜਾਂ ਵੱਧ ਵਿਕਟਾਂ ਲੈਣ ਵਾਲੇ ਗੇਂਦਬਾਜ਼ਾਂ ਵਿੱਚੋਂ ਕਿਸਦੀ ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਵਧੀਆ ਔਸਤ ਹੈ, ਅਤੇ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਦੀ ਇਕਾਨਮੀ ਅਤੇ ਸਟ੍ਰਾਈਕ ਰੇਟ ਕੀ ਹੈ?
gold_sql: SELECT p.player_name, (SUM(d.runs_scored + d.wides + d.noballs) * 1.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN d.wicket_type IS NOT NULL AND d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'retired out', 'obstructing the field') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) AS bowling_average, (SUM(d.runs_scored + d.wides + d.noballs) * 6.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) AS economy_rate, (SUM(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN d.wicket_type IS NOT NULL AND d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'retired out', 'obstructing the field') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) AS strike_rate FROM Players p JOIN Deliveries d ON p.player_id = d.bowler_id GROUP BY p.player_id, p.player_name HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN d.wicket_type IS NOT NULL AND d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'retired out', 'obstructing the field') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 10 ORDER BY bowling_average ASC LIMIT 1;
generated_sql:
SELECT p.player_name AS player_name,
       CAST(stats.runs_conceded AS REAL)/stats.wickets AS bowling_average,
       (CAST(stats.runs_conceded AS REAL)*6)/stats.balls AS economy_rate,
       CAST(stats.balls AS REAL)/stats.wickets AS strike_rate
FROM (
  SELECT d.bowler_id AS bowler_id,
         SUM(d.runs_scored - d.extra_runs) AS runs_conceded,
         COUNT(*) AS balls,
         SUM(CASE WHEN d.wicket_type IS NOT NULL AND d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out','retired hurt','obstructing the field') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wickets
  FROM Deliveries d
  JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
  WHERE m.stage = 'T20I'
    AND d.wides = 0
    AND d.noballs = 0
  GROUP BY d.bowler_id
  HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN d.wicket_type IS NOT NULL AND d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out','retired hurt','obstructing the field') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 10
) AS stats
JOIN Players p ON p.player_id = stats.bowler_id
ORDER BY bowling_average ASC, economy_rate ASC, strike_rate ASC
LIMIT 1;

question: Which fielder has the most dismissals in knockout stage matches, and give dismissals per innings as well?
gold_sql: SELECT p.player_name, COUNT(fd.fielder_dismissal_id) AS total_dismissals, (COUNT(fd.fielder_dismissal_id) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT pim.match_id) FROM PlayerInMatch pim JOIN Matches m2 ON pim.match_id = m2.match_id WHERE pim.player_id = p.player_id AND m2.stage <> 'Group')) AS dismissals_per_innings FROM Players p JOIN FielderDismissals fd ON p.player_id = fd.fielder_id JOIN Deliveries d ON fd.delivery_id = d.delivery_id JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id WHERE m.stage <> 'Group' GROUP BY p.player_id, p.player_name ORDER BY total_dismissals DESC LIMIT 1;
generated_sql:
WITH per_inning AS (
  SELECT fd.fielder_id AS fielder_id,
         d.inning AS inning,
         COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM FielderDismissals fd
  JOIN Deliveries d ON fd.delivery_id = d.delivery_id
  JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
  WHERE lower(m.stage) = 'knockout'
    AND d.wides = 0
    AND d.noballs = 0
  GROUP BY fd.fielder_id, d.inning
),
agg AS (
  SELECT p.fielder_id AS fielder_id,
         SUM(p.cnt) AS total,
         GROUP_CONCAT(p.inning || ':' || p.cnt, ',') AS dismissals_per_innings
  FROM per_inning p
  GROUP BY p.fielder_id
)
SELECT pl.player_name AS player_name,
       a.total AS total_dismissals,
       a.dismissals_per_innings AS dismissals_per_innings
FROM agg a
JOIN Players pl ON pl.player_id = a.fielder_id
ORDER BY a.total DESC
LIMIT 1;

question: Who has the best average among bowlers with 10+ wickets, and what is their economy and strike rate?
gold_sql: SELECT p.player_name, (SUM(d.runs_scored + d.wides + d.noballs) * 1.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN d.wicket_type IS NOT NULL AND d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'retired out', 'obstructing the field') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) AS bowling_average, (SUM(d.runs_scored + d.wides + d.noballs) * 6.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) AS economy_rate, (SUM(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN d.wicket_type IS NOT NULL AND d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'retired out', 'obstructing the field') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) AS strike_rate FROM Players p JOIN Deliveries d ON p.player_id = d.bowler_id GROUP BY p.player_id, p.player_name HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN d.wicket_type IS NOT NULL AND d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'retired out', 'obstructing the field') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 10 ORDER BY bowling_average ASC LIMIT 1;
generated_sql:
SELECT p.player_name AS player_name,
       CAST(b.sum_runs AS REAL) / b.wickets AS bowling_average,
       CAST(b.sum_runs * 6.0 AS REAL) / b.legal_deliveries AS economy_rate,
       CAST(b.legal_deliveries AS REAL) / b.wickets AS strike_rate
FROM (
    SELECT bowler_id,
           SUM(CASE WHEN wides = 0 AND noballs = 0 THEN runs_scored ELSE 0 END) AS sum_runs,
           SUM(CASE WHEN wides = 0 AND noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS legal_deliveries,
           SUM(CASE WHEN wides = 0 AND noballs = 0 AND player_out_id IS NOT NULL AND LOWER(wicket_type) NOT IN ('run out','retired hurt','obstructing the field') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wickets
    FROM Deliveries
    GROUP BY bowler_id
    HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN wides = 0 AND noballs = 0 AND player_out_id IS NOT NULL AND LOWER(wicket_type) NOT IN ('run out','retired hurt','obstructing the field') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 10
) AS b
JOIN Players p ON p.player_id = b.bowler_id
ORDER BY bowling_average ASC
LIMIT 1;

question: 10 या उससे अधिक विकेट लेने वाले गेंदबाज़ों में सबसे बेहतरीन औसत किसका है, और उनकी इकॉनमी तथा स्ट्राइक रेट क्या है?
gold_sql: SELECT p.player_name, (SUM(d.runs_scored + d.wides + d.noballs) * 1.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN d.wicket_type IS NOT NULL AND d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'retired out', 'obstructing the field') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) AS bowling_average, (SUM(d.runs_scored + d.wides + d.noballs) * 6.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) AS economy_rate, (SUM(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN d.wicket_type IS NOT NULL AND d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'retired out', 'obstructing the field') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) AS strike_rate FROM Players p JOIN Deliveries d ON p.player_id = d.bowler_id GROUP BY p.player_id, p.player_name HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN d.wicket_type IS NOT NULL AND d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'retired out', 'obstructing the field') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 10 ORDER BY bowling_average ASC LIMIT 1;
generated_sql:
WITH bowler_stats AS (
  SELECT
    p.player_name AS player_name,
    CAST(SUM(d.runs_scored + d.wides + d.noballs) AS REAL)
      / SUM(CASE WHEN d.player_out_id IS NOT NULL AND d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out','retired hurt','obstructing the field') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS bowling_average,
    (CAST(SUM(d.runs_scored + d.wides + d.noballs) AS REAL) * 6) / COUNT(*) AS economy_rate,
    CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) / SUM(CASE WHEN d.player_out_id IS NOT NULL AND d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out','retired hurt','obstructing the field') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS strike_rate
  FROM Deliveries d
  JOIN Players p ON p.player_id = d.bowler_id
  WHERE d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0
  GROUP BY d.bowler_id
  HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN d.player_out_id IS NOT NULL AND d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out','retired hurt','obstructing the field') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 10
)
SELECT
  player_name AS player_name,
  bowling_average AS bowling_average,
  economy_rate AS economy_rate,
  strike_rate AS strike_rate
FROM bowler_stats
WHERE bowling_average = (SELECT MIN(bowling_average) FROM bowler_stats);

question: 10+ వికెట్లు సంపాదించిన బౌలర్లలో ఎవరి దగ్గర అన్నిటికన్నా మంచి ఆవెరేజ్ ఉన్నది? వాళ్ళ ఎకానమీ మరియు స్ట్రైక్ రేట్ ఏమిటి?
gold_sql: SELECT p.player_name, (SUM(d.runs_scored + d.wides + d.noballs) * 1.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN d.wicket_type IS NOT NULL AND d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'retired out', 'obstructing the field') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) AS bowling_average, (SUM(d.runs_scored + d.wides + d.noballs) * 6.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) AS economy_rate, (SUM(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN d.wicket_type IS NOT NULL AND d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'retired out', 'obstructing the field') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) AS strike_rate FROM Players p JOIN Deliveries d ON p.player_id = d.bowler_id GROUP BY p.player_id, p.player_name HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN d.wicket_type IS NOT NULL AND d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'retired out', 'obstructing the field') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 10 ORDER BY bowling_average ASC LIMIT 1;
generated_sql:
SELECT
  p.player_name AS player_name,
  (b.total_conceded * 1.0) / NULLIF(b.wickets, 0) AS bowling_average,
  (b.total_conceded * 6.0) / NULLIF(b.legal_balls, 0) AS economy_rate,
  (b.legal_balls * 1.0) / NULLIF(b.wickets, 0) AS strike_rate
FROM (
  SELECT
    bowler_id,
    SUM(runs_scored + extra_runs - byes - legbyes) AS total_conceded,
    SUM(CASE WHEN wides = 0 AND noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS legal_balls,
    SUM(CASE WHEN player_out_id IS NOT NULL AND (wicket_type NOT IN ('run out','retired hurt','obstructing the field')) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wickets
  FROM Deliveries
  GROUP BY bowler_id
) AS b
JOIN Players p ON p.player_id = b.bowler_id
WHERE b.wickets > 10
ORDER BY bowling_average ASC
LIMIT 1;

question: नॉकआउट चरण के मैचों में सबसे अधिक डिसमिसल किस फील्डर ने किए हैं, और प्रति पारी डिसमिसल भी बताइए?
gold_sql: SELECT p.player_name, COUNT(fd.fielder_dismissal_id) AS total_dismissals, (COUNT(fd.fielder_dismissal_id) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT pim.match_id) FROM PlayerInMatch pim JOIN Matches m2 ON pim.match_id = m2.match_id WHERE pim.player_id = p.player_id AND m2.stage <> 'Group')) AS dismissals_per_innings FROM Players p JOIN FielderDismissals fd ON p.player_id = fd.fielder_id JOIN Deliveries d ON fd.delivery_id = d.delivery_id JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id WHERE m.stage <> 'Group' GROUP BY p.player_id, p.player_name ORDER BY total_dismissals DESC LIMIT 1;

question: In T20 history list the top two teams in terms of percentage of matches won ,also give the percentages .
gold_sql: WITH TeamMatches AS (SELECT team1 AS team, match_id, match_winner FROM Matches UNION ALL SELECT team2 AS team, match_id, match_winner FROM Matches) SELECT team, (SUM(CASE WHEN match_winner = team THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(match_id)) AS win_percentage FROM TeamMatches GROUP BY team ORDER BY win_percentage DESC LIMIT 2;
generated_sql:
SELECT team, win_percentage
FROM (
  SELECT t.team,
         CASE WHEN COALESCE(mp.matches_played,0)=0 THEN 0
              ELSE 100.0 * COALESCE(w.wins,0) / mp.matches_played
         END AS win_percentage
  FROM (
    SELECT team1 AS team FROM Matches
    UNION
    SELECT team2 AS team FROM Matches
  ) t
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT match_winner AS team, COUNT(*) AS wins
    FROM Matches
    WHERE match_winner IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY match_winner
  ) w ON t.team = w.team
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT team, COUNT(*) AS matches_played FROM (
      SELECT match_id, team1 AS team FROM Matches WHERE match_winner IS NOT NULL
      UNION ALL
      SELECT match_id, team2 AS team FROM Matches WHERE match_winner IS NOT NULL
    ) gp
    GROUP BY team
  ) mp ON t.team = mp.team
)
ORDER BY win_percentage DESC
LIMIT 2;

question: टी20 इतिहास में जीते गए मैचों के प्रतिशत के आधार पर शीर्ष दो टीमों की सूची दीजिए, साथ ही उनके प्रतिशत भी बताइए।
gold_sql: WITH TeamMatches AS (SELECT team1 AS team, match_id, match_winner FROM Matches UNION ALL SELECT team2 AS team, match_id, match_winner FROM Matches) SELECT team, (SUM(CASE WHEN match_winner = team THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(match_id)) AS win_percentage FROM TeamMatches GROUP BY team ORDER BY win_percentage DESC LIMIT 2;

  t.team AS team,
  ROUND(
    (SUM(CASE WHEN m.match_winner = t.team THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0) /
    NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN m.match_winner IS NOT NULL AND (m.team1 = t.team OR m.team2 = t.team) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0)

gold_sql: SELECT p.player_name, COUNT(fd.fielder_dismissal_id) AS total_dismissals, (COUNT(fd.fielder_dismissal_id) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT pim.match_id) FROM PlayerInMatch pim JOIN Matches m2 ON pim.match_id = m2.match_id WHERE pim.player_id = p.player_id AND m2.stage <> 'Group')) AS dismissals_per_innings FROM Players p JOIN FielderDismissals fd ON p.player_id = fd.fielder_id JOIN Deliveries d ON fd.delivery_id = d.delivery_id JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id WHERE m.stage <> 'Group' GROUP BY p.player_id, p.player_name ORDER BY total_dismissals DESC LIMIT 1;

question: T20 ਇਤਿਹਾਸ ਵਿੱਚ ਮੈਚ ਜਿੱਤਣ ਦੀ ਪ੍ਰਤੀਸ਼ਤ ਦੇ ਹਿਸਾਬ ਨਾਲ ਚੋਟੀ ਦੀਆਂ ਦੋ ਟੀਮਾਂ ਕਿਹੜੀਆਂ ਹਨ, ਅਤੇ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਦੀਆਂ ਪ੍ਰਤੀਸ਼ਤਾ ਵੀ ਦੱਸੋ?
gold_sql: WITH TeamMatches AS (SELECT team1 AS team, match_id, match_winner FROM Matches UNION ALL SELECT team2 AS team, match_id, match_winner FROM Matches) SELECT team, (SUM(CASE WHEN match_winner = team THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(match_id)) AS win_percentage FROM TeamMatches GROUP BY team ORDER BY win_percentage DESC LIMIT 2;

SELECT team,
       (wins * 100.0) / matches_played AS win_percentage
FROM (
  SELECT t.team,
         SUM(CASE WHEN m.match_winner = t.team THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wins,
         SUM(CASE WHEN m.match_winner IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS matches_played

  ) t

question: T20 ఇతిహాసలో గెలిచిన మ్యాచుల శాతం ఆధారంగా టాప్ 2 టీములు ఏమిటి? వాళ్ళ శాతాలు కూడా రాయండి.
gold_sql: WITH TeamMatches AS (SELECT team1 AS team, match_id, match_winner FROM Matches UNION ALL SELECT team2 AS team, match_id, match_winner FROM Matches) SELECT team, (SUM(CASE WHEN match_winner = team THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(match_id)) AS win_percentage FROM TeamMatches GROUP BY team ORDER BY win_percentage DESC LIMIT 2;
generated_sql:
WITH teams AS (
  SELECT team1 AS team FROM Matches
  UNION
  SELECT team2 AS team FROM Matches
),
stats AS (
  SELECT
    t.team,
    SUM(CASE WHEN m.match_winner = t.team THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wins,
    SUM(CASE WHEN (m.team1 = t.team OR m.team2 = t.team) AND m.match_winner IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS matches_played

question: For Hetmyer, Farhan, and Kishan — what percentage of their total runs came from boundaries in T-20 season 2026?
gold_sql: SELECT p.player_name, (SUM(CASE WHEN d.runs_scored IN (4, 6) THEN d.runs_scored ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(d.runs_scored), 0)) AS boundary_percentage FROM Players p JOIN Deliveries d ON p.player_id = d.striker_id WHERE p.player_name LIKE '%Hetmyer%' OR p.player_name LIKE '%Farhan%' OR p.player_name LIKE '%Kishan%' GROUP BY p.player_id, p.player_name;
generated_sql:
SELECT
  p.player_name AS player_name,
  CASE
    WHEN agg.total_runs IS NULL OR agg.total_runs = 0 THEN 0.0
    ELSE (agg.boundary_runs * 100.0) / agg.total_runs
  END AS boundary_percentage
FROM Players p
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT
    d.striker_id AS striker_id,
    SUM(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 AND (d.runs_scored - d.byes - d.legbyes) IN (4,6) THEN (d.runs_scored - d.byes - d.legbyes) ELSE 0 END) AS boundary_runs,
    SUM(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN (d.runs_scored - d.byes - d.legbyes) ELSE 0 END) AS total_runs
  FROM Deliveries d
  JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
  WHERE m.season = '2026'
  GROUP BY d.striker_id
) agg ON agg.striker_id = p.player_id
WHERE p.player_name IN ('Hetmyer', 'Farhan', 'Kishan');

question: నాకౌట్ మ్యాచులలో ఏ ఫీల్డర్ దగ్గర అన్నిటికన్నా ఎక్కువ వికెట్లు ఉన్నాయి? ఇన్నింగ్స్‌కు సగటు డిస్మిసల్స్ కూడా రాయండి.

question: उन दो खिलाड़ियों के नाम बताइए जिनके ठीक 4 डक (0) हैं और जो एक ही देश के लिए खेले।
gold_sql: WITH PlayerScores AS (SELECT d.match_id, d.striker_id, d.batting_team, SUM(d.runs_scored) AS runs, MAX(CASE WHEN d.player_out_id = d.striker_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS is_out FROM Deliveries d GROUP BY d.match_id, d.striker_id, d.batting_team), DuckCounts AS (SELECT striker_id, batting_team, COUNT(match_id) AS ducks FROM PlayerScores WHERE runs = 0 AND is_out = 1 GROUP BY striker_id, batting_team HAVING ducks = 4) SELECT p1.player_name, p2.player_name FROM DuckCounts d1 JOIN DuckCounts d2 ON d1.batting_team = d2.batting_team AND d1.striker_id < d2.striker_id JOIN Players p1 ON d1.striker_id = p1.player_id JOIN Players p2 ON d2.striker_id = p2.player_id LIMIT 1;
generated_sql:
WITH legal AS (
  SELECT match_id, inning, striker_id, runs_scored, extra_runs, player_out_id, wicket_type
  FROM Deliveries
  WHERE wides = 0 AND noballs = 0
),
per_inning AS (
  SELECT
    match_id,
    inning,
    striker_id AS player_id,
    SUM(runs_scored - extra_runs) AS batsman_runs,
    MAX(CASE WHEN player_out_id = striker_id AND (wicket_type NOT IN ('run out','retired hurt','obstructing the field')) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dismissed
  FROM legal
  GROUP BY match_id, inning, striker_id
),
ducks AS (
  SELECT player_id
  FROM per_inning
  WHERE batsman_runs = 0 AND dismissed = 1
),
duck_counts AS (
  SELECT player_id, COUNT(*) AS duck_count
  FROM ducks
  GROUP BY player_id
  HAVING COUNT(*) = 4
),
pairs_same_team AS (
  SELECT d1.player_id AS p1, d2.player_id AS p2, pim1.team_name
  FROM duck_counts d1
  JOIN duck_counts d2 ON d1.player_id < d2.player_id
  JOIN PlayerInMatch pim1 ON pim1.player_id = d1.player_id
  JOIN PlayerInMatch pim2 ON pim2.player_id = d2.player_id AND pim2.team_name = pim1.team_name
  GROUP BY d1.player_id, d2.player_id, pim1.team_name
)
SELECT pA.player_name AS player_name, pB.player_name AS player_name
FROM pairs_same_team pts
JOIN Players pA ON pA.player_id = pts.p1
JOIN Players pB ON pB.player_id = pts.p2
LIMIT 1;

ducks AS (

question: ठीक 3 डक वाले सभी खिलाड़ियों में सबसे अधिक स्ट्राइक रेट (SR) किस खिलाड़ी का है, और वह SR क्या है?

gold_sql: WITH InningsStats AS (SELECT striker_id, match_id, SUM(runs_scored) AS runs_in_innings, SUM(CASE WHEN wides = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS balls_in_innings, MAX(CASE WHEN player_out_id = striker_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS is_out FROM Deliveries GROUP BY striker_id, match_id), PlayerStats AS (SELECT striker_id, SUM(runs_in_innings) AS total_runs, SUM(balls_in_innings) AS total_balls, SUM(CASE WHEN runs_in_innings = 0 AND is_out = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ducks FROM InningsStats GROUP BY striker_id) SELECT p.player_name, (ps.total_runs * 100.0 / ps.total_balls) AS lowest_strike_rate FROM PlayerStats ps JOIN Players p ON ps.striker_id = p.player_id WHERE ps.total_runs > 800 AND ps.ducks = 3 ORDER BY lowest_strike_rate ASC LIMIT 2;

question: In T20 season 2026, which bowler claimed a four-wicket haul in only 3.2 overs, name his country, opposition, and his Economy
gold_sql: SELECT p.player_name, d.bowling_team AS country, d.batting_team AS opposition, (SUM(d.runs_scored + d.wides + d.noballs) * 6.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) AS economy_rate FROM Players p JOIN Deliveries d ON p.player_id = d.bowler_id JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id WHERE m.season = '2026' GROUP BY p.player_id, p.player_name, d.match_id, d.bowling_team, d.batting_team HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN d.player_out_id IS NOT NULL AND d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'retired out', 'obstructing the field') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 4 AND SUM(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 20;
generated_sql:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT m.match_id,
         del.inning,
         del.over_number,
         del.ball_number,
         del.bowler_id,
         del.batting_team,
         CASE WHEN del.wides = 0 AND del.noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_legal,
         CASE WHEN del.wides = 0 AND del.noballs = 0 AND del.player_out_id IS NOT NULL AND del.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out','retired hurt','obstructing the field') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_bowler_wicket,
         (del.runs_scored + del.wides + del.noballs) AS runs_conceded
  FROM Deliveries del
  JOIN Matches m ON del.match_id = m.match_id
  WHERE m.season = '2026'
),
cum AS (
  SELECT match_id,
         inning,
         bowler_id,
         batting_team,
         over_number,
         ball_number,
         SUM(is_legal) OVER (PARTITION BY match_id, inning, bowler_id ORDER BY over_number, ball_number ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cum_legal_balls,
         SUM(is_bowler_wicket) OVER (PARTITION BY match_id, inning, bowler_id ORDER BY over_number, ball_number ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cum_wickets,
         SUM(runs_conceded) OVER (PARTITION BY match_id, inning, bowler_id ORDER BY over_number, ball_number ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cum_runs
  FROM d
)
SELECT p.player_name AS player_name,
       pim.team_name AS country,
       c.batting_team AS opposition,
       ROUND((c.cum_runs * 6.0) / c.cum_legal_balls, 2) AS economy_rate
FROM cum c
JOIN Players p ON p.player_id = c.bowler_id
JOIN PlayerInMatch pim ON pim.match_id = c.match_id AND pim.player_id = c.bowler_id
WHERE c.cum_wickets = 4
  AND c.cum_legal_balls = 20;

gold_sql: WITH BowlerStats AS (SELECT p.player_name, d.bowling_team AS country, (SUM(d.runs_scored + d.wides + d.noballs) * 6.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) AS economy_rate FROM Players p JOIN Deliveries d ON p.player_id = d.bowler_id JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id WHERE m.season = '2026' AND d.batting_team = 'West Indies' GROUP BY p.player_id, p.player_name, d.match_id, d.bowling_team HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN d.player_out_id IS NOT NULL AND d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'retired out', 'obstructing the field') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 4) SELECT b1.player_name AS bowler1, b1.country AS country1, b2.player_name AS bowler2, b2.country AS country2, CASE WHEN b1.economy_rate < b2.economy_rate THEN b1.player_name ELSE b2.player_name END AS more_economical, ABS(b1.economy_rate - b2.economy_rate) AS economy_diff FROM BowlerStats b1 JOIN BowlerStats b2 ON b1.player_name < b2.player_name LIMIT 1;

    SUM(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS legal_balls

    bowler_name,
    country,
    match_id,
    wickets,
    runs_conceded,
    legal_balls,
    CASE WHEN legal_balls > 0 THEN (runs_conceded * 6.0) / legal_balls ELSE NULL END AS economy

    SUM(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 AND d.wicket_type IS NOT NULL AND d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out','retired hurt','obstructing the field') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wickets
  FROM Deliveries d
  JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
  WHERE m.season = '2026'
    AND d.batting_team = 'West Indies'
  GROUP BY d.match_id, d.bowler_id
),
qual AS (
  SELECT
    p.match_id,
    p.bowler_id,
    pl.player_name AS bowler_name,
    pim.team_name AS country,
    p.wickets,
    p.runs,
    p.balls,
    (CASE WHEN p.balls > 0 THEN (CAST(p.runs AS REAL) * 6.0) / p.balls ELSE NULL END) AS economy
  FROM per_match p
  JOIN PlayerInMatch pim ON p.match_id = pim.match_id AND p.bowler_id = pim.player_id
  JOIN Players pl ON p.bowler_id = pl.player_id
  WHERE p.wickets = 4
)
SELECT
  q1.bowler_name AS bowler1,
  q1.country AS country1,
  q2.bowler_name AS bowler2,
  q2.country AS country2,
  CASE
    WHEN q1.economy < q2.economy THEN q1.bowler_name
    WHEN q2.economy < q1.economy THEN q2.bowler_name
    ELSE q1.bowler_name
  END AS more_economical,
  ABS(q1.economy - q2.economy) AS economy_diff
FROM qual q1
JOIN qual q2 ON q1.bowler_name < q2.bowler_name
LIMIT 1;

question: T20 ਸੀਜ਼ਨ 2026 ਵਿੱਚ West Indies ਦੇ ਖ��ਲਾਫ਼ ਕਿਹੜੇ ਦੋ ਗੇਂਦਬਾਜ਼ਾਂ ਨੇ 4-4 ਵਿਕਟਾਂ ਲਈਆਂ — ਦੋਵਾਂ ਦੇ ਨਾਮ, ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਦੇ ਦੇਸ਼, ਅਤੇ ਕਿਹੜਾ ਵੱਧ ਕਿਫ਼ਾਇਤੀ ਸੀ ਅਤੇ ਕਿੰਨਾ?

question: T20 సీజన్ 2026 లో ఏ 2 బౌలర్లు వెస్ట్ ఇండీస్ కి వ్యతిరేకంగా ప్రతి ఒక్కరూ 4 వికెట్లు తీసుకున్నారు? వాళ్ళ పేరులు మరియు దేశాలు రాయండి. ఎవరి ఎకానమీ ఎక్కువ మంచిది? ఎంత తేడాతో?
gold_sql: WITH BowlerStats AS (SELECT p.player_name, d.bowling_team AS country, (SUM(d.runs_scored + d.wides + d.noballs) * 6.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) AS economy_rate FROM Players p JOIN Deliveries d ON p.player_id = d.bowler_id JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id WHERE m.season = '2026' AND d.batting_team = 'West Indies' GROUP BY p.player_id, p.player_name, d.match_id, d.bowling_team HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN d.player_out_id IS NOT NULL AND d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'retired out', 'obstructing the field') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 4) SELECT b1.player_name AS bowler1, b1.country AS country1, b2.player_name AS bowler2, b2.country AS country2, CASE WHEN b1.economy_rate < b2.economy_rate THEN b1.player_name ELSE b2.player_name END AS more_economical, ABS(b1.economy_rate - b2.economy_rate) AS economy_diff FROM BowlerStats b1 JOIN BowlerStats b2 ON b1.player_name < b2.player_name LIMIT 1;
generated_sql:
WITH bowler_stats AS (
  SELECT
    d.match_id,
    d.bowler_id,
    SUM(CASE WHEN d.wicket_type IS NOT NULL AND d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out','retired hurt','obstructing the field') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wickets,
    SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) AS runs_conceded,
    SUM(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS legal_deliveries
  FROM Deliveries d
  JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
  WHERE m.season = '2026' AND d.batting_team = 'West Indies'
  GROUP BY d.match_id, d.bowler_id
),
four_wk AS (
  SELECT match_id, bowler_id, wickets, runs_conceded, legal_deliveries
  FROM bowler_stats
  WHERE wickets = 4
),
target_matches AS (
  SELECT match_id
  FROM four_wk
  GROUP BY match_id
  HAVING COUNT(*) = 2
)
SELECT
  (SELECT pl.player_name
   FROM four_wk fw
   JOIN Players pl ON fw.bowler_id = pl.player_id
   WHERE fw.match_id = tm.match_id
   ORDER BY pl.player_name
   LIMIT 1) AS bowler1,
  (SELECT pim.team_name
   FROM four_wk fw
   JOIN Players pl ON fw.bowler_id = pl.player_id
   JOIN PlayerInMatch pim ON fw.match_id = pim.match_id AND fw.bowler_id = pim.player_id
   WHERE fw.match_id = tm.match_id
   ORDER BY pl.player_name
   LIMIT 1) AS country1,
  (SELECT pl.player_name
   FROM four_wk fw
   JOIN Players pl ON fw.bowler_id = pl.player_id
   WHERE fw.match_id = tm.match_id
   ORDER BY pl.player_name DESC
   LIMIT 1) AS bowler2,
  (SELECT pim.team_name
   FROM four_wk fw
   JOIN Players pl ON fw.bowler_id = pl.player_id
   JOIN PlayerInMatch pim ON fw.match_id = pim.match_id AND fw.bowler_id = pim.player_id
   WHERE fw.match_id = tm.match_id
   ORDER BY pl.player_name DESC
   LIMIT 1) AS country2,
  CASE
    WHEN (SELECT (fw.runs_conceded * 6.0 / NULLIF(fw.legal_deliveries,0))
          FROM four_wk fw
          JOIN Players pl ON fw.bowler_id = pl.player_id
          WHERE fw.match_id = tm.match_id
          ORDER BY pl.player_name
          LIMIT 1)
         < (SELECT (fw.runs_conceded * 6.0 / NULLIF(fw.legal_deliveries,0))
            FROM four_wk fw
            JOIN Players pl ON fw.bowler_id = pl.player_id
            WHERE fw.match_id = tm.match_id
            ORDER BY pl.player_name DESC
            LIMIT 1)
    THEN (SELECT pl.player_name
          FROM four_wk fw
          JOIN Players pl ON fw.bowler_id = pl.player_id
          WHERE fw.match_id = tm.match_id
          ORDER BY pl.player_name
          LIMIT 1)
    ELSE (SELECT pl.player_name
          FROM four_wk fw
          JOIN Players pl ON fw.bowler_id = pl.player_id
          WHERE fw.match_id = tm.match_id
          ORDER BY pl.player_name DESC
          LIMIT 1)
  END AS more_economical,
  ROUND(ABS(
    (SELECT (fw.runs_conceded * 6.0 / NULLIF(fw.legal_deliveries,0))
     FROM four_wk fw
     JOIN Players pl ON fw.bowler_id = pl.player_id
     WHERE fw.match_id = tm.match_id
     ORDER BY pl.player_name
     LIMIT 1)
    -
    (SELECT (fw.runs_conceded * 6.0 / NULLIF(fw.legal_deliveries,0))
     FROM four_wk fw
     JOIN Players pl ON fw.bowler_id = pl.player_id
     WHERE fw.match_id = tm.match_id
     ORDER BY pl.player_name DESC
     LIMIT 1)
  ), 2) AS economy_diff
FROM target_matches tm
LIMIT 1;

question: In T20 World Cup history, which South African fielder has the highest Ct/Inn ratio among all players with 16+ catches,  total catches, and Maximum catches in a single innings?
gold_sql: WITH FieldingInnings AS (SELECT pim.player_id, d.match_id, d.inning, COUNT(fd.fielder_dismissal_id) AS catches_in_innings FROM PlayerInMatch pim JOIN Deliveries d ON pim.match_id = d.match_id AND pim.team_name = d.bowling_team LEFT JOIN FielderDismissals fd ON d.delivery_id = fd.delivery_id AND fd.fielder_id = pim.player_id WHERE pim.team_name = 'South Africa' GROUP BY pim.player_id, d.match_id, d.inning), FielderStats AS (SELECT player_id, SUM(catches_in_innings) AS total_catches, COUNT(match_id) AS innings_fielded, MAX(catches_in_innings) AS max_catches_in_inning FROM FieldingInnings GROUP BY player_id) SELECT p.player_name AS fielder, fs.total_catches, fs.innings_fielded, ROUND(CAST(fs.total_catches AS FLOAT) / fs.innings_fielded, 3) AS ct_inn_ratio, fs.max_catches_in_inning FROM FielderStats fs JOIN Players p ON fs.player_id = p.player_id WHERE fs.total_catches >= 16 ORDER BY ct_inn_ratio DESC LIMIT 1;
generated_sql:
WITH t20_matches AS (
  SELECT match_id
  FROM Matches
  WHERE season LIKE '%T20 World Cup%'
),
catches AS (
  SELECT fd.fielder_id AS player_id, d.match_id, d.inning
  FROM FielderDismissals fd
  JOIN Deliveries d ON fd.delivery_id = d.delivery_id
  JOIN t20_matches tm ON d.match_id = tm.match_id
  JOIN PlayerInMatch pim ON pim.match_id = d.match_id AND pim.player_id = fd.fielder_id AND pim.team_name = 'South Africa'
  WHERE d.wicket_type IN ('caught','caught and bowled')
),
per_player_total AS (
  SELECT player_id, COUNT(*) AS total_catches
  FROM catches
  GROUP BY player_id
),
per_player_innings AS (
  SELECT pim.player_id,
         COUNT(DISTINCT d.match_id || '-' || d.inning) AS innings_fielded
  FROM PlayerInMatch pim
  JOIN t20_matches tm ON pim.match_id = tm.match_id
  JOIN Deliveries d ON d.match_id = tm.match_id AND d.bowling_team = pim.team_name
  WHERE pim.team_name = 'South Africa'
  GROUP BY pim.player_id
),
per_player_max AS (
  SELECT player_id, MAX(cnt) AS max_catches_in_inning
  FROM (
    SELECT fd.fielder_id AS player_id, d.match_id, d.inning, COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM FielderDismissals fd
    JOIN Deliveries d ON fd.delivery_id = d.delivery_id
    JOIN t20_matches tm ON d.match_id = tm.match_id
    JOIN PlayerInMatch pim ON pim.match_id = d.match_id AND pim.player_id = fd.fielder_id AND pim.team_name = 'South Africa'
    WHERE d.wicket_type IN ('caught','caught and bowled')
    GROUP BY fd.fielder_id, d.match_id, d.inning
  )
  GROUP BY player_id
)
SELECT pl.player_name AS fielder,
       t.total_catches AS total_catches,
       i.innings_fielded AS innings_fielded,
       CAST(t.total_catches AS REAL) / i.innings_fielded AS ct_inn_ratio,
       m.max_catches_in_inning AS max_catches_in_inning
FROM per_player_total t
JOIN per_player_innings i ON i.player_id = t.player_id
LEFT JOIN per_player_max m ON m.player_id = t.player_id
JOIN Players pl ON pl.player_id = t.player_id
WHERE t.total_catches >= 16
  AND i.innings_fielded > 0
ORDER BY ct_inn_ratio DESC, t.total_catches DESC, fielder ASC
LIMIT 1;

question: T20 ਵਿਸ਼ਵ ਕੱਪ ਇਤਿਹਾਸ ਵਿੱਚ, 16 ਜਾਂ ਵੱਧ ਕੈਚਾਂ ਵਾਲੇ ਸਾਰੇ ਖਿਡਾਰੀਆਂ ਵਿੱਚੋਂ ਕਿਸ ਦੱਖਣੀ ਅਫ਼ਰੀਕੀ ਫ਼ੀਲਡਰ ਦੀ Ct/Inn ਅਨੁਪਾਤ ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਵੱਧ ਹੈ, ਕੁੱਲ ਕੈਚ ਅਤੇ ਇੱਕੋ ਪਾਰੀ ਵਿੱਚ ਵੱਧ ਤੋਂ ਵੱਧ ਕੈਚ ਵੀ ਦੱਸੋ?
gold_sql: WITH FieldingInnings AS (SELECT pim.player_id, d.match_id, d.inning, COUNT(fd.fielder_dismissal_id) AS catches_in_innings FROM PlayerInMatch pim JOIN Deliveries d ON pim.match_id = d.match_id AND pim.team_name = d.bowling_team LEFT JOIN FielderDismissals fd ON d.delivery_id = fd.delivery_id AND fd.fielder_id = pim.player_id WHERE pim.team_name = 'South Africa' GROUP BY pim.player_id, d.match_id, d.inning), FielderStats AS (SELECT player_id, SUM(catches_in_innings) AS total_catches, COUNT(match_id) AS innings_fielded, MAX(catches_in_innings) AS max_catches_in_inning FROM FieldingInnings GROUP BY player_id) SELECT p.player_name AS fielder, fs.total_catches, fs.innings_fielded, ROUND(CAST(fs.total_catches AS FLOAT) / fs.innings_fielded, 3) AS ct_inn_ratio, fs.max_catches_in_inning FROM FielderStats fs JOIN Players p ON fs.player_id = p.player_id WHERE fs.total_catches >= 16 ORDER BY ct_inn_ratio DESC LIMIT 1;
generated_sql:
WITH t20_matches AS (
  SELECT match_id FROM Matches
  WHERE season LIKE '%T20 World Cup%' OR stage LIKE '%World Cup%'
),
fielder_catches_by_inning AS (
  SELECT fd.fielder_id AS fielder, d.match_id, d.inning, COUNT(*) AS c
  FROM FielderDismissals fd
  JOIN Deliveries d ON fd.delivery_id = d.delivery_id
  JOIN t20_matches tm ON d.match_id = tm.match_id
  JOIN PlayerInMatch pim ON pim.match_id = d.match_id AND pim.player_id = fd.fielder_id AND pim.team_name = d.bowling_team AND pim.team_name = 'South Africa'

  GROUP BY fd.fielder_id, d.match_id, d.inning
),
fielder_totals AS (
  SELECT fielder, SUM(c) AS total_catches, MAX(c) AS max_catches_in_inning
  FROM fielder_catches_by_inning
  GROUP BY fielder
),
innings_fielded AS (
  SELECT pim.player_id AS fielder, COUNT(DISTINCT d.match_id || '-' || d.inning) AS innings_fielded
  FROM PlayerInMatch pim
  JOIN t20_matches tm ON pim.match_id = tm.match_id

question: T20 వరల్డ్ కప్పు ఇతిహాసలో కనీసం 16 క్యాచులు పట్టిన సౌత్ ఆఫ్రికా ఫీల్డర్లలో ఒక మ్యాచ్కు ఎక్కువ క్యాచులు పట్టే (Ct/Inn ఎక్కువగా ఉన్న) క్రీడాకారుడు ఎవరు? అతని మొత్తం క్యాచులు మరియు ఒక ఇన్నింగ్స్లో అన్నిటికన్నా ఎక్కువ క్యాచులు రాయండి.
gold_sql: WITH FieldingInnings AS (SELECT pim.player_id, d.match_id, d.inning, COUNT(fd.fielder_dismissal_id) AS catches_in_innings FROM PlayerInMatch pim JOIN Deliveries d ON pim.match_id = d.match_id AND pim.team_name = d.bowling_team LEFT JOIN FielderDismissals fd ON d.delivery_id = fd.delivery_id AND fd.fielder_id = pim.player_id WHERE pim.team_name = 'South Africa' GROUP BY pim.player_id, d.match_id, d.inning), FielderStats AS (SELECT player_id, SUM(catches_in_innings) AS total_catches, COUNT(match_id) AS innings_fielded, MAX(catches_in_innings) AS max_catches_in_inning FROM FieldingInnings GROUP BY player_id) SELECT p.player_name AS fielder, fs.total_catches, fs.innings_fielded, ROUND(CAST(fs.total_catches AS FLOAT) / fs.innings_fielded, 3) AS ct_inn_ratio, fs.max_catches_in_inning FROM FielderStats fs JOIN Players p ON fs.player_id = p.player_id WHERE fs.total_catches >= 16 ORDER BY ct_inn_ratio DESC LIMIT 1;
generated_sql:
WITH matches_t20 AS (
  SELECT match_id FROM Matches WHERE season = 'T20 World Cup' OR stage = 'T20 World Cup'
),
total AS (
  SELECT fd.fielder_id,
         COUNT(*) AS total_catches
  FROM FielderDismissals fd
  JOIN Deliveries d ON fd.delivery_id = d.delivery_id
  JOIN matches_t20 mt ON d.match_id = mt.match_id
  JOIN PlayerInMatch pim ON pim.match_id = d.match_id AND pim.player_id = fd.fielder_id AND pim.team_name = 'South Africa'
  WHERE d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 AND d.bowling_team = 'South Africa'
  GROUP BY fd.fielder_id
),
max_inn AS (
  SELECT sub.fielder_id, MAX(sub.cnt) AS max_catches_in_inning
  FROM (
    SELECT fd2.fielder_id, d2.match_id, d2.inning, COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM FielderDismissals fd2
    JOIN Deliveries d2 ON fd2.delivery_id = d2.delivery_id
    JOIN matches_t20 mt2 ON d2.match_id = mt2.match_id
    JOIN PlayerInMatch pim2 ON pim2.match_id = d2.match_id AND pim2.player_id = fd2.fielder_id AND pim2.team_name = 'South Africa'
    WHERE d2.wides = 0 AND d2.noballs = 0 AND d2.bowling_team = 'South Africa'
    GROUP BY fd2.fielder_id, d2.match_id, d2.inning
  ) sub
  GROUP BY sub.fielder_id
),
innings AS (
  SELECT p.player_id,
         COUNT(DISTINCT d.match_id || '-' || d.inning) AS innings_fielded
  FROM Players p
  JOIN PlayerInMatch pim ON pim.player_id = p.player_id AND pim.team_name = 'South Africa'
  JOIN Deliveries d ON d.match_id = pim.match_id AND d.bowling_team = 'South Africa' AND d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0
  JOIN matches_t20 mt ON d.match_id = mt.match_id
  GROUP BY p.player_id
)
SELECT
  p.player_name AS fielder,
  t.total_catches AS total_catches,
  i.innings_fielded AS innings_fielded,
  CAST(t.total_catches AS REAL) / i.innings_fielded AS ct_inn_ratio,
  COALESCE(m.max_catches_in_inning, 0) AS max_catches_in_inning
FROM total t
JOIN Players p ON p.player_id = t.fielder_id
JOIN innings i ON i.player_id = t.fielder_id
LEFT JOIN max_inn m ON m.fielder_id = t.fielder_id

question: ठीक 14 कैच वाले सभी खिलाड़ियों में किसका Ct/Inn अनुपात सबसे अच्छा है, 14 कैच वाले सभी चार खिलाड़ियों के नाम, उनके देश, और Ct/Inn के आधार पर सर्वश्रेष्ठ से सबसे कम तक रैंकिंग बताइए।
gold_sql: WITH CatchCounts AS (SELECT fd.fielder_id, COUNT(fd.fielder_dismissal_id) AS total_catches FROM FielderDismissals fd JOIN Deliveries d ON fd.delivery_id = d.delivery_id WHERE d.wicket_type IN ('caught', 'caught and bowled') GROUP BY fd.fielder_id HAVING COUNT(fd.fielder_dismissal_id) = 14), PlayerStats AS (SELECT player_id, MAX(team_name) AS country, COUNT(DISTINCT match_id) AS innings_played FROM PlayerInMatch GROUP BY player_id) SELECT p.player_name, ps.country, cc.total_catches, (cc.total_catches * 1.0 / ps.innings_played) AS ct_inn_ratio FROM CatchCounts cc JOIN PlayerStats ps ON cc.fielder_id = ps.player_id JOIN Players p ON cc.fielder_id = p.player_id ORDER BY ct_inn_ratio DESC;
generated_sql:
SELECT
  p.player_name AS player_name,
  (SELECT pim2.team_name
   FROM PlayerInMatch pim2
   WHERE pim2.player_id = p.player_id
   GROUP BY pim2.team_name
   ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
   LIMIT 1) AS country,
  fc.total_catches AS total_catches,
  (fc.total_catches * 1.0) /
    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d2.match_id || '-' || d2.inning)
     FROM PlayerInMatch pim
     JOIN Deliveries d2 ON pim.match_id = d2.match_id AND pim.team_name = d2.bowling_team
     WHERE pim.player_id = p.player_id AND d2.wides = 0 AND d2.noballs = 0
    ) AS ct_inn_ratio
FROM Players p
JOIN (
  SELECT fd.fielder_id AS fielder_id, COUNT(*) AS total_catches
  FROM FielderDismissals fd
  JOIN Deliveries d ON fd.delivery_id = d.delivery_id
  WHERE d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 AND d.wicket_type LIKE 'caught%'
  GROUP BY fd.fielder_id
  HAVING COUNT(*) = 14
) fc ON p.player_id = fc.fielder_id
ORDER BY ct_inn_ratio DESC, p.player_name;

question: Among all players with exactly 14 catches, which has the best Ct/Inn ratio, name all four players with 14 catches, their countries, and rank them by Ct/Inn best to worst.
gold_sql: WITH CatchCounts AS (SELECT fd.fielder_id, COUNT(fd.fielder_dismissal_id) AS total_catches FROM FielderDismissals fd JOIN Deliveries d ON fd.delivery_id = d.delivery_id WHERE d.wicket_type IN ('caught', 'caught and bowled') GROUP BY fd.fielder_id HAVING COUNT(fd.fielder_dismissal_id) = 14), PlayerStats AS (SELECT player_id, MAX(team_name) AS country, COUNT(DISTINCT match_id) AS innings_played FROM PlayerInMatch GROUP BY player_id) SELECT p.player_name, ps.country, cc.total_catches, (cc.total_catches * 1.0 / ps.innings_played) AS ct_inn_ratio FROM CatchCounts cc JOIN PlayerStats ps ON cc.fielder_id = ps.player_id JOIN Players p ON cc.fielder_id = p.player_id ORDER BY ct_inn_ratio DESC;
generated_sql:
WITH catches AS (
  SELECT
    fd.fielder_id AS player_id,
    COUNT(*) AS total_catches
  FROM FielderDismissals fd
  JOIN Deliveries d ON fd.delivery_id = d.delivery_id
  WHERE (d.wicket_type = 'caught' OR d.wicket_type = 'caught and bowled')
    AND d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0
  GROUP BY fd.fielder_id
  HAVING COUNT(*) = 14
),
innings AS (
  SELECT
    pim.player_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT (d.match_id || '-' || d.inning)) AS innings_count,
    MIN(pim.team_name) AS country
  FROM PlayerInMatch pim
  JOIN Deliveries d ON d.match_id = pim.match_id AND d.bowling_team = pim.team_name
  WHERE d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0
  GROUP BY pim.player_id
)
SELECT
  p.player_name AS player_name,
  i.country AS country,
  c.total_catches AS total_catches,
  (c.total_catches * 1.0) / NULLIF(i.innings_count, 0) AS ct_inn_ratio
FROM catches c
JOIN Players p ON p.player_id = c.player_id
LEFT JOIN innings i ON i.player_id = c.player_id
ORDER BY ct_inn_ratio DESC, player_name ASC;

question: ਠੀਕ 14 ਕੈਚਾਂ ਵਾਲੇ ਸਾਰੇ ਖਿਡਾਰੀਆਂ ਵਿੱਚੋਂ ਕਿਸਦੀ Ct/Inn ਅਨੁਪਾਤ ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਵਧੀਆ ਹੈ, 14 ਕੈਚਾਂ ਵਾਲੇ ਸਾਰੇ ਚਾਰ ਖਿਡਾਰੀਆਂ ਦੇ ਨਾਮ, ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਦੇ ਦੇਸ਼, ਅਤੇ Ct/Inn ਅਨੁਸਾਰ ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਵਧੀਆ ਤੋਂ ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਮਾੜੇ ਕ੍ਰਮ ਵਿੱਚ ਦੱਸੋ?
gold_sql: WITH CatchCounts AS (SELECT fd.fielder_id, COUNT(fd.fielder_dismissal_id) AS total_catches FROM FielderDismissals fd JOIN Deliveries d ON fd.delivery_id = d.delivery_id WHERE d.wicket_type IN ('caught', 'caught and bowled') GROUP BY fd.fielder_id HAVING COUNT(fd.fielder_dismissal_id) = 14), PlayerStats AS (SELECT player_id, MAX(team_name) AS country, COUNT(DISTINCT match_id) AS innings_played FROM PlayerInMatch GROUP BY player_id) SELECT p.player_name, ps.country, cc.total_catches, (cc.total_catches * 1.0 / ps.innings_played) AS ct_inn_ratio FROM CatchCounts cc JOIN PlayerStats ps ON cc.fielder_id = ps.player_id JOIN Players p ON cc.fielder_id = p.player_id ORDER BY ct_inn_ratio DESC;
generated_sql:
SELECT
  p.player_name AS player_name,
  (SELECT pim.team_name
   FROM PlayerInMatch pim
   WHERE pim.player_id = p.player_id
   GROUP BY pim.team_name
   ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, pim.team_name ASC
   LIMIT 1) AS country,
  fc.total_catches AS total_catches,
  CASE WHEN COALESCE(innings.inns,0) > 0 THEN CAST(fc.total_catches AS REAL) / innings.inns ELSE NULL END AS ct_inn_ratio
FROM Players p
JOIN (
  SELECT fielder_id, COUNT(*) AS total_catches

) fc ON fc.fielder_id = p.player_id

  WHERE d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0
  GROUP BY pim.player_id
) innings ON innings.player_id = p.player_id
ORDER BY ct_inn_ratio DESC;

question: సరిగ్గా 14 క్యాచులు ఉన్న క్రీడాకార్లలో ఎవరి దగ్గర అన్నిటికన్నా మంచి Ct/Inn రేషియో ఉన్నది? అన్నీ నలుగురు ఆటగాళ్లు మరియు వాళ్ళ దేశాలు రాయండి. వారిని Ct/Inn రేషియో ప్రకారం ఎక్కువ నుండి తక్కువ వరుసలో అమర్చండి.
gold_sql: WITH CatchCounts AS (SELECT fd.fielder_id, COUNT(fd.fielder_dismissal_id) AS total_catches FROM FielderDismissals fd JOIN Deliveries d ON fd.delivery_id = d.delivery_id WHERE d.wicket_type IN ('caught', 'caught and bowled') GROUP BY fd.fielder_id HAVING COUNT(fd.fielder_dismissal_id) = 14), PlayerStats AS (SELECT player_id, MAX(team_name) AS country, COUNT(DISTINCT match_id) AS innings_played FROM PlayerInMatch GROUP BY player_id) SELECT p.player_name, ps.country, cc.total_catches, (cc.total_catches * 1.0 / ps.innings_played) AS ct_inn_ratio FROM CatchCounts cc JOIN PlayerStats ps ON cc.fielder_id = ps.player_id JOIN Players p ON cc.fielder_id = p.player_id ORDER BY ct_inn_ratio DESC;

SELECT

gold_sql: WITH MatchCatches AS (SELECT fd.fielder_id, d.match_id, COUNT(fd.fielder_dismissal_id) AS match_catches FROM FielderDismissals fd JOIN Deliveries d ON fd.delivery_id = d.delivery_id JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id WHERE d.wicket_type = 'caught' AND m.season = '2026' GROUP BY fd.fielder_id, d.match_id) SELECT p.player_name, (SUM(mc.match_catches) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT pim.match_id) FROM PlayerInMatch pim JOIN Matches m ON pim.match_id = m.match_id WHERE pim.player_id = mc.fielder_id AND m.season = '2026')) AS ct_inn_ratio, MAX(mc.match_catches) AS max_catches_in_innings FROM MatchCatches mc JOIN Players p ON mc.fielder_id = p.player_id WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM PlayerInMatch pim WHERE pim.player_id = mc.fielder_id AND pim.team_name = 'West Indies') GROUP BY mc.fielder_id, p.player_name HAVING MAX(mc.match_catches) >= 3;

WITH legal_fd AS (

),
players_with_3plus AS (

  WHERE catches_in_match >= 3
),
total_catches AS (
  SELECT fd.fielder_id, COUNT(*) AS total_catches

innings_fielded AS (
  SELECT pim.player_id, COUNT(DISTINCT (d.match_id || '-' || d.inning)) AS innings_count

  JOIN Matches m ON pim.match_id = m.match_id
  JOIN Deliveries d ON d.match_id = pim.match_id AND pim.team_name = d.bowling_team
  WHERE m.season = '2026' AND pim.team_name = 'West Indies'

),
max_catches_in_innings AS (
  SELECT fielder_id, MAX(cnt) AS max_catches
  FROM (
    SELECT fd.fielder_id, d.match_id, d.inning, COUNT(*) AS cnt

question: Name the West Indian fielder who took 3+ catches in a single match in season 2026, his Ct/Inn ratio, and Maximum catches in an innings.
gold_sql: WITH MatchCatches AS (SELECT fd.fielder_id, d.match_id, COUNT(fd.fielder_dismissal_id) AS match_catches FROM FielderDismissals fd JOIN Deliveries d ON fd.delivery_id = d.delivery_id JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id WHERE d.wicket_type = 'caught' AND m.season = '2026' GROUP BY fd.fielder_id, d.match_id) SELECT p.player_name, (SUM(mc.match_catches) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT pim.match_id) FROM PlayerInMatch pim JOIN Matches m ON pim.match_id = m.match_id WHERE pim.player_id = mc.fielder_id AND m.season = '2026')) AS ct_inn_ratio, MAX(mc.match_catches) AS max_catches_in_innings FROM MatchCatches mc JOIN Players p ON mc.fielder_id = p.player_id WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM PlayerInMatch pim WHERE pim.player_id = mc.fielder_id AND pim.team_name = 'West Indies') GROUP BY mc.fielder_id, p.player_name HAVING MAX(mc.match_catches) >= 3;
generated_sql:
WITH
per_match_catches AS (
  SELECT fd.fielder_id, m.match_id, COUNT(*) AS catches_in_match
  FROM FielderDismissals fd
  JOIN Deliveries del ON fd.delivery_id = del.delivery_id
  JOIN Matches m ON del.match_id = m.match_id
  JOIN PlayerInMatch pim ON pim.match_id = m.match_id
    AND pim.player_id = fd.fielder_id
    AND pim.team_name = del.bowling_team
    AND pim.team_name = 'West Indies'
  WHERE m.season = '2026'
    AND del.wicket_type = 'caught'
  GROUP BY fd.fielder_id, m.match_id
),
qual AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT fielder_id
  FROM per_match_catches
  WHERE catches_in_match >= 3
),
total_catches AS (
  SELECT fd.fielder_id, COUNT(*) AS total_catches
  FROM FielderDismissals fd
  JOIN Deliveries del ON fd.delivery_id = del.delivery_id
  JOIN Matches m ON del.match_id = m.match_id
  WHERE m.season = '2026'
    AND del.wicket_type = 'caught'
  GROUP BY fd.fielder_id
),
innings_fielded AS (
  SELECT pim.player_id,
         COUNT(DISTINCT m.match_id || '-' || del.inning) AS innings_fielded
  FROM PlayerInMatch pim
  JOIN Matches m ON pim.match_id = m.match_id
    AND m.season = '2026'
    AND pim.team_name = 'West Indies'
  JOIN Deliveries del ON del.match_id = m.match_id
    AND del.bowling_team = pim.team_name
  GROUP BY pim.player_id
),
per_inning AS (
  SELECT fd.fielder_id, m.match_id, del.inning, COUNT(*) AS catches_in_innings
  FROM FielderDismissals fd
  JOIN Deliveries del ON fd.delivery_id = del.delivery_id
  JOIN Matches m ON del.match_id = m.match_id
  JOIN PlayerInMatch pim ON pim.match_id = m.match_id
    AND pim.player_id = fd.fielder_id
    AND pim.team_name = del.bowling_team
    AND pim.team_name = 'West Indies'
  WHERE m.season = '2026'
    AND del.wicket_type = 'caught'
  GROUP BY fd.fielder_id, m.match_id, del.inning
),
per_inning_max AS (
  SELECT fielder_id, MAX(catches_in_innings) AS max_catches_in_innings
  FROM per_inning
  GROUP BY fielder_id
)
SELECT
  p.player_name AS player_name,
  CASE WHEN IFNULL(inn.innings_fielded,0) > 0
       THEN CAST(IFNULL(tc.total_catches,0) AS REAL) / inn.innings_fielded
       ELSE 0 END AS ct_inn_ratio,
  IFNULL(pimx.max_catches_in_innings,0) AS max_catches_in_innings
FROM qual q
JOIN Players p ON p.player_id = q.fielder_id
LEFT JOIN total_catches tc ON tc.fielder_id = q.fielder_id
LEFT JOIN innings_fielded inn ON inn.player_id = q.fielder_id
LEFT JOIN per_inning_max pimx ON pimx.fielder_id = q.fielder_id;

question: ਉਸ West Indies ਫ਼ੀਲਡਰ ਦਾ ਨਾਮ ਦੱਸੋ ਜਿਸਨੇ ਸੀਜ਼ਨ 2026 ਵਿੱਚ ਇੱਕੋ ਮੈਚ ਵਿੱਚ 3+ ਕੈਚ ਲਏ, ਉਸਦੀ Ct/Inn ਅਨੁਪਾਤ ਅਤੇ ਇੱਕ ਪਾਰੀ ਵਿੱਚ ਵੱਧ ਤੋਂ ਵੱਧ ਕੈਚ ਵੀ ਦੱਸੋ?
gold_sql: WITH MatchCatches AS (SELECT fd.fielder_id, d.match_id, COUNT(fd.fielder_dismissal_id) AS match_catches FROM FielderDismissals fd JOIN Deliveries d ON fd.delivery_id = d.delivery_id JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id WHERE d.wicket_type = 'caught' AND m.season = '2026' GROUP BY fd.fielder_id, d.match_id) SELECT p.player_name, (SUM(mc.match_catches) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT pim.match_id) FROM PlayerInMatch pim JOIN Matches m ON pim.match_id = m.match_id WHERE pim.player_id = mc.fielder_id AND m.season = '2026')) AS ct_inn_ratio, MAX(mc.match_catches) AS max_catches_in_innings FROM MatchCatches mc JOIN Players p ON mc.fielder_id = p.player_id WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM PlayerInMatch pim WHERE pim.player_id = mc.fielder_id AND pim.team_name = 'West Indies') GROUP BY mc.fielder_id, p.player_name HAVING MAX(mc.match_catches) >= 3;
generated_sql:
WITH season_matches AS (

),
catches_innings AS (

    AND d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0
    AND d.wicket_type LIKE 'caught%'
    AND d.bowling_team = 'West Indies'
  GROUP BY fd.fielder_id, d.match_id, d.inning
),
catches_matches AS (
  SELECT player_id, match_id, SUM(catches_in_inning) AS catches_in_match
  FROM catches_innings
  GROUP BY player_id, match_id
),
players_with_3plus AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT player_id FROM catches_matches WHERE catches_in_match >= 3
),
total_and_max AS (
  SELECT player_id,
         SUM(catches_in_inning) AS total_catches,
         MAX(catches_in_inning) AS max_catches_in_innings
  FROM catches_innings
  GROUP BY player_id
),
innings_fielded AS (
  SELECT pim.player_id,
         COUNT(DISTINCT (d.match_id || '-' || d.inning)) AS innings_count
  FROM PlayerInMatch pim
  JOIN Deliveries d ON pim.match_id = d.match_id AND pim.team_name = d.bowling_team
  WHERE pim.team_name = 'West Indies' AND pim.match_id IN (SELECT match_id FROM season_matches)
  GROUP BY pim.player_id
),
west_players AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT player_id FROM PlayerInMatch WHERE team_name = 'West Indies' AND match_id IN (SELECT match_id FROM season_matches)
)
SELECT pl.player_name AS player_name,
       CAST(ta.total_catches AS REAL) / inn.innings_count AS ct_inn_ratio,
       ta.max_catches_in_innings AS max_catches_in_innings
FROM Players pl
JOIN players_with_3plus pw ON pl.player_id = pw.player_id
JOIN west_players wp ON pl.player_id = wp.player_id
JOIN total_and_max ta ON pl.player_id = ta.player_id
JOIN innings_fielded inn ON pl.player_id = inn.player_id;

question: సీజన్ 2026 లో ఒకే మ్యాచ్ లో 3+ క్యాచులు పట్టుకున్న వెస్ట్ ఇండీస్ ఫీల్డర్ ఎవరు? అతన Ct/Inn రేషియో మరియు ఒక ఇన్నింగ్స్లో అతను పట్టిన అత్యధిక క���యాచుల సంఖ్యను రాయండి.
gold_sql: WITH MatchCatches AS (SELECT fd.fielder_id, d.match_id, COUNT(fd.fielder_dismissal_id) AS match_catches FROM FielderDismissals fd JOIN Deliveries d ON fd.delivery_id = d.delivery_id JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id WHERE d.wicket_type = 'caught' AND m.season = '2026' GROUP BY fd.fielder_id, d.match_id) SELECT p.player_name, (SUM(mc.match_catches) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT pim.match_id) FROM PlayerInMatch pim JOIN Matches m ON pim.match_id = m.match_id WHERE pim.player_id = mc.fielder_id AND m.season = '2026')) AS ct_inn_ratio, MAX(mc.match_catches) AS max_catches_in_innings FROM MatchCatches mc JOIN Players p ON mc.fielder_id = p.player_id WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM PlayerInMatch pim WHERE pim.player_id = mc.fielder_id AND pim.team_name = 'West Indies') GROUP BY mc.fielder_id, p.player_name HAVING MAX(mc.match_catches) >= 3;
generated_sql:
WITH matches_2026 AS (
  SELECT match_id FROM Matches WHERE season = '2026'
),
caught_events AS (
  SELECT fd.fielder_id, d.match_id, d.inning
  FROM FielderDismissals fd
  JOIN Deliveries d ON fd.delivery_id = d.delivery_id
  JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
  WHERE m.season = '2026'
    AND d.wicket_type LIKE 'caught%'
    AND d.wides = 0
    AND d.noballs = 0
),
catches_per_inning AS (
  SELECT fielder_id, match_id, inning, COUNT(*) AS catches_in_inning
  FROM caught_events
  GROUP BY fielder_id, match_id, inning
),
catches_per_match AS (
  SELECT fielder_id, match_id, SUM(catches_in_inning) AS catches_in_match
  FROM catches_per_inning
  GROUP BY fielder_id, match_id
),
qualified_players AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT cpm.fielder_id
  FROM catches_per_match cpm
  JOIN PlayerInMatch pim ON cpm.match_id = pim.match_id AND cpm.fielder_id = pim.player_id
  WHERE pim.team_name = 'West Indies' AND cpm.catches_in_match >= 3
),
-- total catches in season 2026 while representing West Indies
total_catches AS (
  SELECT ce.fielder_id, COUNT(*) AS total_catches
  FROM caught_events ce
  JOIN PlayerInMatch pim ON ce.match_id = pim.match_id AND ce.fielder_id = pim.player_id
  WHERE pim.team_name = 'West Indies'
  GROUP BY ce.fielder_id
),
-- innings fielded in season 2026 while representing West Indies (distinct match+inning where their team was bowling)
innings_fielded AS (
  SELECT pim.player_id, COUNT(DISTINCT (d.match_id || '-' || d.inning)) AS innings_fielded
  FROM PlayerInMatch pim
  JOIN Matches m ON pim.match_id = m.match_id AND m.season = '2026'
  JOIN Deliveries d ON d.match_id = pim.match_id AND d.bowling_team = pim.team_name
  WHERE pim.team_name = 'West Indies'
  GROUP BY pim.player_id
),
-- max catches in a single innings in season 2026 while representing West Indies
max_catches_in_innings_cte AS (
  SELECT cpi.fielder_id, MAX(cpi.catches_in_inning) AS max_catches_in_innings
  FROM catches_per_inning cpi
  JOIN PlayerInMatch pim ON cpi.match_id = pim.match_id AND cpi.fielder_id = pim.player_id
  WHERE pim.team_name = 'West Indies'
  GROUP BY cpi.fielder_id
)
SELECT
  p.player_name AS player_name,
  (CAST(tc.total_catches AS REAL) / NULLIF(ie.innings_fielded, 0)) AS ct_inn_ratio,
  mc.max_catches_in_innings AS max_catches_in_innings
FROM qualified_players qp
JOIN Players p ON qp.fielder_id = p.player_id
LEFT JOIN total_catches tc ON tc.fielder_id = p.player_id
LEFT JOIN innings_fielded ie ON ie.player_id = p.player_id
LEFT JOIN max_catches_in_innings_cte mc ON mc.fielder_id = p.player_id;

question: In T20 history, excluding the teams with No Results (NR), which team has the worst win-loss record in a single series, and what is their exact record?
gold_sql: WITH TeamSeasonStats AS (SELECT m.season, t.team_name, SUM(CASE WHEN m.match_winner = t.team_name THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wins, SUM(CASE WHEN m.match_winner != t.team_name AND m.match_winner IS NOT NULL AND m.result_type != 'no result' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS losses, SUM(CASE WHEN m.match_winner IS NULL OR m.result_type = 'no result' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS nr_count FROM Matches m JOIN (SELECT match_id, team1 AS team_name FROM Matches UNION ALL SELECT match_id, team2 AS team_name FROM Matches) t ON m.match_id = t.match_id GROUP BY m.season, t.team_name) SELECT team_name, season, wins, losses FROM TeamSeasonStats WHERE nr_count = 0 ORDER BY (wins * 1.0 / (wins + losses)) ASC, losses DESC LIMIT 1;
generated_sql:
SELECT team_name AS team_name, season AS season, SUM(win) AS wins, SUM(loss) AS losses
FROM (
  SELECT team1 AS team_name, season,
    CASE WHEN match_winner = team1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS win,
    CASE WHEN match_winner IS NOT NULL AND match_winner != team1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS loss
  FROM Matches
  WHERE COALESCE(lower(result_type),'') NOT IN ('no result','nr')
  UNION ALL
  SELECT team2 AS team_name, season,
    CASE WHEN match_winner = team2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS win,
    CASE WHEN match_winner IS NOT NULL AND match_winner != team2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS loss
  FROM Matches
  WHERE COALESCE(lower(result_type),'') NOT IN ('no result','nr')
) AS combined
GROUP BY team_name, season
ORDER BY wins ASC, losses DESC
LIMIT 1;

question: T20 ਇਤਿਹਾਸ ਵਿੱਚ, ਕੋਈ ਨਤੀਜਾ ਨਾ (NR) ਵਾਲੀਆਂ ਟੀਮਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਛੱਡ ਕੇ, ਕਿਸ ਟੀਮ ਦਾ ਇੱਕੋ ਲੜੀ ਵਿੱਚ ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਖਰਾਬ ਜਿੱਤ-ਹਾਰ ਰਿਕਾਰਡ ਹੈ, ਅਤੇ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਦਾ ਸਹੀ ਰਿਕਾਰਡ ਕੀ ਹੈ?
gold_sql: WITH TeamSeasonStats AS (SELECT m.season, t.team_name, SUM(CASE WHEN m.match_winner = t.team_name THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wins, SUM(CASE WHEN m.match_winner != t.team_name AND m.match_winner IS NOT NULL AND m.result_type != 'no result' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS losses, SUM(CASE WHEN m.match_winner IS NULL OR m.result_type = 'no result' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS nr_count FROM Matches m JOIN (SELECT match_id, team1 AS team_name FROM Matches UNION ALL SELECT match_id, team2 AS team_name FROM Matches) t ON m.match_id = t.match_id GROUP BY m.season, t.team_name) SELECT team_name, season, wins, losses FROM TeamSeasonStats WHERE nr_count = 0 ORDER BY (wins * 1.0 / (wins + losses)) ASC, losses DESC LIMIT 1;
generated_sql:
SELECT team_name AS team_name, season AS season, wins AS wins, losses AS losses
FROM (
  SELECT team_name, season,
    SUM(CASE WHEN match_winner = team_name THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wins,
    SUM(CASE WHEN match_winner IS NOT NULL AND match_winner <> team_name THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS losses,
    CASE 
      WHEN (SUM(CASE WHEN match_winner = team_name THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + SUM(CASE WHEN match_winner IS NOT NULL AND match_winner <> team_name THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) = 0 THEN 1.0
      ELSE 1.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN match_winner = team_name THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / (SUM(CASE WHEN match_winner = team_name THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + SUM(CASE WHEN match_winner IS NOT NULL AND match_winner <> team_name THEN 1 ELSE 0 END))
    END AS win_pct
  FROM (
    SELECT match_id, season, result_type, match_winner, team1 AS team_name FROM Matches
    UNION ALL
    SELECT match_id, season, result_type, match_winner, team2 AS team_name FROM Matches
  ) t
  WHERE NOT (result_type = 'no result')
  GROUP BY team_name, season
) s
WHERE (wins + losses) > 0
ORDER BY win_pct ASC, losses DESC, wins ASC, team_name ASC
LIMIT 1;

  UNION

),

  SELECT d.match_id, SUM(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS legal_balls
  FROM Deliveries d
  GROUP BY d.match_id

    bowling_team AS bowling_team,

FROM Deliveries d
JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id

question: ਕਿਸ ਟੀਮ ਦੇ ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਵੱਧ ਨੋ ਬਾਲ ਸਨ ਜਦੋਂ ਕਿ ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਘੱਟ ਵਾਈਡਾਂ ਦਿੱਤੀਆਂ? ਵਿਰੋਧੀ ਟੀਮ ਅਤੇ ਨੋ ਬਾਲ ਤੋਂ ਵਾਈਡ ਅਨੁਪਾਤ ਵੀ ਦੱਸੋ?
gold_sql: SELECT bowling_team, batting_team AS opposing_team, (SUM(noballs) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(wides), 0)) AS nb_to_wide_ratio FROM Deliveries GROUP BY match_id, bowling_team, batting_team ORDER BY SUM(noballs) DESC, SUM(wides) ASC LIMIT 1;
generated_sql:
WITH pair_stats AS (
  SELECT
    bowling_team,
    batting_team AS opposing_team,
    SUM(noballs) AS total_noballs,
    SUM(wides)   AS total_wides
  FROM Deliveries
  GROUP BY bowling_team, batting_team
),
min_wides AS (
  SELECT MIN(total_wides) AS min_wides FROM pair_stats
)
SELECT
  bowling_team AS bowling_team,
  opposing_team AS opposing_team,
  CAST(total_noballs AS REAL) / NULLIF(total_wides, 0) AS nb_to_wide_ratio
FROM pair_stats
WHERE total_wides = (SELECT min_wides FROM min_wides)
ORDER BY total_noballs DESC, bowling_team ASC
LIMIT 1;

question: Which team recorded the most leg byes in a T20I innings, how many , against whom, at what venue, and what were their total extras and score?
gold_sql: SELECT d.batting_team, SUM(d.legbyes) AS total_legbyes, d.bowling_team AS against_whom, m.venue, SUM(d.extra_runs) AS total_extras, SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) AS total_score FROM Deliveries d JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id GROUP BY d.match_id, d.inning, d.batting_team, d.bowling_team, m.venue ORDER BY total_legbyes DESC LIMIT 1;

  d.batting_team AS batting_team,
  SUM(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN d.legbyes ELSE 0 END) AS total_legbyes,
  CASE WHEN m.team1 = d.batting_team THEN m.team2 ELSE m.team1 END AS against_whom,
  m.venue AS venue,
  SUM(d.extra_runs) AS total_extras,
  SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) AS total_score

GROUP BY d.match_id, d.inning, d.batting_team

question: सबसे कम वाइड्स देते हुए सबसे अधिक नो-बॉल किस टीम ने फेंकी? विपक्षी टीम और नो-बॉल से वाइड्स का अनुपात भी बताइए।
gold_sql: SELECT bowling_team, batting_team AS opposing_team, (SUM(noballs) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(wides), 0)) AS nb_to_wide_ratio FROM Deliveries GROUP BY match_id, bowling_team, batting_team ORDER BY SUM(noballs) DESC, SUM(wides) ASC LIMIT 1;
generated_sql:
WITH totals AS (
  SELECT bowling_team, SUM(noballs) AS total_nb, SUM(wides) AS total_wides
  FROM Deliveries
  GROUP BY bowling_team
),
min_wides AS (
  SELECT MIN(total_wides) AS mw FROM totals
),
best AS (
  SELECT t.*
  FROM totals t
  WHERE t.total_wides = (SELECT mw FROM min_wides)
    AND t.total_nb = (
      SELECT MAX(total_nb) FROM totals WHERE total_wides = (SELECT mw FROM min_wides)
    )
),
opp AS (
  SELECT b.bowling_team,
         d.batting_team AS opposing_team,
         SUM(d.noballs) AS nb_vs_opponent
  FROM best b
  JOIN Deliveries d ON d.bowling_team = b.bowling_team
  GROUP BY b.bowling_team, d.batting_team
),
opp_choice AS (
  SELECT bowling_team, opposing_team
  FROM (
    SELECT bowling_team, opposing_team, nb_vs_opponent,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY bowling_team ORDER BY nb_vs_opponent DESC, opposing_team ASC) AS rn
    FROM opp
  ) WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT b.bowling_team AS bowling_team,
       o.opposing_team AS opposing_team,
       (CAST(b.total_nb AS REAL) / NULLIF(b.total_wides, 0)) AS nb_to_wide_ratio
FROM best b
LEFT JOIN opp_choice o USING (bowling_team);

question: ఏ టీం అన్నిటికన్నా తక్కువ వైడ్లు ఇస్తూ అన్నిటికన్నా ఎక్కువ నో బాల్స సంపాదించింది? వ్యతిరేకమైన టీం మరియు నో బాల్స/వైడ్ల రేషియో రాయండి.
gold_sql: SELECT bowling_team, batting_team AS opposing_team, (SUM(noballs) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(wides), 0)) AS nb_to_wide_ratio FROM Deliveries GROUP BY match_id, bowling_team, batting_team ORDER BY SUM(noballs) DESC, SUM(wides) ASC LIMIT 1;
generated_sql:
WITH totals AS (
  SELECT
    bowling_team,
    SUM(wides) AS wides_sum,
    SUM(noballs) AS noballs_sum
  FROM Deliveries
  GROUP BY bowling_team
),
target AS (
  SELECT bowling_team
  FROM totals
  WHERE wides_sum = (SELECT MIN(wides_sum) FROM totals)
    AND noballs_sum = (SELECT MAX(noballs_sum) FROM totals)
)
SELECT
  d.bowling_team AS bowling_team,
  d.batting_team AS opposing_team,
  SUM(d.noballs)*1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(d.wides), 0) AS nb_to_wide_ratio
FROM Deliveries d
JOIN target t ON d.bowling_team = t.bowling_team
GROUP BY d.bowling_team, d.batting_team;

question: टी20I करियर बल्लेबाज़ी इतिहास में, 3000 से अधिक रन वाले सभी भारतीय खिलाड़ियों में सबसे अधिक स्ट्राइक रेट किस भारतीय बल्लेबाज़ का है? उसका स्ट्राइक रेट, औसत और कुल छक्के बताइए।
gold_sql: SELECT p.player_name, (SUM(d.runs_scored) * 100.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) AS strike_rate, (SUM(d.runs_scored) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN d.player_out_id = d.striker_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0)) AS average, SUM(CASE WHEN d.runs_scored = 6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_sixes FROM Deliveries d JOIN Players p ON d.striker_id = p.player_id WHERE d.batting_team = 'India' GROUP BY d.striker_id, p.player_name HAVING SUM(d.runs_scored) >= 3000 ORDER BY strike_rate DESC LIMIT 1;
generated_sql:
SELECT p.player_name AS player_name,
       (d.total_runs * 100.0) / d.balls_faced AS strike_rate,
       CASE WHEN d.dismissals = 0 THEN NULL ELSE (d.total_runs * 1.0) / d.dismissals END AS average,
       d.total_sixes AS total_sixes
FROM Players p
JOIN (
  SELECT striker_id AS player_id,
         SUM(runs_scored) AS total_runs,
         SUM(CASE WHEN wides = 0 AND noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS balls_faced,
         SUM(CASE WHEN player_out_id = striker_id AND wicket_type IS NOT NULL AND wicket_type NOT IN ('run out','retired hurt','obstructing the field') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dismissals,
         SUM(CASE WHEN runs_scored = 6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_sixes
  FROM Deliveries
  WHERE batting_team = 'India'
  GROUP BY striker_id
) d ON p.player_id = d.player_id
WHERE EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM PlayerInMatch pim WHERE pim.player_id = p.player_id AND pim.team_name = 'India'
)
AND d.total_runs > 3000
ORDER BY strike_rate DESC
LIMIT 1;

question: In T20I career batting history, which Indian batter has the highest strike rate among all Indian players with 3000+ runs. Report the Strike rate, average, and total sixes?
gold_sql: SELECT p.player_name, (SUM(d.runs_scored) * 100.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) AS strike_rate, (SUM(d.runs_scored) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN d.player_out_id = d.striker_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0)) AS average, SUM(CASE WHEN d.runs_scored = 6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_sixes FROM Deliveries d JOIN Players p ON d.striker_id = p.player_id WHERE d.batting_team = 'India' GROUP BY d.striker_id, p.player_name HAVING SUM(d.runs_scored) >= 3000 ORDER BY strike_rate DESC LIMIT 1;
generated_sql:
