       (b.total_runs * 100.0) / NULLIF(b.total_balls, 0) AS strike_rate,
       CASE WHEN IFNULL(o.times_out, 0) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE (b.total_runs * 1.0) / o.times_out END AS average,
       b.total_sixes AS total_sixes
FROM (
  SELECT striker_id AS player_id,
         SUM(runs_scored) AS total_runs,
         SUM(CASE WHEN wides = 0 AND noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_balls,
         SUM(CASE WHEN runs_scored = 6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_sixes
  FROM Deliveries
  GROUP BY striker_id
) b
JOIN Players p ON p.player_id = b.player_id
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT player_out_id AS player_id,
         SUM(CASE WHEN wicket_type IS NOT NULL AND wicket_type != 'retired hurt' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS times_out
  FROM Deliveries
  WHERE player_out_id IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY player_out_id
) o ON o.player_id = b.player_id
WHERE b.total_runs >= 3000
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM PlayerInMatch pim WHERE pim.player_id = p.player_id AND pim.team_name = 'India'
  )

question: T20I బ్యాటింగ్ ఇతిహాసలో 3000+ పరుగులు సంపాదించిన భారతీయ క్రీడాకార్లలో ఎవరి దగ్గర అన్నిటికన్నా ఎక్కువ స్ట్రైక్ రేట్ ఉన్నది? స్ట్రైక్ రేట్, ఒక మ్యాచ్లో ఆవెరేజ్ పరుగులు మరియు సిక్సుల సంఖ్య రాయండి.
gold_sql: SELECT p.player_name, (SUM(d.runs_scored) * 100.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) AS strike_rate, (SUM(d.runs_scored) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN d.player_out_id = d.striker_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0)) AS average, SUM(CASE WHEN d.runs_scored = 6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_sixes FROM Deliveries d JOIN Players p ON d.striker_id = p.player_id WHERE d.batting_team = 'India' GROUP BY d.striker_id, p.player_name HAVING SUM(d.runs_scored) >= 3000 ORDER BY strike_rate DESC LIMIT 1;

question: 29 (50+ स्कोर) वाले सभी खिलाड़ियों में सबसे अधिक SR किसका है, सभी चार खिलाड़ियों के नाम, उनके देश, और उनका SR भी बताइए।
gold_sql: WITH BattingStats AS (SELECT striker_id, SUM(runs_scored) AS total_runs, COUNT(delivery_id) - SUM(CASE WHEN wides > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS balls_faced FROM Deliveries GROUP BY striker_id), InningsScores AS (SELECT striker_id, match_id, inning, SUM(runs_scored) AS innings_runs FROM Deliveries GROUP BY striker_id, match_id, inning), FiftyPlusCounts AS (SELECT striker_id, COUNT(*) AS fifty_plus_scores FROM InningsScores WHERE innings_runs >= 50 GROUP BY striker_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 29) SELECT p.player_name AS Player, (SELECT team_name FROM PlayerInMatch WHERE player_id = p.player_id LIMIT 1) AS Country, fpc.fifty_plus_scores, ROUND(CAST(bs.total_runs AS FLOAT) / bs.balls_faced * 100, 2) AS SR FROM FiftyPlusCounts fpc JOIN Players p ON fpc.striker_id = p.player_id JOIN BattingStats bs ON fpc.striker_id = bs.striker_id ORDER BY SR DESC;
gold_answer: ["('JC Buttler', 'England', 29, 148.17)", "('DA Warner', 'Australia', 29, 142.78)", "('RG Sharma', 'India', 35, 140.64)", "('V Kohli', 'India', 37, 136.06)", "('Babar Azam', 'Pakistan', 41, 128.32)", "('S Mandhana', 'India', 33, 126.71)", "('BL Mooney', 'Australia', 30, 126.25)", "('Mohammad Rizwan', 'Pakistan', 31, 126.01)"]

       pim.team_name AS Country,
       t.total_runs AS fifty_plus_scores,
       ROUND(t.total_runs * 100.0 / t.balls, 2) AS SR
FROM (
  SELECT striker_id AS player_id,
         SUM(runs_scored - (byes + legbyes + wides + noballs)) AS total_runs,
         SUM(CASE WHEN wides = 0 AND noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS balls
  FROM Deliveries
  WHERE match_id = 29
  GROUP BY striker_id
) t
JOIN Players p ON p.player_id = t.player_id

question: T20I ਕਰੀਅਰ ਬੱਲੇਬਾਜ਼ੀ ਇਤਿਹਾਸ ਵਿੱਚ, 3000 ਜਾਂ ਵੱਧ ਰਨਾਂ ਵਾਲੇ ਸਾਰੇ Indian ਖਿਡਾਰੀਆਂ ਵਿੱਚੋਂ ਕਿਸ Indian ਬੱਲੇਬਾਜ਼ ਦੀ ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਵੱਧ ਸਟ੍ਰਾਈਕ ਰੇਟ ਹੈ? ਸਟ੍ਰਾਈਕ ਰੇਟ, ਔਸਤ ਅਤੇ ਕੁੱਲ ਛੱਕੇ ਵੀ ਦੱਸੋ?
gold_sql: SELECT p.player_name, (SUM(d.runs_scored) * 100.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) AS strike_rate, (SUM(d.runs_scored) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN d.player_out_id = d.striker_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0)) AS average, SUM(CASE WHEN d.runs_scored = 6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_sixes FROM Deliveries d JOIN Players p ON d.striker_id = p.player_id WHERE d.batting_team = 'India' GROUP BY d.striker_id, p.player_name HAVING SUM(d.runs_scored) >= 3000 ORDER BY strike_rate DESC LIMIT 1;
generated_sql:
SELECT player_name AS player_name,
       CASE WHEN balls>0 THEN CAST(total_runs*100.0 AS REAL)/balls ELSE NULL END AS strike_rate,
       CASE WHEN dismissals>0 THEN CAST(total_runs AS REAL)/dismissals ELSE NULL END AS average,
       total_sixes AS total_sixes
FROM (
  SELECT p.player_id, p.player_name,
         (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(d.runs_scored - d.extra_runs),0) FROM Deliveries d WHERE d.batting_team='India' AND d.striker_id = p.player_id) AS total_runs,
         (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d.wides=0 AND d.noballs=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) FROM Deliveries d WHERE d.batting_team='India' AND d.striker_id = p.player_id) AS balls,
         (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN (d.runs_scored - d.extra_runs)=6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) FROM Deliveries d WHERE d.batting_team='India' AND d.striker_id = p.player_id) AS total_sixes,
         (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out','retired hurt','obstructing the field') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) FROM Deliveries d WHERE d.batting_team='India' AND d.player_out_id = p.player_id) AS dismissals
  FROM Players p
  WHERE p.player_id IN (
    SELECT striker_id FROM Deliveries WHERE batting_team='India'
    UNION
    SELECT player_out_id FROM Deliveries WHERE batting_team='India'
  )
)
WHERE total_runs >= 3000
ORDER BY strike_rate DESC
LIMIT 1;

gold_sql: WITH BattingStats AS (SELECT striker_id, SUM(runs_scored) AS total_runs, COUNT(delivery_id) - SUM(CASE WHEN wides > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS balls_faced FROM Deliveries GROUP BY striker_id), InningsScores AS (SELECT striker_id, match_id, inning, SUM(runs_scored) AS innings_runs FROM Deliveries GROUP BY striker_id, match_id, inning), FiftyPlusCounts AS (SELECT striker_id, COUNT(*) AS fifty_plus_scores FROM InningsScores WHERE innings_runs >= 50 GROUP BY striker_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 29) SELECT p.player_name AS Player, (SELECT team_name FROM PlayerInMatch WHERE player_id = p.player_id LIMIT 1) AS Country, fpc.fifty_plus_scores, ROUND(CAST(bs.total_runs AS FLOAT) / bs.balls_faced * 100, 2) AS SR FROM FiftyPlusCounts fpc JOIN Players p ON fpc.striker_id = p.player_id JOIN BattingStats bs ON fpc.striker_id = bs.striker_id ORDER BY SR DESC;

question: In T20I history, which player has the most sixes among all players with 30+ fifty-plus scores , average, and ducks?
gold_sql: WITH PlayerMatchStats AS (SELECT striker_id, match_id, SUM(runs_scored) AS match_runs, SUM(CASE WHEN runs_scored = 6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS match_sixes, MAX(CASE WHEN player_out_id = striker_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS is_out FROM Deliveries GROUP BY striker_id, match_id) SELECT p.player_name, SUM(pms.match_sixes) AS total_sixes, (SUM(pms.match_runs) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(pms.is_out), 0)) AS average, SUM(CASE WHEN pms.match_runs = 0 AND pms.is_out = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_ducks FROM PlayerMatchStats pms JOIN Players p ON pms.striker_id = p.player_id GROUP BY pms.striker_id, p.player_name HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN pms.match_runs >= 50 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 30 ORDER BY total_sixes DESC LIMIT 1;
generated_sql:
WITH innings_players AS (
  SELECT match_id, inning, striker_id AS player_id FROM Deliveries
  UNION
  SELECT match_id, inning, player_out_id AS player_id FROM Deliveries WHERE player_out_id IS NOT NULL
),
per_inning AS (
  SELECT ip.player_id, ip.match_id, ip.inning,
    COALESCE((SELECT SUM(d.runs_scored) FROM Deliveries d WHERE d.match_id = ip.match_id AND d.inning = ip.inning AND d.striker_id = ip.player_id), 0) AS runs,
    CASE WHEN EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM Deliveries d2
      WHERE d2.match_id = ip.match_id AND d2.inning = ip.inning
        AND d2.player_out_id = ip.player_id AND d2.wicket_type <> 'retired hurt'
    ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS dismissed
  FROM innings_players ip
),
player_agg AS (
  SELECT p.player_id, p.player_name,
    SUM(CASE WHEN pi.runs >= 50 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fifty_plus_count,
    SUM(pi.runs) AS total_runs,
    SUM(pi.dismissed) AS dismissals,
    SUM(CASE WHEN pi.dismissed = 1 AND pi.runs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_ducks,
    COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Deliveries d WHERE d.striker_id = p.player_id AND d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 AND d.runs_scored = 6), 0) AS total_sixes
  FROM Players p
  LEFT JOIN per_inning pi ON pi.player_id = p.player_id
  GROUP BY p.player_id
)
SELECT player_name AS player_name,
       total_sixes AS total_sixes,
       CASE WHEN dismissals = 0 THEN NULL ELSE ROUND(total_runs * 1.0 / dismissals, 2) END AS average,
       total_ducks AS total_ducks
FROM player_agg
WHERE fifty_plus_count >= 30
ORDER BY total_sixes DESC
LIMIT 1;

question: T20I ਇਤਿਹਾਸ ਵਿੱਚ, 30 ਜਾਂ ਵੱਧ ਅਰਧ-ਸੈਂਕੜੇ ਵਾਲੇ ਸਾਰੇ ਖਿਡਾਰੀਆਂ ਵਿੱਚੋਂ ਕਿਸਨੇ ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਵੱਧ ਛੱਕੇ ਮਾਰੇ ਹਨ, ਉਸਦੀ ਔਸਤ ਅਤੇ ਡੱਕ ਵੀ ਦੱਸੋ?
gold_sql: WITH PlayerMatchStats AS (SELECT striker_id, match_id, SUM(runs_scored) AS match_runs, SUM(CASE WHEN runs_scored = 6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS match_sixes, MAX(CASE WHEN player_out_id = striker_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS is_out FROM Deliveries GROUP BY striker_id, match_id) SELECT p.player_name, SUM(pms.match_sixes) AS total_sixes, (SUM(pms.match_runs) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(pms.is_out), 0)) AS average, SUM(CASE WHEN pms.match_runs = 0 AND pms.is_out = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_ducks FROM PlayerMatchStats pms JOIN Players p ON pms.striker_id = p.player_id GROUP BY pms.striker_id, p.player_name HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN pms.match_runs >= 50 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 30 ORDER BY total_sixes DESC LIMIT 1;
generated_sql:
WITH T20_deliveries AS (
  SELECT d.*
  FROM Deliveries d
  JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
  WHERE m.season = 'T20I'
),
batting_events AS (
  SELECT match_id, inning, striker_id AS player_id FROM T20_deliveries
  UNION
  SELECT match_id, inning, player_out_id AS player_id FROM T20_deliveries WHERE player_out_id IS NOT NULL
),
innings AS (
  SELECT be.match_id, be.inning, be.player_id,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN td.striker_id = be.player_id THEN td.runs_scored - td.extra_runs ELSE 0 END), 0) AS runs,
    MAX(CASE WHEN td.player_out_id = be.player_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS was_out
  FROM batting_events be
  JOIN T20_deliveries td ON td.match_id = be.match_id AND td.inning = be.inning
  GROUP BY be.match_id, be.inning, be.player_id
),
player_stats AS (
  SELECT i.player_id,
    SUM(CASE WHEN i.runs BETWEEN 50 AND 99 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS half_count,
    SUM(i.runs) AS total_runs,
    SUM(i.was_out) AS dismissals,
    SUM(CASE WHEN i.was_out = 1 AND i.runs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_ducks
  FROM innings i
  GROUP BY i.player_id
),
sixes AS (
  SELECT td.striker_id AS player_id, COUNT(*) AS total_sixes
  FROM T20_deliveries td
  WHERE td.wides = 0 AND td.noballs = 0 AND (td.runs_scored - td.extra_runs) = 6
  GROUP BY td.striker_id
)
SELECT p.player_name,
       COALESCE(s.total_sixes, 0) AS total_sixes,
       CASE WHEN ps.dismissals > 0 THEN CAST(ps.total_runs AS REAL) / ps.dismissals ELSE NULL END AS average,
       COALESCE(ps.total_ducks, 0) AS total_ducks
FROM Players p
JOIN player_stats ps ON p.player_id = ps.player_id
LEFT JOIN sixes s ON p.player_id = s.player_id
WHERE ps.half_count >= 30
  AND COALESCE(s.total_sixes, 0) = (
    SELECT MAX(COALESCE(sx.total_sixes, 0))
    FROM player_stats p2
    LEFT JOIN sixes sx ON p2.player_id = sx.player_id
    WHERE p2.half_count >= 30
  );

question: टी20I इतिहास में, 30 या उससे अधिक 50+ स्कोर वाले खिलाड़ियों में सबसे अधिक छक्के किस खिलाड़ी ने लगाए हैं, साथ ही उसका औसत और डक भी बताइए।
gold_sql: WITH PlayerMatchStats AS (SELECT striker_id, match_id, SUM(runs_scored) AS match_runs, SUM(CASE WHEN runs_scored = 6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS match_sixes, MAX(CASE WHEN player_out_id = striker_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS is_out FROM Deliveries GROUP BY striker_id, match_id) SELECT p.player_name, SUM(pms.match_sixes) AS total_sixes, (SUM(pms.match_runs) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(pms.is_out), 0)) AS average, SUM(CASE WHEN pms.match_runs = 0 AND pms.is_out = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_ducks FROM PlayerMatchStats pms JOIN Players p ON pms.striker_id = p.player_id GROUP BY pms.striker_id, p.player_name HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN pms.match_runs >= 50 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 30 ORDER BY total_sixes DESC LIMIT 1;
generated_sql:
WITH legal_deliveries AS (
  SELECT * FROM Deliveries WHERE wides = 0 AND noballs = 0
),
innings_runs AS (
  SELECT striker_id AS player_id, match_id, inning, SUM(runs_scored) AS runs_in_innings
  FROM legal_deliveries
  GROUP BY striker_id, match_id, inning
),
fifties AS (
  SELECT player_id, COUNT(*) AS fifty_count
  FROM innings_runs
  WHERE runs_in_innings >= 50
  GROUP BY player_id
),
total_sixes AS (
  SELECT striker_id AS player_id, COUNT(*) AS total_sixes
  FROM legal_deliveries
  WHERE runs_scored = 6
  GROUP BY striker_id
),
total_runs AS (
  SELECT striker_id AS player_id, SUM(runs_scored) AS total_runs
  FROM legal_deliveries
  GROUP BY striker_id
),
dismissals AS (
  SELECT player_out_id AS player_id, COUNT(*) AS dismissals
  FROM legal_deliveries
  WHERE player_out_id IS NOT NULL AND wicket_type != 'retired hurt'
  GROUP BY player_out_id
),
ducks AS (
  SELECT ir.player_id, COUNT(*) AS total_ducks
  FROM innings_runs ir
  JOIN legal_deliveries ld
    ON ir.player_id = ld.player_out_id
   AND ir.match_id = ld.match_id
   AND ir.inning = ld.inning
  WHERE ir.runs_in_innings = 0
    AND ld.player_out_id IS NOT NULL
    AND ld.wicket_type != 'retired hurt'
  GROUP BY ir.player_id
)
SELECT
  p.player_name AS player_name,
  COALESCE(ts.total_sixes, 0) AS total_sixes,
  CASE WHEN d.dismissals > 0 THEN ROUND(CAST(tr.total_runs AS REAL) / d.dismissals, 2) ELSE NULL END AS average,
  COALESCE(du.total_ducks, 0) AS total_ducks
FROM Players p
JOIN fifties f ON p.player_id = f.player_id AND f.fifty_count >= 30
LEFT JOIN total_sixes ts ON p.player_id = ts.player_id
LEFT JOIN total_runs tr ON p.player_id = tr.player_id
LEFT JOIN dismissals d ON p.player_id = d.player_id
LEFT JOIN ducks du ON p.player_id = du.player_id
ORDER BY total_sixes DESC
LIMIT 1;

question: Which bowler took consecutive four wicket hauls where both spells came in the first innings against the same opposition on consecutive days .Report his country, ratio of wickets to runs conceded, and opponents?
gold_sql: WITH BowlerStats AS (SELECT d.match_id, m.match_date, d.bowler_id, d.bowling_team, d.batting_team, SUM(CASE WHEN d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field', 'retired out') AND d.wicket_type IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wickets, SUM(d.runs_scored + d.wides + d.noballs) AS runs_conceded FROM Deliveries d JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id WHERE d.inning = 1 GROUP BY d.match_id, m.match_date, d.bowler_id, d.bowling_team, d.batting_team HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field', 'retired out') AND d.wicket_type IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 4) SELECT p.player_name, b1.bowling_team AS country, ((b1.wickets + b2.wickets) * 1.0 / NULLIF((b1.runs_conceded + b2.runs_conceded), 0)) AS wicket_to_runs_ratio, b1.batting_team AS opponents FROM BowlerStats b1 JOIN BowlerStats b2 ON b1.bowler_id = b2.bowler_id AND b1.batting_team = b2.batting_team AND date(b2.match_date) = date(b1.match_date, '+1 day') JOIN Players p ON b1.bowler_id = p.player_id;
generated_sql:
WITH bowler_innings AS (
  SELECT
    d.match_id,
    m.match_date,
    d.bowler_id,
    d.bowling_team,
    d.batting_team,
    SUM(CASE WHEN d.wicket_type IS NOT NULL AND d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out','retired hurt','obstructing the field') AND d.player_out_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wickets,
    SUM(d.runs_scored) AS runs_conceded
  FROM Deliveries d
  JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
  WHERE d.inning = 1
    AND d.wides = 0
    AND d.noballs = 0
  GROUP BY d.match_id, d.bowler_id, d.bowling_team, d.batting_team
),
four_wicket_innings AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM bowler_innings
  WHERE wickets >= 4
),
consecutive_pairs AS (
  SELECT
    f1.bowler_id,
    f1.match_id AS match1_id,
    f2.match_id AS match2_id,
    f1.match_date AS match1_date,
    f2.match_date AS match2_date,
    f1.batting_team AS opponents,
    f1.wickets AS w1,
    f2.wickets AS w2,
    f1.runs_conceded AS r1,
    f2.runs_conceded AS r2
  FROM four_wicket_innings f1
  JOIN four_wicket_innings f2
    ON f1.bowler_id = f2.bowler_id
   AND f1.batting_team = f2.batting_team
   AND julianday(f2.match_date) = julianday(f1.match_date) + 1
   AND julianday(f2.match_date) > julianday(f1.match_date)
)
SELECT
  p.player_name AS player_name,
  pim.team_name AS country,
  CAST((cp.w1 + cp.w2) AS REAL) / NULLIF((cp.r1 + cp.r2),0) AS wicket_to_runs_ratio,
  cp.opponents AS opponents
FROM consecutive_pairs cp
JOIN Players p ON p.player_id = cp.bowler_id
JOIN PlayerInMatch pim ON pim.match_id = cp.match1_id AND pim.player_id = cp.bowler_id
GROUP BY p.player_name, pim.team_name, cp.opponents, CAST((cp.w1 + cp.w2) AS REAL) / NULLIF((cp.r1 + cp.r2),0);

question: T20I ఇతిహాసలో 30+ యాభై కన్నా ఎక్కువ స్కోర్ ఉన్న క్రీడాకార్లలో ఎవరి దగ్గర అన్నిటికన్నా ఎక్కువ సిక్సులు ఉన్నాయి? అతన ఆవెరేజ్ మరియు డక్కూల సంఖ్య రాయండి.
gold_sql: WITH PlayerMatchStats AS (SELECT striker_id, match_id, SUM(runs_scored) AS match_runs, SUM(CASE WHEN runs_scored = 6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS match_sixes, MAX(CASE WHEN player_out_id = striker_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS is_out FROM Deliveries GROUP BY striker_id, match_id) SELECT p.player_name, SUM(pms.match_sixes) AS total_sixes, (SUM(pms.match_runs) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(pms.is_out), 0)) AS average, SUM(CASE WHEN pms.match_runs = 0 AND pms.is_out = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_ducks FROM PlayerMatchStats pms JOIN Players p ON pms.striker_id = p.player_id GROUP BY pms.striker_id, p.player_name HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN pms.match_runs >= 50 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 30 ORDER BY total_sixes DESC LIMIT 1;
generated_sql:
WITH innings AS (
  SELECT
    d.match_id,
    d.inning,
    d.striker_id AS player_id,
    SUM(d.runs_scored - d.extra_runs) AS innings_runs,
    SUM(CASE WHEN d.player_out_id = d.striker_id AND d.wicket_type IS NOT NULL AND d.wicket_type != 'retired hurt' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS was_out
  FROM Deliveries d
  JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
  WHERE m.season = 'T20I'
  GROUP BY d.match_id, d.inning, d.striker_id
),
player_stats AS (
  SELECT
    p.player_id,
    p.player_name,
    SUM(i.innings_runs) AS total_runs,
    SUM(CASE WHEN i.innings_runs >= 50 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fifties,
    SUM(CASE WHEN i.innings_runs = 0 AND i.was_out > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_ducks,
    SUM(i.was_out) AS dismissals
  FROM innings i
  JOIN Players p ON p.player_id = i.player_id
  GROUP BY p.player_id
),
sixes AS (
  SELECT
    d.striker_id AS player_id,
    SUM(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 AND (d.runs_scored - d.extra_runs) = 6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_sixes
  FROM Deliveries d
  JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
  WHERE m.season = 'T20I'
  GROUP BY d.striker_id
)
SELECT
  ps.player_name AS player_name,
  COALESCE(s.total_sixes, 0) AS total_sixes,
  (CAST(ps.total_runs AS REAL) / NULLIF(ps.dismissals, 0)) AS average,
  ps.total_ducks AS total_ducks
FROM player_stats ps
LEFT JOIN sixes s ON s.player_id = ps.player_id
WHERE ps.fifties >= 30
ORDER BY total_sixes DESC
LIMIT 1;

question: किस गेंदबाज़ ने लगातार चार-चार विकेट वाले स्पेल लिए, जहाँ दोनों स्पेल पहली पारी में, उसी विपक्ष के खिलाफ, लगातार दिनों में आए? उसका देश, लिए गए विकेट और दिए गए रन का अनुपात, तथा विपक्षी टीम बताइए।
gold_sql: WITH BowlerStats AS (SELECT d.match_id, m.match_date, d.bowler_id, d.bowling_team, d.batting_team, SUM(CASE WHEN d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field', 'retired out') AND d.wicket_type IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wickets, SUM(d.runs_scored + d.wides + d.noballs) AS runs_conceded FROM Deliveries d JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id WHERE d.inning = 1 GROUP BY d.match_id, m.match_date, d.bowler_id, d.bowling_team, d.batting_team HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field', 'retired out') AND d.wicket_type IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 4) SELECT p.player_name, b1.bowling_team AS country, ((b1.wickets + b2.wickets) * 1.0 / NULLIF((b1.runs_conceded + b2.runs_conceded), 0)) AS wicket_to_runs_ratio, b1.batting_team AS opponents FROM BowlerStats b1 JOIN BowlerStats b2 ON b1.bowler_id = b2.bowler_id AND b1.batting_team = b2.batting_team AND date(b2.match_date) = date(b1.match_date, '+1 day') JOIN Players p ON b1.bowler_id = p.player_id;

WITH bowler_match AS (

gold_sql: WITH BowlerStats AS (SELECT d.match_id, m.match_date, d.bowler_id, d.bowling_team, d.batting_team, SUM(CASE WHEN d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field', 'retired out') AND d.wicket_type IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wickets, SUM(d.runs_scored + d.wides + d.noballs) AS runs_conceded FROM Deliveries d JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id WHERE d.inning = 1 GROUP BY d.match_id, m.match_date, d.bowler_id, d.bowling_team, d.batting_team HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field', 'retired out') AND d.wicket_type IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 4) SELECT p.player_name, b1.bowling_team AS country, ((b1.wickets + b2.wickets) * 1.0 / NULLIF((b1.runs_conceded + b2.runs_conceded), 0)) AS wicket_to_runs_ratio, b1.batting_team AS opponents FROM BowlerStats b1 JOIN BowlerStats b2 ON b1.bowler_id = b2.bowler_id AND b1.batting_team = b2.batting_team AND date(b2.match_date) = date(b1.match_date, '+1 day') JOIN Players p ON b1.bowler_id = p.player_id;
generated_sql:
WITH per_match_bowler AS (
  SELECT
    d.match_id,
    d.bowler_id,
    m.match_date AS match_date,
    MAX(d.bowling_team) AS bowling_team,

question: In T20I career bowling history, which spinner has bowled the most balls despite never taking a five-wicket haul, name his country, wickets, economy?
gold_sql: WITH MatchWickets AS (SELECT match_id, bowler_id, bowling_team, SUM(CASE WHEN wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field', 'retired out') AND wicket_type IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS match_wkts, SUM(CASE WHEN wides = 0 AND noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS match_balls, SUM(runs_scored + wides + noballs) AS match_runs FROM Deliveries GROUP BY match_id, bowler_id, bowling_team) SELECT p.player_name, MAX(mw.bowling_team) AS country, SUM(mw.match_wkts) AS wickets, (SUM(mw.match_runs) * 6.0 / NULLIF(SUM(mw.match_balls), 0)) AS economy FROM MatchWickets mw JOIN Players p ON mw.bowler_id = p.player_id GROUP BY mw.bowler_id, p.player_name HAVING MAX(mw.match_wkts) < 5 ORDER BY SUM(mw.match_balls) DESC LIMIT 1;
generated_sql:
WITH spinner_ids AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT bowler_id AS player_id
  FROM Deliveries
  WHERE wicket_type = 'stumped' AND bowler_id IS NOT NULL
),
match_wickets AS (
  SELECT match_id, bowler_id,
    SUM(CASE WHEN wicket_type IS NOT NULL AND wicket_type NOT IN ('run out','retired hurt','obstructing the field') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS match_wickets
  FROM Deliveries
  GROUP BY match_id, bowler_id
),
bowler_stats AS (
  SELECT b.player_id,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS legal_balls,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d.wicket_type IS NOT NULL AND d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out','retired hurt','obstructing the field') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS total_wickets,
    COALESCE(SUM(d.runs_scored + d.wides + d.noballs), 0) AS runs_conceded,
    COALESCE((SELECT MAX(mw.match_wickets) FROM match_wickets mw WHERE mw.bowler_id = b.player_id), 0) AS max_wickets_in_match
  FROM (SELECT DISTINCT bowler_id AS player_id FROM Deliveries) b
  LEFT JOIN Deliveries d ON d.bowler_id = b.player_id
  GROUP BY b.player_id
),
spinner_stats AS (
  SELECT bs.*
  FROM bowler_stats bs
  JOIN spinner_ids s ON s.player_id = bs.player_id
  WHERE bs.max_wickets_in_match < 5 AND bs.legal_balls > 0
),
most_balls_spinner AS (
  SELECT player_id
  FROM spinner_stats
  ORDER BY legal_balls DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT pl.player_name AS player_name,
  (SELECT pim.team_name
   FROM PlayerInMatch pim
   WHERE pim.player_id = ms.player_id
   GROUP BY pim.team_name
   ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, pim.team_name ASC
   LIMIT 1) AS country,
  ss.total_wickets AS wickets,
  (ss.runs_conceded * 6.0 / ss.legal_balls) AS economy
FROM most_balls_spinner ms
JOIN spinner_stats ss ON ss.player_id = ms.player_id
JOIN Players pl ON pl.player_id = ss.player_id;

question: टी20I करियर गेंदबाज़ी इतिहास में, पांच विकेट हॉल कभी न लेने के बावजूद सबसे अधिक गेंदें किस स्पिनर ने फेंकी हैं, उसका देश, विकेट और इकॉनमी बताइए।
gold_sql: WITH MatchWickets AS (SELECT match_id, bowler_id, bowling_team, SUM(CASE WHEN wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field', 'retired out') AND wicket_type IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS match_wkts, SUM(CASE WHEN wides = 0 AND noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS match_balls, SUM(runs_scored + wides + noballs) AS match_runs FROM Deliveries GROUP BY match_id, bowler_id, bowling_team) SELECT p.player_name, MAX(mw.bowling_team) AS country, SUM(mw.match_wkts) AS wickets, (SUM(mw.match_runs) * 6.0 / NULLIF(SUM(mw.match_balls), 0)) AS economy FROM MatchWickets mw JOIN Players p ON mw.bowler_id = p.player_id GROUP BY mw.bowler_id, p.player_name HAVING MAX(mw.match_wkts) < 5 ORDER BY SUM(mw.match_balls) DESC LIMIT 1;
generated_sql:
WITH player_country AS (
  SELECT p.player_id,
         (SELECT pim.team_name
          FROM PlayerInMatch pim
          WHERE pim.player_id = p.player_id
          GROUP BY pim.team_name
          ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
          LIMIT 1) AS country
  FROM Players p
),
bowler_match_wkts AS (
  SELECT bowler_id, match_id,
         SUM(CASE WHEN wicket_type IS NOT NULL AND wicket_type NOT IN ('run out','retired hurt','obstructing the field') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wkts
  FROM Deliveries
  GROUP BY bowler_id, match_id
),
five_hauls AS (
  SELECT bowler_id, COUNT(*) AS five_haul_count
  FROM bowler_match_wkts
  WHERE wkts >= 5
  GROUP BY bowler_id
),
bowler_stats AS (
  SELECT d.bowler_id,
         SUM(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS legal_balls,
         SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) AS runs_conceded,
         SUM(CASE WHEN d.wicket_type IS NOT NULL AND d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out','retired hurt','obstructing the field') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wickets,
         SUM(CASE WHEN d.wicket_type = 'stumped' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stumpings
  FROM Deliveries d
  GROUP BY d.bowler_id
)
SELECT pl.player_name AS player_name,
       pc.country AS country,
       bs.wickets AS wickets,
       CASE WHEN bs.legal_balls > 0 THEN (CAST(COALESCE(bs.runs_conceded,0) AS REAL) * 6.0) / bs.legal_balls ELSE NULL END AS economy
FROM bowler_stats bs
JOIN Players pl ON pl.player_id = bs.bowler_id
LEFT JOIN player_country pc ON pc.player_id = pl.player_id
LEFT JOIN five_hauls fh ON fh.bowler_id = bs.bowler_id
WHERE bs.stumpings > 0
  AND (fh.five_haul_count IS NULL OR fh.five_haul_count = 0)
  AND bs.legal_balls > 0
ORDER BY bs.legal_balls DESC
LIMIT 1;

question: ఏ బౌలర్ వరుసగా 4 వికెట్లు తీసుకున్నాడు? రెండు స్పెల్స్ ఒకే టీం కి వ్యతిరేకంగా వరుస రోజుల్లో మొదటి ఇన్నింగ్స్లో వచ్చాయి. అతన దేశం, వికెట్లు/ఇచ్చిన పరుగుల రేషియో మరియు వ్యతిరేకమైన టీం రాయండి.
gold_sql: WITH BowlerStats AS (SELECT d.match_id, m.match_date, d.bowler_id, d.bowling_team, d.batting_team, SUM(CASE WHEN d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field', 'retired out') AND d.wicket_type IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wickets, SUM(d.runs_scored + d.wides + d.noballs) AS runs_conceded FROM Deliveries d JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id WHERE d.inning = 1 GROUP BY d.match_id, m.match_date, d.bowler_id, d.bowling_team, d.batting_team HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field', 'retired out') AND d.wicket_type IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 4) SELECT p.player_name, b1.bowling_team AS country, ((b1.wickets + b2.wickets) * 1.0 / NULLIF((b1.runs_conceded + b2.runs_conceded), 0)) AS wicket_to_runs_ratio, b1.batting_team AS opponents FROM BowlerStats b1 JOIN BowlerStats b2 ON b1.bowler_id = b2.bowler_id AND b1.batting_team = b2.batting_team AND date(b2.match_date) = date(b1.match_date, '+1 day') JOIN Players p ON b1.bowler_id = p.player_id;

WITH D AS (

),
W AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    LEAD(match_id,1) OVER (PARTITION BY bowler_id ORDER BY match_date, match_id, delivery_id) AS l1_match_id,
    LEAD(match_date,1) OVER (PARTITION BY bowler_id ORDER BY match_date, match_id, delivery_id) AS l1_date,
    LEAD(batting_team,1) OVER (PARTITION BY bowler_id ORDER BY match_date, match_id, delivery_id) AS l1_batting_team,
    LEAD(is_wicket,1) OVER (PARTITION BY bowler_id ORDER BY match_date, match_id, delivery_id) AS l1_wicket,
    LEAD(runs_scored,1) OVER (PARTITION BY bowler_id ORDER BY match_date, match_id, delivery_id) AS l1_runs,

    LEAD(is_wicket,2) OVER (PARTITION BY bowler_id ORDER BY match_date, match_id, delivery_id) AS l2_wicket,
    LEAD(runs_scored,2) OVER (PARTITION BY bowler_id ORDER BY match_date, match_id, delivery_id) AS l2_runs,
    LEAD(extra_runs,2) OVER (PARTITION BY bowler_id ORDER BY match_date, match_id, delivery_id) AS l2_extra,
    LEAD(match_id,3) OVER (PARTITION BY bowler_id ORDER BY match_date, match_id, delivery_id) AS l3_match_id,
    LEAD(match_date,3) OVER (PARTITION BY bowler_id ORDER BY match_date, match_id, delivery_id) AS l3_date,
    LEAD(batting_team,3) OVER (PARTITION BY bowler_id ORDER BY match_date, match_id, delivery_id) AS l3_batting_team,

question: T20I ਕਰੀਅਰ ਗੇਂਦਬਾਜ਼ੀ ਇਤਿਹਾਸ ਵਿੱਚ, ਕਿਹੜੇ ਸਪਿਨਰ ਨੇ ਕਦੇ ਪੰਜ ਵਿਕਟ ਹਾਲ ਨਾ ਲੈਂਦੇ ਹੋਏ ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਵੱਧ ਗੇਂਦਾਂ ਸੁੱਟੀਆਂ ਹਨ, ਉਸਦਾ ਦੇਸ਼, ਵਿਕਟਾਂ ਅਤੇ ਇਕਾਨਮੀ ਦੱਸੋ?
gold_sql: WITH MatchWickets AS (SELECT match_id, bowler_id, bowling_team, SUM(CASE WHEN wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field', 'retired out') AND wicket_type IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS match_wkts, SUM(CASE WHEN wides = 0 AND noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS match_balls, SUM(runs_scored + wides + noballs) AS match_runs FROM Deliveries GROUP BY match_id, bowler_id, bowling_team) SELECT p.player_name, MAX(mw.bowling_team) AS country, SUM(mw.match_wkts) AS wickets, (SUM(mw.match_runs) * 6.0 / NULLIF(SUM(mw.match_balls), 0)) AS economy FROM MatchWickets mw JOIN Players p ON mw.bowler_id = p.player_id GROUP BY mw.bowler_id, p.player_name HAVING MAX(mw.match_wkts) < 5 ORDER BY SUM(mw.match_balls) DESC LIMIT 1;
generated_sql:
WITH bowler_match_wickets AS (
  SELECT bowler_id, match_id, COUNT(*) AS wickets_in_match
  FROM Deliveries
  WHERE player_out_id IS NOT NULL
    AND wicket_type NOT IN ('run out','retired hurt','obstructing the field')
  GROUP BY bowler_id, match_id
),
player_max_wickets AS (
  SELECT bowler_id AS player_id, MAX(wickets_in_match) AS max_wickets
  FROM bowler_match_wickets
  GROUP BY bowler_id
),
career AS (
  SELECT d.bowler_id AS player_id,
         SUM(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS balls,
         SUM(CASE WHEN d.player_out_id IS NOT NULL AND d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out','retired hurt','obstructing the field') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wickets,
         SUM(d.runs_scored + d.wides + d.noballs) AS runs_conceded
  FROM Deliveries d
  GROUP BY d.bowler_id
),
country AS (
  SELECT p.player_id,
         (SELECT pim.team_name
          FROM PlayerInMatch pim
          WHERE pim.player_id = p.player_id
          GROUP BY pim.team_name
          ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, pim.team_name ASC
          LIMIT 1) AS country
  FROM Players p
)
SELECT pl.player_name AS player_name,
       co.country AS country,
       ca.wickets AS wickets,
       (CAST(ca.runs_conceded AS REAL) * 6.0) / ca.balls AS economy
FROM career ca
JOIN Players pl ON pl.player_id = ca.player_id
LEFT JOIN player_max_wickets pm ON pm.player_id = ca.player_id
LEFT JOIN country co ON co.player_id = ca.player_id
WHERE COALESCE(pm.max_wickets, 0) < 5
  AND ca.balls > 0
ORDER BY ca.balls DESC
LIMIT 1;

question: सीज़न 2026 में 100 से अधिक गेंदें फेंकने वाले बांग्लादेशी गेंदबाज़ों में सबसे अधिक 3+ विकेट हॉल किसने लिए हैं? उसकी इकॉनमी, विकेट, और कुल 3+ विकेट हॉल बताइए।
gold_sql: WITH BowlerMatchStats AS (SELECT d.bowler_id, d.match_id, SUM(CASE WHEN d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field', 'retired out') AND d.wicket_type IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS match_wkts, SUM(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS match_balls, SUM(d.runs_scored + d.wides + d.noballs) AS match_runs FROM Deliveries d JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id WHERE d.bowling_team = 'Bangladesh' AND m.season = '2026' GROUP BY d.bowler_id, d.match_id) SELECT p.player_name, (SUM(bms.match_runs) * 6.0 / NULLIF(SUM(bms.match_balls), 0)) AS economy, SUM(bms.match_wkts) AS wickets, SUM(CASE WHEN bms.match_wkts >= 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS three_wicket_hauls FROM BowlerMatchStats bms JOIN Players p ON bms.bowler_id = p.player_id GROUP BY bms.bowler_id, p.player_name HAVING SUM(bms.match_balls) >= 100 ORDER BY three_wicket_hauls DESC LIMIT 1;
generated_sql:
WITH del AS (
  SELECT d.*, m.season
  FROM Deliveries d
  JOIN Matches m ON m.match_id = d.match_id
  WHERE m.season = '2026' AND d.bowling_team = 'Bangladesh'
),
agg AS (
  SELECT
    bowler_id,
    SUM(CASE WHEN wides = 0 AND noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS legal_balls,
    SUM(runs_scored + extra_runs) AS runs_conceded,
    SUM(CASE WHEN wicket_type IS NOT NULL AND wicket_type NOT IN ('run out','retired hurt','obstructing the field') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wickets
  FROM del
  GROUP BY bowler_id
),
innings AS (
  SELECT bowler_id, match_id, inning,
    SUM(CASE WHEN wicket_type IS NOT NULL AND wicket_type NOT IN ('run out','retired hurt','obstructing the field') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wickets_in_inning
  FROM del
  GROUP BY bowler_id, match_id, inning
),
three AS (
  SELECT bowler_id, COUNT(*) AS three_wicket_hauls
  FROM innings
  WHERE wickets_in_inning >= 3
  GROUP BY bowler_id
),
combined AS (
  SELECT a.bowler_id, a.legal_balls, a.runs_conceded, a.wickets, COALESCE(t.three_wicket_hauls,0) AS three_wicket_hauls
  FROM agg a
  LEFT JOIN three t ON t.bowler_id = a.bowler_id
  WHERE a.legal_balls > 100
),
max_three AS (
  SELECT MAX(three_wicket_hauls) AS max_three FROM combined
)
SELECT p.player_name AS player_name,
       ROUND((c.runs_conceded * 6.0) / c.legal_balls, 2) AS economy,
       c.wickets AS wickets,
       c.three_wicket_hauls AS three_wicket_hauls
FROM combined c
JOIN Players p ON p.player_id = c.bowler_id
JOIN max_three m ON c.three_wicket_hauls = m.max_three
ORDER BY p.player_name;

question: Which Bangladeshi bowler has taken the most 3+ wicket hauls with 100+ balls in season 2026. Report his economy, wickets, and how many 3+ wicket hauls does he have
gold_sql: WITH BowlerMatchStats AS (SELECT d.bowler_id, d.match_id, SUM(CASE WHEN d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field', 'retired out') AND d.wicket_type IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS match_wkts, SUM(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS match_balls, SUM(d.runs_scored + d.wides + d.noballs) AS match_runs FROM Deliveries d JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id WHERE d.bowling_team = 'Bangladesh' AND m.season = '2026' GROUP BY d.bowler_id, d.match_id) SELECT p.player_name, (SUM(bms.match_runs) * 6.0 / NULLIF(SUM(bms.match_balls), 0)) AS economy, SUM(bms.match_wkts) AS wickets, SUM(CASE WHEN bms.match_wkts >= 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS three_wicket_hauls FROM BowlerMatchStats bms JOIN Players p ON bms.bowler_id = p.player_id GROUP BY bms.bowler_id, p.player_name HAVING SUM(bms.match_balls) >= 100 ORDER BY three_wicket_hauls DESC LIMIT 1;
generated_sql:
WITH season_matches AS (
  SELECT match_id FROM Matches WHERE season = '2026'
),
legal_deliveries AS (
  SELECT d.*
  FROM Deliveries d
  JOIN season_matches sm ON d.match_id = sm.match_id
  WHERE d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0
),
bangla_players AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT pim.player_id
  FROM PlayerInMatch pim
  JOIN season_matches sm ON pim.match_id = sm.match_id
  WHERE pim.team_name = 'Bangladesh'
),
player_match_wk AS (
  SELECT
    bowler_id AS player_id,
    match_id,
    SUM(
      CASE
        WHEN player_out_id IS NOT NULL
         AND (wicket_type NOT IN ('run out','retired hurt','obstructing the field'))
        THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
    ) AS wickets_in_match
  FROM legal_deliveries
  GROUP BY bowler_id, match_id
),
three_hauls AS (
  SELECT player_id, COUNT(*) AS three_wicket_hauls
  FROM player_match_wk
  WHERE wickets_in_match >= 3
  GROUP BY player_id
),
season_stats AS (
  SELECT
    d.bowler_id AS player_id,
    COUNT(*) AS balls,
    SUM(d.runs_scored) AS runs_conceded,
    SUM(
      CASE
        WHEN d.player_out_id IS NOT NULL
         AND (d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out','retired hurt','obstructing the field'))
        THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
    ) AS wickets
  FROM legal_deliveries d
  GROUP BY d.bowler_id
),
combined AS (
  SELECT s.player_id, pl.player_name, s.balls, s.runs_conceded, s.wickets,
         COALESCE(t.three_wicket_hauls, 0) AS three_wicket_hauls
  FROM season_stats s
  JOIN bangla_players bp ON bp.player_id = s.player_id
  LEFT JOIN three_hauls t ON t.player_id = s.player_id
  JOIN Players pl ON pl.player_id = s.player_id
  WHERE s.balls >= 100
)
SELECT
  player_name AS player_name,
  (CAST(runs_conceded AS REAL) * 6.0 / CAST(balls AS REAL)) AS economy,
  wickets AS wickets,
  three_wicket_hauls AS three_wicket_hauls
FROM combined
ORDER BY three_wicket_hauls DESC, wickets DESC
LIMIT 1;

question: T20I బౌలింగ్ ఇతిహాసలో ఏ స్పిన్నర్ ఒక ఇన్నింగ్స్లో 5 వికెట్లు తీసుకోకుండా అన్నిటికన్నా ఎక్కువ బంతులు విసిరాడు? అతన దేశం, వికెట్ల సంఖ్య మరియు ఎకానమీ రాయండి.
gold_sql: WITH MatchWickets AS (SELECT match_id, bowler_id, bowling_team, SUM(CASE WHEN wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field', 'retired out') AND wicket_type IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS match_wkts, SUM(CASE WHEN wides = 0 AND noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS match_balls, SUM(runs_scored + wides + noballs) AS match_runs FROM Deliveries GROUP BY match_id, bowler_id, bowling_team) SELECT p.player_name, MAX(mw.bowling_team) AS country, SUM(mw.match_wkts) AS wickets, (SUM(mw.match_runs) * 6.0 / NULLIF(SUM(mw.match_balls), 0)) AS economy FROM MatchWickets mw JOIN Players p ON mw.bowler_id = p.player_id GROUP BY mw.bowler_id, p.player_name HAVING MAX(mw.match_wkts) < 5 ORDER BY SUM(mw.match_balls) DESC LIMIT 1;
generated_sql:
WITH innings_stats AS (
  SELECT
    match_id,
    inning,
    bowler_id,
    COUNT(*) AS balls,
    SUM(CASE WHEN player_out_id IS NOT NULL AND wicket_type NOT IN ('run out','retired hurt','obstructing the field') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wickets,
    SUM(runs_scored + extra_runs) AS runs
  FROM Deliveries
  WHERE wides = 0 AND noballs = 0 AND over_number <= 20
  GROUP BY match_id, inning, bowler_id
),
player_country AS (
  SELECT pim.player_id, pim.team_name AS country
  FROM PlayerInMatch pim
  GROUP BY pim.player_id, pim.team_name
  HAVING COUNT(*) = (
    SELECT MAX(cnt) FROM (
      SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt
      FROM PlayerInMatch pim2
      WHERE pim2.player_id = pim.player_id
      GROUP BY pim2.team_name
    )
  )
)
SELECT
  p.player_name AS player_name,
  pc.country AS country,
  s.wickets AS wickets,
  CASE WHEN s.balls > 0 THEN (s.runs * 6.0) / s.balls ELSE NULL END AS economy
FROM innings_stats s
JOIN Players p ON p.player_id = s.bowler_id
LEFT JOIN player_country pc ON pc.player_id = s.bowler_id
WHERE s.wickets < 5
  AND (
    lower(p.player_name) LIKE '%spin%' OR
    lower(p.player_name) LIKE '%googly%' OR
    lower(p.player_name) LIKE '%chinaman%' OR
    lower(p.player_name) LIKE '%arm%' OR
    lower(p.player_name) LIKE '%slow%' OR
    lower(p.player_name) LIKE '%off%'
  )
ORDER BY s.balls DESC
LIMIT 1;

question: New Zealand and India tied in T20Is on consecutive days. Give the dates and venues of the matches.
gold_sql: WITH NZ_IND_Ties AS (SELECT match_date, venue FROM Matches WHERE ((team1 = 'New Zealand' AND team2 = 'India') OR (team1 = 'India' AND team2 = 'New Zealand')) AND result_type = 'tie') SELECT t1.match_date AS date1, t1.venue AS venue1, t2.match_date AS date2, t2.venue AS venue2 FROM NZ_IND_Ties t1 JOIN NZ_IND_Ties t2 ON date(t2.match_date) = date(t1.match_date, '+2 day');

FROM Matches m1
JOIN Matches m2 ON date(m2.match_date) = date(m1.match_date, '+1 day')
WHERE m1.match_id <> m2.match_id
  AND ((m1.team1 = 'New Zealand' AND m1.team2 = 'India') OR (m1.team1 = 'India' AND m1.team2 = 'New Zealand'))
  AND ((m2.team1 = 'New Zealand' AND m2.team2 = 'India') OR (m2.team1 = 'India' AND m2.team2 = 'New Zealand'))
  AND lower(m1.result_type) LIKE '%tie%'
  AND lower(m2.result_type) LIKE '%tie%'
ORDER BY date1;

gold_sql: WITH BowlerMatchStats AS (SELECT d.bowler_id, d.match_id, SUM(CASE WHEN d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field', 'retired out') AND d.wicket_type IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS match_wkts, SUM(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS match_balls, SUM(d.runs_scored + d.wides + d.noballs) AS match_runs FROM Deliveries d JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id WHERE d.bowling_team = 'Bangladesh' AND m.season = '2026' GROUP BY d.bowler_id, d.match_id) SELECT p.player_name, (SUM(bms.match_runs) * 6.0 / NULLIF(SUM(bms.match_balls), 0)) AS economy, SUM(bms.match_wkts) AS wickets, SUM(CASE WHEN bms.match_wkts >= 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS three_wicket_hauls FROM BowlerMatchStats bms JOIN Players p ON bms.bowler_id = p.player_id GROUP BY bms.bowler_id, p.player_name HAVING SUM(bms.match_balls) >= 100 ORDER BY three_wicket_hauls DESC LIMIT 1;
generated_sql:
WITH bangla_players AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT PIM.player_id
  FROM PlayerInMatch PIM
  JOIN Matches M ON PIM.match_id = M.match_id
  WHERE PIM.team_name = 'Bangladesh' AND M.season = '2026'
),
bowler_stats AS (
  SELECT
    D.bowler_id AS player_id,
    SUM(D.runs_scored + D.wides + D.noballs) AS runs_conceded,
    SUM(CASE WHEN D.wides = 0 AND D.noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS legal_balls,
    SUM(CASE
          WHEN D.wicket_type IS NOT NULL
           AND D.player_out_id IS NOT NULL
           AND D.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out','retired hurt','obstructing the field')
           AND D.wides = 0
           AND D.noballs = 0
          THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wickets
  FROM Deliveries D
  JOIN Matches M ON D.match_id = M.match_id
  WHERE M.season = '2026' AND D.bowler_id IN (SELECT player_id FROM bangla_players)
  GROUP BY D.bowler_id
),
three_hauls AS (
  SELECT
    s.bowler_id AS player_id,
    SUM(CASE WHEN s.wicket_count >= 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS three_wicket_hauls
  FROM (
    SELECT
      D.bowler_id,
      D.match_id,
      D.inning,
      SUM(CASE
            WHEN D.wicket_type IS NOT NULL
             AND D.player_out_id IS NOT NULL
             AND D.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out','retired hurt','obstructing the field')
             AND D.wides = 0
             AND D.noballs = 0
            THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wicket_count
    FROM Deliveries D
    JOIN Matches M ON D.match_id = M.match_id
    WHERE M.season = '2026' AND D.bowler_id IN (SELECT player_id FROM bangla_players)
    GROUP BY D.bowler_id, D.match_id, D.inning
  ) s
  GROUP BY s.bowler_id
)
SELECT
  P.player_name AS player_name,
  (bs.runs_conceded * 6.0) / bs.legal_balls AS economy,
  bs.wickets AS wickets,
  COALESCE(th.three_wicket_hauls, 0) AS three_wicket_hauls
FROM bowler_stats bs
JOIN Players P ON bs.player_id = P.player_id
LEFT JOIN three_hauls th ON bs.player_id = th.player_id
WHERE bs.legal_balls >= 100
ORDER BY three_wicket_hauls DESC, bs.wickets DESC, economy ASC
LIMIT 1;

question: टी20I इतिहास में, आखिरी गेंद पर सबसे बड़ा लक्ष्य किस टीम ने सफलतापूर्वक हासिल किया? टीम का नाम, लक्ष्य, विपक्षी टीम, जीत का अंतर, और तारीख बताइए।
gold_sql: WITH InningStats AS (SELECT match_id, inning, batting_team, bowling_team, SUM(runs_scored + extra_runs) AS total_runs, SUM(CASE WHEN wides = 0 AND noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS legal_balls FROM Deliveries GROUP BY match_id, inning, batting_team, bowling_team) SELECT i2.batting_team AS team_name, (i1.total_runs + 1) AS target, i2.bowling_team AS opponents, m.result_margin, m.match_date FROM InningStats i1 JOIN InningStats i2 ON i1.match_id = i2.match_id AND i1.inning = 1 AND i2.inning = 2 JOIN Matches m ON i1.match_id = m.match_id WHERE m.match_winner = i2.batting_team AND i2.legal_balls = 120 ORDER BY target DESC LIMIT 1;
generated_sql:
WITH inning1 AS (
  SELECT match_id, SUM(runs_scored + extra_runs) AS inning1_runs
  FROM Deliveries
  WHERE inning = 1
  GROUP BY match_id
),
winning_deliveries AS (
  SELECT d.match_id, d.over_number, d.ball_number, d.batting_team
  FROM Deliveries d
  JOIN Matches m ON m.match_id = d.match_id
  WHERE d.inning = 2
    AND d.wides = 0
    AND d.noballs = 0
    AND m.match_winner = d.batting_team
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM Deliveries d2
      WHERE d2.match_id = d.match_id
        AND d2.inning = 2
        AND d2.wides = 0
        AND d2.noballs = 0
        AND (d2.over_number > d.over_number OR (d2.over_number = d.over_number AND d2.ball_number > d.ball_number))
    )
),
winning_on_last AS (
  SELECT wd.match_id, wd.batting_team,
    (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(runs_scored + extra_runs),0)
     FROM Deliveries d3
     WHERE d3.match_id = wd.match_id
       AND d3.inning = 2
       AND d3.wides = 0
       AND d3.noballs = 0
       AND (d3.over_number < wd.over_number OR (d3.over_number = wd.over_number AND d3.ball_number < wd.ball_number))
    ) AS cumulative_before,
    (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(runs_scored + extra_runs),0)
     FROM Deliveries d4
     WHERE d4.match_id = wd.match_id
       AND d4.inning = 2
       AND d4.wides = 0
       AND d4.noballs = 0
       AND (d4.over_number < wd.over_number OR (d4.over_number = wd.over_number AND d4.ball_number <= wd.ball_number))
    ) AS cumulative_after
  FROM winning_deliveries wd
),
candidates AS (
  SELECT w.match_id, w.batting_team AS team_name, (i.inning1_runs + 1) AS target
  FROM winning_on_last w
  JOIN inning1 i ON i.match_id = w.match_id
  WHERE w.cumulative_before < (i.inning1_runs + 1)
    AND w.cumulative_after >= (i.inning1_runs + 1)
),
max_target AS (
  SELECT MAX(target) AS max_target FROM candidates
)
SELECT c.team_name AS team_name,
       c.target AS target,
       CASE WHEN c.team_name = m.team1 THEN m.team2 ELSE m.team1 END AS opponents,
       m.result_margin AS result_margin,
       m.match_date AS match_date
FROM candidates c
JOIN Matches m ON m.match_id = c.match_id
JOIN max_target mt ON c.target = mt.max_target;

question: In T20I history, which team chased the highest ever target on the last ball.Give their name their target, opponents, margin of victory, and date?
gold_sql: WITH InningStats AS (SELECT match_id, inning, batting_team, bowling_team, SUM(runs_scored + extra_runs) AS total_runs, SUM(CASE WHEN wides = 0 AND noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS legal_balls FROM Deliveries GROUP BY match_id, inning, batting_team, bowling_team) SELECT i2.batting_team AS team_name, (i1.total_runs + 1) AS target, i2.bowling_team AS opponents, m.result_margin, m.match_date FROM InningStats i1 JOIN InningStats i2 ON i1.match_id = i2.match_id AND i1.inning = 1 AND i2.inning = 2 JOIN Matches m ON i1.match_id = m.match_id WHERE m.match_winner = i2.batting_team AND i2.legal_balls = 120 ORDER BY target DESC LIMIT 1;

WITH inning1 AS (
  SELECT match_id, SUM(runs_scored + extra_runs) AS inning1_total
  FROM Deliveries
  WHERE inning = 1
  GROUP BY match_id
),
inning2 AS (
  SELECT match_id, SUM(runs_scored + extra_runs) AS inning2_total
  FROM Deliveries
  WHERE inning = 2
  GROUP BY match_id
),
max_over AS (
  SELECT match_id,
    MAX(CASE WHEN inning = 1 THEN over_number END) AS max_over1,
    MAX(CASE WHEN inning = 2 THEN over_number END) AS max_over2
  FROM Deliveries
  GROUP BY match_id
),
last_legal AS (
  SELECT match_id, MAX(delivery_id) AS last_delivery_id
  FROM Deliveries
  WHERE inning = 2 AND wides = 0 AND noballs = 0

)
SELECT
  d.batting_team AS team_name,
  (i1.inning1_total + 1) AS target,
  CASE WHEN Matches.team1 = d.batting_team THEN Matches.team2 ELSE Matches.team1 END AS opponents,
  Matches.result_margin AS result_margin,
  Matches.match_date AS match_date
FROM last_legal ll
JOIN Deliveries d ON d.delivery_id = ll.last_delivery_id
JOIN Matches ON Matches.match_id = ll.match_id
JOIN inning1 i1 ON i1.match_id = ll.match_id
JOIN inning2 i2 ON i2.match_id = ll.match_id
JOIN max_over mo ON mo.match_id = ll.match_id
WHERE Matches.match_winner = d.batting_team
  AND i2.inning2_total = i1.inning1_total + 1
  AND (mo.max_over1 IS NULL OR mo.max_over1 <= 20)
  AND (mo.max_over2 IS NULL OR mo.max_over2 <= 20)
ORDER BY target DESC
LIMIT 1;

gold_sql: WITH InningStats AS (SELECT match_id, inning, batting_team, bowling_team, SUM(runs_scored + extra_runs) AS total_runs, SUM(CASE WHEN wides = 0 AND noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS legal_balls FROM Deliveries GROUP BY match_id, inning, batting_team, bowling_team) SELECT i2.batting_team AS team_name, (i1.total_runs + 1) AS target, i2.bowling_team AS opponents, m.result_margin, m.match_date FROM InningStats i1 JOIN InningStats i2 ON i1.match_id = i2.match_id AND i1.inning = 1 AND i2.inning = 2 JOIN Matches m ON i1.match_id = m.match_id WHERE m.match_winner = i2.batting_team AND i2.legal_balls = 120 ORDER BY target DESC LIMIT 1;

gold_sql: WITH InningStats AS (SELECT match_id, inning, batting_team, bowling_team, SUM(runs_scored + extra_runs) AS total_runs, SUM(CASE WHEN wides = 0 AND noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS legal_balls FROM Deliveries GROUP BY match_id, inning, batting_team, bowling_team) SELECT i2.batting_team AS team_name, (i1.total_runs + 1) AS target, i2.bowling_team AS opponents, m.result_margin, m.match_date FROM InningStats i1 JOIN InningStats i2 ON i1.match_id = i2.match_id AND i1.inning = 1 AND i2.inning = 2 JOIN Matches m ON i1.match_id = m.match_id WHERE m.match_winner = i2.batting_team AND i2.legal_balls = 120 ORDER BY target DESC LIMIT 1;

question: Name the only last-ball T20I win completed in just 5 overs. State the winner, opposition, target and margin?
gold_sql: WITH MatchLengths AS (SELECT match_id, SUM(CASE WHEN wides = 0 AND noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS legal_balls_inn2 FROM Deliveries WHERE inning = 2 GROUP BY match_id), FirstInningScore AS (SELECT match_id, SUM(runs_scored + extra_runs) AS inn1_runs FROM Deliveries WHERE inning = 1 GROUP BY match_id) SELECT m.match_winner AS winner, CASE WHEN m.team1 = m.match_winner THEN m.team2 ELSE m.team1 END AS opposition, f.inn1_runs + 1 AS target, m.result_margin || ' ' || m.result_type AS margin, m.match_date FROM Matches m JOIN MatchLengths ml ON m.match_id = ml.match_id JOIN FirstInningScore f ON m.match_id = f.match_id WHERE ml.legal_balls_inn2 = 30 AND m.match_winner IS NOT NULL AND m.result_type = 'wickets' ORDER BY m.match_date DESC LIMIT 1;
generated_sql:
SELECT
  m.match_winner AS winner,
  CASE WHEN m.match_winner = m.team1 THEN m.team2 ELSE m.team1 END AS opposition,
  (fi.total + 1) AS target,
  m.result_margin AS margin,
  m.match_date AS match_date
FROM Matches m
JOIN (
  SELECT match_id, COALESCE(SUM(runs_scored + extra_runs),0) AS total
  FROM Deliveries
  WHERE inning = 1
  GROUP BY match_id
) fi ON fi.match_id = m.match_id
JOIN (
  SELECT d.match_id, MAX(d.over_number) AS last_over
  FROM Deliveries d
  WHERE d.inning = 2 AND d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0
  GROUP BY d.match_id
) lo ON lo.match_id = m.match_id
JOIN (
  SELECT d.match_id, d.over_number, MAX(d.ball_number) AS last_ball
  FROM Deliveries d
  WHERE d.inning = 2 AND d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0
  GROUP BY d.match_id, d.over_number
) lb ON lb.match_id = m.match_id AND lb.over_number = lo.last_over
WHERE m.match_winner IS NOT NULL
  AND lo.last_over = 5
  AND lb.last_ball = 6
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM Deliveries d
    WHERE d.match_id = m.match_id
      AND d.inning = 2
      AND d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0
      AND d.over_number = lo.last_over
      AND d.ball_number = lb.last_ball
      AND d.batting_team = m.match_winner
  )
  AND (
    (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(runs_scored + extra_runs),0)
     FROM Deliveries d
     WHERE d.match_id = m.match_id
       AND d.inning = 2
       AND d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0
       AND (d.over_number < lo.last_over OR (d.over_number = lo.last_over AND d.ball_number <= lb.last_ball))
    ) >= (fi.total + 1)
  )
  AND (

question: ਉਸ ਇੱਕਮਾਤਰ T20I ਜਿੱਤ ਦਾ ਨਾਮ ਦੱਸੋ ਜੋ ਆਖਰੀ ਗੇਂਦ 'ਤੇ ਸਿਰਫ਼ 5 ਓਵਰਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਪੂਰੀ ਹੋਈ। ਜੇਤੂ ਟੀਮ, ਵਿਰੋਧੀ ਟੀਮ, ਟੀਚਾ ਅਤੇ ਜਿੱਤ ਦਾ ਫ਼ਰਕ ਦੱਸੋ?
gold_sql: WITH MatchLengths AS (SELECT match_id, SUM(CASE WHEN wides = 0 AND noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS legal_balls_inn2 FROM Deliveries WHERE inning = 2 GROUP BY match_id), FirstInningScore AS (SELECT match_id, SUM(runs_scored + extra_runs) AS inn1_runs FROM Deliveries WHERE inning = 1 GROUP BY match_id) SELECT m.match_winner AS winner, CASE WHEN m.team1 = m.match_winner THEN m.team2 ELSE m.team1 END AS opposition, f.inn1_runs + 1 AS target, m.result_margin || ' ' || m.result_type AS margin, m.match_date FROM Matches m JOIN MatchLengths ml ON m.match_id = ml.match_id JOIN FirstInningScore f ON m.match_id = f.match_id WHERE ml.legal_balls_inn2 = 30 AND m.match_winner IS NOT NULL AND m.result_type = 'wickets' ORDER BY m.match_date DESC LIMIT 1;
generated_sql:
WITH first_innings AS (
  SELECT match_id, SUM(runs_scored + extra_runs) AS first_total
  FROM Deliveries
  WHERE inning = 1
  GROUP BY match_id
),
inning2 AS (
  SELECT d.*,
         (runs_scored + extra_runs) AS this_runs,
         SUM(runs_scored + extra_runs) OVER (PARTITION BY match_id, inning ORDER BY over_number, ball_number ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cum_runs
  FROM Deliveries d
  WHERE inning = 2
)
SELECT m.match_winner AS winner,
       CASE WHEN m.match_winner = m.team1 THEN m.team2 ELSE m.team1 END AS opposition,
       fi.first_total + 1 AS target,
       m.result_margin AS margin,
       m.match_date AS match_date
FROM inning2 d
JOIN first_innings fi ON d.match_id = fi.match_id
JOIN Matches m ON m.match_id = d.match_id
WHERE d.cum_runs >= fi.first_total + 1
  AND (d.cum_runs - d.this_runs) < fi.first_total + 1
  AND d.over_number = 5
  AND d.ball_number = 6
  AND d.wides = 0
  AND d.noballs = 0
  AND m.stage = 'T20I'
  AND m.match_winner IS NOT NULL;

  innings.score * 1.0 / innings.wickets AS batting_average
FROM (

question: Canada ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਵੱਧ ਬੱਲੇਬਾਜ਼ੀ ਔਸਤ ਰਿਕਾਰਡਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਦੋ ਵਾਰ ਆਉਂਦਾ ਹੈ। ਦੋਵੇਂ ਵਿਰੋਧੀ ਟੀਮਾਂ, ਔਸਤਾਂ ਅਤੇ ਸਕੋਰ ਦੱਸੋ?
gold_sql: SELECT d.bowling_team AS opponent, (SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN d.wicket_type IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0)) AS average, SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) AS score FROM Deliveries d WHERE d.batting_team = 'Canada' GROUP BY d.match_id, d.bowling_team ORDER BY average DESC LIMIT 2;
generated_sql:

  CASE WHEN m.team1 = 'Canada' THEN m.team2 ELSE m.team1 END AS opponent,
  agg.average AS average,
  agg.total_runs AS score
FROM (
  SELECT
    d.match_id,
    d.inning,
    SUM(runs_scored + extra_runs) AS total_runs,
    SUM(CASE WHEN player_out_id IS NOT NULL AND wicket_type NOT IN ('run out','retired hurt','obstructing the field') AND wides = 0 AND noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wickets,
    CASE
      WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN player_out_id IS NOT NULL AND wicket_type NOT IN ('run out','retired hurt','obstructing the field') AND wides = 0 AND noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0
        THEN SUM(runs_scored + extra_runs)
      ELSE CAST(SUM(runs_scored + extra_runs) AS REAL) / SUM(CASE WHEN player_out_id IS NOT NULL AND wicket_type NOT IN ('run out','retired hurt','obstructing the field') AND wides = 0 AND noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
    END AS average
  FROM Deliveries d
  WHERE d.batting_team = 'Canada'
  GROUP BY d.match_id, d.inning
) AS agg
JOIN Matches m ON m.match_id = agg.match_id
ORDER BY agg.average DESC, agg.total_runs DESC
LIMIT 2;

question: Canada appears twice in highest batting average records. Name both opponents, averages and scores?

    d.inning,
    d.batting_team,

question: Which team achieved an average of 200 in T20I history in just 14.1 overs. Name their opposition and score
gold_sql: SELECT d.batting_team, d.bowling_team AS opposition, SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) AS score FROM Deliveries d GROUP BY d.match_id, d.batting_team, d.bowling_team HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 85 AND (SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN d.wicket_type IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0)) = 200;

WITH cum AS (
  SELECT
    match_id,
    inning,
    over_number,
    ball_number,
    batting_team,
    bowling_team,
    runs_scored,
    extra_runs,
    wides,
    noballs,
    delivery_id,
    SUM(runs_scored + extra_runs) OVER (
      PARTITION BY match_id, inning
      ORDER BY over_number, ball_number, delivery_id
      ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) AS cum_runs
  FROM Deliveries
),

  FROM cum
  WHERE over_number = 15
    AND ball_number = 1

    AND noballs = 0

)

  r.bowling_team AS opposition,

question: टी20I इतिहास में सिर्फ 14.1 ओवर में 200 का औसत किस टीम ने हासिल किया? उसकी विपक्षी टीम और स्कोर बताइए।
gold_sql: SELECT d.batting_team, d.bowling_team AS opposition, SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) AS score FROM Deliveries d GROUP BY d.match_id, d.batting_team, d.bowling_team HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 85 AND (SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN d.wicket_type IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0)) = 200;
generated_sql:
WITH legal AS (
  SELECT
    d.match_id,
    d.inning,
    d.batting_team,
    d.over_number,
    d.ball_number,
    d.delivery_id,
    SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) OVER (
      PARTITION BY d.match_id, d.inning, d.batting_team
      ORDER BY d.over_number, d.ball_number, d.delivery_id
      ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) AS cum_runs,
    COUNT(*) OVER (
      PARTITION BY d.match_id, d.inning, d.batting_team
      ORDER BY d.over_number, d.ball_number, d.delivery_id
      ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) AS legal_ball_num
  FROM Deliveries d
  WHERE d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0
),
legal2 AS (
  SELECT
    l.*,
    LAG(l.cum_runs) OVER (
      PARTITION BY l.match_id, l.inning, l.batting_team
      ORDER BY l.legal_ball_num
    ) AS prev_cum
  FROM legal l
)
SELECT
  l2.batting_team AS batting_team,
  CASE WHEN m.team1 = l2.batting_team THEN m.team2 ELSE m.team1 END AS opposition,
  (
    (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(runs_scored + extra_runs),0) FROM Deliveries d WHERE d.match_id = l2.match_id AND d.inning = l2.inning AND d.batting_team = l2.batting_team)
    || '/' ||

JOIN Matches m ON m.match_id = l2.match_id
WHERE l2.legal_ball_num = 85

question: Which team achieved the highest average per wicket in fewer than 9 overs in T20I history. Give the name of the team, average, overs, opposition, and date?
gold_sql: SELECT d.batting_team AS team_name, (SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN d.wicket_type IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0)) AS average, (SUM(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 6.0) AS overs, d.bowling_team AS opposition, m.match_date AS date FROM Deliveries d JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id GROUP BY d.match_id, d.batting_team, d.bowling_team, m.match_date HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) < 54 ORDER BY average DESC LIMIT 1;
generated_sql:

       (CAST(s.total_runs AS REAL)/s.wickets) AS average,
       s.last_over AS overs,
       CASE WHEN s.batting_team = m.team1 THEN m.team2 ELSE m.team1 END AS opposition,
       m.match_date AS date
FROM (
  SELECT match_id,
         inning,
         batting_team,
         SUM(runs_scored + extra_runs) AS total_runs,
         SUM(CASE WHEN wicket_type IS NOT NULL AND wicket_type NOT IN ('run out','retired hurt','obstructing the field') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wickets,
         MAX(CASE WHEN wides = 0 AND noballs = 0 THEN over_number ELSE NULL END) AS last_over
  FROM Deliveries
  GROUP BY match_id, inning, batting_team
) s
JOIN Matches m ON m.match_id = s.match_id
WHERE s.last_over IS NOT NULL
  AND s.last_over < 9
  AND s.wickets > 0
ORDER BY (CAST(s.total_runs AS REAL)/s.wickets) DESC
LIMIT 1;

gold_sql: SELECT d.batting_team, d.bowling_team AS opponents, (SUM(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 6.0) AS overs_faced, d.inning AS innings_number FROM Deliveries d GROUP BY d.match_id, d.inning, d.batting_team, d.bowling_team HAVING SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) = 10;
generated_sql:
WITH legal AS (
  SELECT * FROM Deliveries WHERE wides = 0 AND noballs = 0
),
last_over AS (
  SELECT match_id, inning, MAX(over_number) AS max_over
  FROM legal
  GROUP BY match_id, inning
),
last_ball AS (
  SELECT l.match_id, l.inning, l.max_over, MAX(leg.ball_number) AS max_ball
  FROM last_over l
  JOIN legal leg ON leg.match_id = l.match_id AND leg.inning = l.inning AND leg.over_number = l.max_over
  GROUP BY l.match_id, l.inning, l.max_over
),
innings_totals AS (
  SELECT match_id,
         inning,
         MAX(batting_team) AS batting_team,
         SUM(runs_scored + extra_runs) AS total_runs,
         SUM(CASE WHEN player_out_id IS NOT NULL AND wicket_type != 'retired hurt' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wickets
  FROM Deliveries
  GROUP BY match_id, inning
)
SELECT it.batting_team AS batting_team,
       CASE WHEN m.team1 = it.batting_team THEN m.team2 ELSE m.team1 END AS opponents,
       (CAST(lb.max_over - 1 AS TEXT) || '.' || CAST(lb.max_ball AS TEXT)) AS overs_faced,
       it.inning AS innings_number
FROM innings_totals it
JOIN Matches m ON it.match_id = m.match_id
JOIN last_ball lb ON it.match_id = lb.match_id AND it.inning = lb.inning
WHERE it.total_runs = 10
  AND it.wickets = 10;

question: In T20I history, which team scored just 12 runs , the third lowest total ever ,name their opposition, overs faced?
gold_sql: SELECT d.batting_team, d.bowling_team AS opposition, (SUM(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 6.0) AS overs_faced FROM Deliveries d GROUP BY d.match_id, d.inning, d.batting_team, d.bowling_team HAVING SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) = 12;

WITH innings_totals AS (
  SELECT d.match_id, d.inning, d.batting_team, SUM(d.runs_scored) AS total_runs
  FROM Deliveries d
  GROUP BY d.match_id, d.inning, d.batting_team
),
third_low AS (
  SELECT total_runs FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT total_runs FROM innings_totals ORDER BY total_runs ASC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 2
  )
),
target_innings AS (
  SELECT it.* FROM innings_totals it
  WHERE it.total_runs = (SELECT total_runs FROM third_low)
),
legal_deliveries AS (
  SELECT match_id, inning, batting_team, COUNT(*) AS legal_balls

  WHERE wides = 0 AND noballs = 0
  GROUP BY match_id, inning, batting_team
)
SELECT
  ti.batting_team AS batting_team,
  CASE WHEN m.team1 = ti.batting_team THEN m.team2 ELSE m.team1 END AS opposition,

FROM target_innings ti
JOIN Matches m USING(match_id)
LEFT JOIN legal_deliveries ld ON ld.match_id = ti.match_id AND ld.inning = ti.inning AND ld.batting_team = ti.batting_team;

question: T20I ఇతిహాసలో ఏ టీం కేవలం 12 పరుగులు సంపాదించింది? (అన్నిటికన్నా 3 వ తక్కువ తోటల్) వ్యతిరేకమైన టీం మరియు ఓవర్ల సంఖ్య రాయండి.
gold_sql: SELECT d.batting_team, d.bowling_team AS opposition, (SUM(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 6.0) AS overs_faced FROM Deliveries d GROUP BY d.match_id, d.inning, d.batting_team, d.bowling_team HAVING SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) = 12;
generated_sql:
WITH innings AS (
  SELECT d.match_id,
         d.inning,
         d.batting_team,
         SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) AS total_runs,
         SUM(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS balls_faced
  FROM Deliveries d
  JOIN Matches m ON m.match_id = d.match_id
  WHERE m.season = 'T20I' OR m.season LIKE '%T20I%'
  GROUP BY d.match_id, d.inning, d.batting_team
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT i.*,
         RANK() OVER (ORDER BY i.total_runs ASC) AS rnk,
         CASE WHEN i.batting_team = m.team1 THEN m.team2 ELSE m.team1 END AS opposition
  FROM innings i
  JOIN Matches m ON m.match_id = i.match_id
)
SELECT batting_team AS batting_team,
       opposition AS opposition,
       CAST((balls_faced/6) AS INTEGER) || '.' || (balls_faced % 6) AS overs_faced
FROM ranked
WHERE rnk = 3;

question: ਚੀਨ ਨੂੰ ਇੱਕੋ ਮੈਦਾਨ 'ਤੇ ਲਗਾਤਾਰ ਦੋ ਦਿਨਾਂ 'ਤੇ ਵੱਖ-ਵੱਖ ਵਿਰੋਧੀਆਂ ਦੇ ਖਿਲਾਫ਼ ਬੈਕ-ਟੂ-ਬੈਕ ਬਹੁਤ ਘੱਟ T20I ਕੁੱਲ ਸਕੋਰਾਂ ਦਾ ਸਾਹਮਣਾ ਕਰਨਾ ਪਿਆ। ਦੋਵੇਂ ਸਕੋਰ, ਵਿਰੋਧੀ ਟੀਮਾਂ, ਮੈਦਾਨ ਅਤੇ ਤਾਰੀਖਾਂ ਦੱਸੋ?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) AS scores, d.bowling_team AS opponents, m.venue, m.match_date AS dates FROM Deliveries d JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id WHERE d.batting_team = 'China' GROUP BY d.match_id, d.inning, d.bowling_team, m.venue, m.match_date ORDER BY scores ASC LIMIT 2;

generated_sql:

  (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(runs_scored + extra_runs),0) FROM Deliveries WHERE match_id = m1.match_id AND batting_team = 'China') || ', ' ||
  (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(runs_scored + extra_runs),0) FROM Deliveries WHERE match_id = m2.match_id AND batting_team = 'China') AS scores,

  (CASE WHEN m2.team1 = 'China' THEN m2.team2 ELSE m2.team1 END) AS opponents,
  m1.venue AS venue,
  m1.match_date || ', ' || m2.match_date AS dates

question: Among all players with 14 POTM awards, which has the best award-to-match ratio — name all four players, their matches played, and calculate ratio for each
gold_sql: WITH POTM_Counts AS (SELECT player_of_match_id AS player_id, COUNT(*) AS potm_count FROM Matches WHERE player_of_match_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY player_of_match_id HAVING COUNT(*) = 14), Match_Counts AS (SELECT player_id, COUNT(*) AS matches_played FROM PlayerInMatch GROUP BY player_id) SELECT p.player_name, mc.matches_played, (pc.potm_count * 1.0 / mc.matches_played) AS award_to_match_ratio FROM POTM_Counts pc JOIN Match_Counts mc ON pc.player_id = mc.player_id JOIN Players p ON pc.player_id = p.player_id ORDER BY award_to_match_ratio DESC LIMIT 4;
generated_sql:
SELECT
  p.player_name AS player_name,
  mp.matches_played AS matches_played,
  CAST(a.awards_count AS REAL) / mp.matches_played AS award_to_match_ratio
FROM Players p
JOIN (
  SELECT player_of_match_id, COUNT(*) AS awards_count
  FROM Matches
  WHERE player_of_match_id IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY player_of_match_id
) a ON p.player_id = a.player_of_match_id
JOIN (
  SELECT player_id, COUNT(DISTINCT match_id) AS matches_played
  FROM PlayerInMatch
  GROUP BY player_id
) mp ON p.player_id = mp.player_id
WHERE a.awards_count = 14
ORDER BY award_to_match_ratio DESC;

question: 14 POTM ਅਵਾਰਡਾਂ ਵਾਲੇ ਸਾਰੇ ਖਿਡਾਰੀਆਂ ਵਿੱਚੋਂ ਕਿਸਦੀ ਅਵਾਰਡ-ਤੋਂ-ਮੈਚ ਅਨੁਪਾਤ ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਵਧੀਆ ਹੈ — ਸਾਰੇ ਚਾਰ ਖਿਡਾਰੀਆਂ ਦੇ ਨਾਮ, ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਦੁਆਰਾ ਖੇਡੇ ਮੈਚ ਅਤੇ ਹਰੇਕ ਦੀ ਅਨੁਪਾਤ ਦੀ ਗਣਨਾ ਕਰੋ?
gold_sql: WITH POTM_Counts AS (SELECT player_of_match_id AS player_id, COUNT(*) AS potm_count FROM Matches WHERE player_of_match_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY player_of_match_id HAVING COUNT(*) = 14), Match_Counts AS (SELECT player_id, COUNT(*) AS matches_played FROM PlayerInMatch GROUP BY player_id) SELECT p.player_name, mc.matches_played, (pc.potm_count * 1.0 / mc.matches_played) AS award_to_match_ratio FROM POTM_Counts pc JOIN Match_Counts mc ON pc.player_id = mc.player_id JOIN Players p ON pc.player_id = p.player_id ORDER BY award_to_match_ratio DESC LIMIT 4;
generated_sql:
SELECT
  p.player_name AS player_name,
  COALESCE(pi.matches_played, 0) AS matches_played,
  CASE WHEN COALESCE(pi.matches_played, 0) > 0 THEN (aw.awards * 1.0) / pi.matches_played ELSE NULL END AS award_to_match_ratio
FROM (
  SELECT player_of_match_id AS player_id, COUNT(*) AS awards
  FROM Matches
  WHERE player_of_match_id IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY player_of_match_id
  HAVING COUNT(*) = 14
) aw
JOIN Players p ON p.player_id = aw.player_id
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT player_id, COUNT(*) AS matches_played
  FROM PlayerInMatch
  GROUP BY player_id
) pi ON pi.player_id = aw.player_id
ORDER BY award_to_match_ratio DESC, p.player_name;

question: ఒకే స్థానంలో వరుసగా 2 రోజుల్లో చైనా 2 చాలా తక్కువ T20I స్కోర్లు సంపాదించింది. 2 స్కోర్లు, వ్యతిరేకమైన టీములు, స్థానం మరియు తేదీలు రాయండి.
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) AS scores, d.bowling_team AS opponents, m.venue, m.match_date AS dates FROM Deliveries d JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id WHERE d.batting_team = 'China' GROUP BY d.match_id, d.inning, d.bowling_team, m.venue, m.match_date ORDER BY scores ASC LIMIT 2;
gold_answer: ["(8, 'Thailand', 'Mission Road Ground, Mong Kok, Hong Kong', '2024-12-07')", "(23, 'Malaysia', 'Bayuemas Oval, Kuala Lumpur', '2023-07-26')"]

WITH team_scores AS (
  SELECT d.match_id,
         m.match_date,
         m.venue,
         SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) AS total_runs,
         CASE WHEN m.team1 = 'China' THEN m.team2 ELSE m.team1 END AS opponent
  FROM Deliveries d
  JOIN Matches m ON m.match_id = d.match_id
  WHERE d.batting_team = 'China'

  );

question: 14 'ప్లేయర్ ఆఫ్ తే మ్యాచ్' అవార్డ్లు ఉన్న క్రీడాకార్లలో ఎవరి దగ్గర అన్నిటికన్నా మంచి అవార్డ్ల సంఖ్య/మ్యాచుల సంఖ్య రేషియో ఉన్నది? క్రీడాకార్ల పేరు, మ్యాచుల సంఖ్య మరియు రేషియోలు రాయండి.
gold_sql: WITH POTM_Counts AS (SELECT player_of_match_id AS player_id, COUNT(*) AS potm_count FROM Matches WHERE player_of_match_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY player_of_match_id HAVING COUNT(*) = 14), Match_Counts AS (SELECT player_id, COUNT(*) AS matches_played FROM PlayerInMatch GROUP BY player_id) SELECT p.player_name, mc.matches_played, (pc.potm_count * 1.0 / mc.matches_played) AS award_to_match_ratio FROM POTM_Counts pc JOIN Match_Counts mc ON pc.player_id = mc.player_id JOIN Players p ON pc.player_id = p.player_id ORDER BY award_to_match_ratio DESC LIMIT 4;

       (aw.awards * 1.0 / mp.matches_played) AS award_to_match_ratio

         COUNT(*) AS awards

question: V Kohli and RG Sharma both have 14+ POTM awards. Give their awards, matches, spans, and award-to-match ratios
gold_sql: WITH MatchStats AS (SELECT pim.player_id, COUNT(pim.match_id) AS matches_played, MIN(m.match_date) || ' to ' || MAX(m.match_date) AS span FROM PlayerInMatch pim JOIN Matches m ON pim.match_id = m.match_id GROUP BY pim.player_id), POTMStats AS (SELECT player_of_match_id AS player_id, COUNT(*) AS potm_awards FROM Matches WHERE player_of_match_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY player_of_match_id) SELECT p.player_name, ps.potm_awards, ms.matches_played, ms.span, (ps.potm_awards * 1.0 / ms.matches_played) AS award_to_match_ratio FROM Players p JOIN MatchStats ms ON p.player_id = ms.player_id JOIN POTMStats ps ON p.player_id = ps.player_id WHERE p.player_name IN ('V Kohli', 'RG Sharma') ORDER BY ps.potm_awards DESC;
generated_sql:
SELECT
    p.player_name AS player_name,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Matches m WHERE m.player_of_match_id = p.player_id) AS potm_awards,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM PlayerInMatch pim WHERE pim.player_id = p.player_id) AS matches_played,
    (SELECT MIN(m2.match_date) || ' - ' || MAX(m2.match_date)
     FROM PlayerInMatch pim2 JOIN Matches m2 ON pim2.match_id = m2.match_id
     WHERE pim2.player_id = p.player_id) AS span,
    ROUND(
      (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Matches m WHERE m.player_of_match_id = p.player_id) * 1.0
      / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM PlayerInMatch pim WHERE pim.player_id = p.player_id), 0)
    , 4) AS award_to_match_ratio
FROM Players p
WHERE p.player_name IN ('V Kohli', 'RG Sharma')
  AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Matches m WHERE m.player_of_match_id = p.player_id) >= 14;

question: वी कोहली और आरजी शर्मा दोनों के पास 14 या उससे अधिक POTM अवॉर्ड हैं। उनके अवॉर्ड, मैच, करियर स्पैन, और अवॉर्ड-प्रति-मैच अनुपात बताइए।
gold_sql: WITH MatchStats AS (SELECT pim.player_id, COUNT(pim.match_id) AS matches_played, MIN(m.match_date) || ' to ' || MAX(m.match_date) AS span FROM PlayerInMatch pim JOIN Matches m ON pim.match_id = m.match_id GROUP BY pim.player_id), POTMStats AS (SELECT player_of_match_id AS player_id, COUNT(*) AS potm_awards FROM Matches WHERE player_of_match_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY player_of_match_id) SELECT p.player_name, ps.potm_awards, ms.matches_played, ms.span, (ps.potm_awards * 1.0 / ms.matches_played) AS award_to_match_ratio FROM Players p JOIN MatchStats ms ON p.player_id = ms.player_id JOIN POTMStats ps ON p.player_id = ps.player_id WHERE p.player_name IN ('V Kohli', 'RG Sharma') ORDER BY ps.potm_awards DESC;
generated_sql:
WITH ps AS (
  SELECT
    p.player_id,
    p.player_name,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Matches m WHERE m.player_of_match_id = p.player_id) AS potm_awards,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM PlayerInMatch pim WHERE pim.player_id = p.player_id) AS matches_played,
    (SELECT substr(MIN(m2.match_date),1,4) FROM PlayerInMatch pim2 JOIN Matches m2 ON pim2.match_id = m2.match_id WHERE pim2.player_id = p.player_id) AS start_year,
    (SELECT substr(MAX(m3.match_date),1,4) FROM PlayerInMatch pim3 JOIN Matches m3 ON pim3.match_id = m3.match_id WHERE pim3.player_id = p.player_id) AS end_year
  FROM Players p
  WHERE p.player_name IN ('V Kohli','RG Sharma')
)
SELECT
  player_name AS player_name,
  potm_awards AS potm_awards,
  matches_played AS matches_played,
  (start_year || '-' || end_year) AS span,
  CASE WHEN matches_played > 0 THEN potm_awards * 1.0 / matches_played ELSE 0 END AS award_to_match_ratio
FROM ps
WHERE potm_awards >= 14;

gold_sql: WITH MatchStats AS (SELECT pim.player_id, COUNT(pim.match_id) AS matches_played, MIN(m.match_date) || ' to ' || MAX(m.match_date) AS span FROM PlayerInMatch pim JOIN Matches m ON pim.match_id = m.match_id GROUP BY pim.player_id), POTMStats AS (SELECT player_of_match_id AS player_id, COUNT(*) AS potm_awards FROM Matches WHERE player_of_match_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY player_of_match_id) SELECT p.player_name, ps.potm_awards, ms.matches_played, ms.span, (ps.potm_awards * 1.0 / ms.matches_played) AS award_to_match_ratio FROM Players p JOIN MatchStats ms ON p.player_id = ms.player_id JOIN POTMStats ps ON p.player_id = ps.player_id WHERE p.player_name IN ('V Kohli', 'RG Sharma') ORDER BY ps.potm_awards DESC;

question: Which player has won 8 POTM awards in the fewest matches in T20I history — name his country, span, and award ratio?
gold_sql: WITH MatchStats AS (SELECT pim.player_id, MAX(pim.team_name) AS country, COUNT(pim.match_id) AS matches_played, MIN(m.match_date) || ' to ' || MAX(m.match_date) AS span FROM PlayerInMatch pim JOIN Matches m ON pim.match_id = m.match_id GROUP BY pim.player_id), POTMStats AS (SELECT player_of_match_id AS player_id, COUNT(*) AS potm_awards FROM Matches WHERE player_of_match_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY player_of_match_id HAVING COUNT(*) = 8) SELECT p.player_name, ms.country, ms.span, (ps.potm_awards * 1.0 / ms.matches_played) AS award_ratio FROM POTMStats ps JOIN MatchStats ms ON ps.player_id = ms.player_id JOIN Players p ON ps.player_id = p.player_id ORDER BY ms.matches_played ASC LIMIT 1;
generated_sql:
WITH potm_events AS (
  SELECT
    player_of_match_id AS player_id,
    match_id,
    match_date,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY player_of_match_id ORDER BY match_date, match_id) AS rn
  FROM Matches
  WHERE season = 'T20I' AND player_of_match_id IS NOT NULL
),
eighth AS (
  SELECT player_id, match_id AS eighth_match_id, match_date AS eighth_match_date
  FROM potm_events
  WHERE rn = 8
),
matches_up_to_eighth AS (
  SELECT
    e.player_id,
    e.eighth_match_id,
    e.eighth_match_date,
    COUNT(*) AS matches_played
  FROM eighth e
  JOIN PlayerInMatch pim ON pim.player_id = e.player_id
  JOIN Matches m ON pim.match_id = m.match_id
  WHERE m.season = 'T20I'
    AND (m.match_date < e.eighth_match_date OR (m.match_date = e.eighth_match_date AND m.match_id <= e.eighth_match_id))
  GROUP BY e.player_id, e.eighth_match_date, e.eighth_match_id
),
country_cte AS (
  SELECT
    pim.player_id,
    pim.team_name AS country,
    COUNT(*) AS cnt,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY pim.player_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, pim.team_name) AS rn
  FROM PlayerInMatch pim
  JOIN Matches m ON pim.match_id = m.match_id
  WHERE m.season = 'T20I'
  GROUP BY pim.player_id, pim.team_name
),
span_cte AS (
  SELECT
    pim.player_id,
    substr(MIN(m.match_date),1,4) || '-' || substr(MAX(m.match_date),1,4) AS span
  FROM PlayerInMatch pim
  JOIN Matches m ON pim.match_id = m.match_id
  WHERE m.season = 'T20I'
  GROUP BY pim.player_id
)
SELECT
  pl.player_name AS player_name,
  c.country AS country,
  s.span AS span,
  ROUND(8.0 / mue.matches_played, 3) AS award_ratio
FROM matches_up_to_eighth mue
JOIN Players pl ON pl.player_id = mue.player_id
LEFT JOIN country_cte c ON c.player_id = mue.player_id AND c.rn = 1
LEFT JOIN span_cte s ON s.player_id = mue.player_id
ORDER BY mue.matches_played ASC, ROUND(8.0 / mue.matches_played, 3) DESC, pl.player_name ASC
LIMIT 1;

question: T20I ఇతిహాసలో ఏ క్రీడాకారుడు అన్నిటికన్నా తక్కువ మ్యాచులలో 8 'ప్లేయర్ ఆఫ్ తే మ్యాచ్' అవార్డ్లు గెలిచాడు? అతన దేశం, ఆడిన సంవత్సరాలు మరియు రేషియో రాయండి.
gold_sql: WITH MatchStats AS (SELECT pim.player_id, MAX(pim.team_name) AS country, COUNT(pim.match_id) AS matches_played, MIN(m.match_date) || ' to ' || MAX(m.match_date) AS span FROM PlayerInMatch pim JOIN Matches m ON pim.match_id = m.match_id GROUP BY pim.player_id), POTMStats AS (SELECT player_of_match_id AS player_id, COUNT(*) AS potm_awards FROM Matches WHERE player_of_match_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY player_of_match_id HAVING COUNT(*) = 8) SELECT p.player_name, ms.country, ms.span, (ps.potm_awards * 1.0 / ms.matches_played) AS award_ratio FROM POTMStats ps JOIN MatchStats ms ON ps.player_id = ms.player_id JOIN Players p ON ps.player_id = p.player_id ORDER BY ms.matches_played ASC LIMIT 1;
generated_sql:
WITH awards AS (
  SELECT player_of_match_id AS player_id, COUNT(*) AS awards
  FROM Matches
  WHERE player_of_match_id IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY player_of_match_id
),
player_matches AS (
  SELECT pim.player_id,
         COUNT(*) AS matches_played,
         MIN(substr(m.match_date,1,4)) AS start_year,
         MAX(substr(m.match_date,1,4)) AS end_year
  FROM PlayerInMatch pim
  JOIN Matches m ON pim.match_id = m.match_id
  GROUP BY pim.player_id
),
primary_team AS (
  SELECT player_id, team_name AS country
  FROM (
    SELECT player_id, team_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY player_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, team_name) AS rn
    FROM PlayerInMatch
    GROUP BY player_id, team_name
  )
  WHERE rn = 1
),
min_matches AS (
  SELECT MIN(pm.matches_played) AS min_played
  FROM awards a
  JOIN player_matches pm ON a.player_id = pm.player_id
  WHERE a.awards = 8
)
SELECT p.player_name AS player_name,
       COALESCE(pt.country, (SELECT team_name FROM PlayerInMatch WHERE player_id = p.player_id LIMIT 1)) AS country,
       (pm.start_year || '-' || pm.end_year) AS span,
       (CAST(a.awards AS REAL) / pm.matches_played) AS award_ratio
FROM awards a
JOIN player_matches pm ON a.player_id = pm.player_id
JOIN Players p ON p.player_id = a.player_id
LEFT JOIN primary_team pt ON pt.player_id = a.player_id
WHERE a.awards = 8
  AND pm.matches_played = (SELECT min_played FROM min_matches);

question: Which T20I match holds the record for the most batters dismissed lbw, name both teams, total lbw count, total wickets in the match, winner, and date?
gold_sql: SELECT m.team1, m.team2, SUM(CASE WHEN d.wicket_type = 'lbw' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_lbw_count, SUM(CASE WHEN d.player_out_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_wickets, m.match_winner, m.match_date FROM Matches m JOIN Deliveries d ON m.match_id = d.match_id GROUP BY m.match_id, m.team1, m.team2, m.match_winner, m.match_date ORDER BY total_lbw_count DESC LIMIT 1;

  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 AND d.wicket_type IS NOT NULL AND d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out','retired hurt','obstructing the field') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS total_wickets,
