question: What is Sanju Samson’s T20 batting record at Chepauk?
gold_sql: WITH innings_scores AS ( SELECT d.match_id, d.inning, d.striker_id, SUM(d.runs_scored) AS runs, COUNT(CASE WHEN d.wides=0 THEN 1 END) AS balls, SUM(CASE WHEN d.player_out_id=d.striker_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dismissed FROM Deliveries d GROUP BY d.match_id, d.inning, d.striker_id ) SELECT p.player_name, COUNT(*) AS innings, SUM(s.runs) AS total_runs, ROUND(SUM(s.runs) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(s.dismissed),0),2) AS average, ROUND(SUM(s.runs)*100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(s.balls),0),2) AS strike_rate, MAX(s.runs) AS high_score FROM innings_scores s JOIN Players p ON s.striker_id = p.player_id JOIN Matches m ON s.match_id = m.match_id WHERE p.player_name LIKE '%Samson%' AND (m.venue LIKE '%Chepauk%' OR m.city LIKE '%Chennai%') GROUP BY p.player_name;

    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Deliveries d WHERE d.match_id = m.match_id)

  GROUP BY d.match_id, d.inning

    COALESCE((SELECT SUM(d2.runs_scored) FROM del d2 WHERE d2.striker_id = p.player_id), 0) AS total_runs,

    END AS average,

      WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM del d2 WHERE d2.striker_id = p.player_id AND d2.wides = 0 AND d2.noballs = 0) = 0 THEN NULL
      ELSE ROUND(
        (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(d2.runs_scored),0) FROM del d2 WHERE d2.striker_id = p.player_id) * 100.0
        / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM del d2 WHERE d2.striker_id = p.player_id AND d2.wides = 0 AND d2.noballs = 0)
      , 2)
    END AS strike_rate
  FROM player p
),
high AS (
  SELECT MAX(runs_in_innings) AS high_score FROM innings_runs
)
SELECT
  s.player_name AS player_name,
  s.innings AS innings,
  s.total_runs AS total_runs,
  s.average AS average,
  s.strike_rate AS strike_rate,
  COALESCE(h.high_score, 0) AS high_score
FROM stats s CROSS JOIN high h;

  JOIN player p ON pim.player_id = p.player_id
  WHERE m.stage = 'T20I' AND (m.team1 = 'India' OR m.team2 = 'India')
),
matches_count AS (
  SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT match_id) AS matches FROM relevant_matches
),
batting_runs AS (
  SELECT d.match_id, d.inning,
         SUM(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN (d.runs_scored - d.byes - d.legbyes) ELSE 0 END) AS runs_in_innings
  FROM Deliveries d
  JOIN player p ON d.striker_id = p.player_id
  WHERE d.match_id IN (SELECT match_id FROM relevant_matches)
  GROUP BY d.match_id, d.inning
),
total_runs AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(runs_in_innings),0) AS total_runs FROM batting_runs
),
high_score AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(MAX(runs_in_innings),0) AS high_score FROM batting_runs
),
dismissals AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS dismissals
  FROM Deliveries d
  JOIN player p ON d.player_out_id = p.player_id
  WHERE d.match_id IN (SELECT match_id FROM relevant_matches)
    AND d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0
    AND (d.wicket_type IS NULL OR d.wicket_type <> 'retired hurt')
)
SELECT p.player_name AS player_name,
       mc.matches AS matches,
       CASE WHEN dis.dismissals = 0 THEN NULL ELSE (tr.total_runs * 1.0) / dis.dismissals END AS average,
       hs.high_score AS high_score
FROM player p
CROSS JOIN matches_count mc
CROSS JOIN total_runs tr
CROSS JOIN high_score hs
CROSS JOIN dismissals dis;

question: What are the most consecutive wins in Men’s T20 World Cups?
gold_sql: WITH wc_teams AS ( SELECT m.match_winner AS team, m.match_date, m.match_id, 1 AS won FROM Matches m WHERE m.match_winner IS NOT NULL AND m.result_type != 'tie' UNION ALL SELECT CASE WHEN m.team1 = m.match_winner THEN m.team2 ELSE m.team1 END, m.match_date, m.match_id, 0 FROM Matches m WHERE m.match_winner IS NOT NULL AND m.result_type != 'tie' ), numbered AS ( SELECT team, match_date, match_id, won, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY team ORDER BY match_date, match_id) AS rn FROM wc_teams ), grouped AS ( SELECT team, won, rn, rn - ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY team, won ORDER BY rn) AS grp FROM numbered ), streaks AS ( SELECT team, won, grp, COUNT(*) AS streak_len FROM grouped WHERE won = 1 GROUP BY team, won, grp ) SELECT team, MAX(streak_len) AS max_consecutive_wins FROM streaks GROUP BY team ORDER BY max_consecutive_wins DESC LIMIT 10;
generated_sql:
WITH tournament_matches AS (
  SELECT * FROM Matches WHERE season LIKE '%T20 World Cup%'
),
team_games AS (
  SELECT m.match_id, m.match_date, m.team1 AS team, m.match_winner FROM tournament_matches m
  UNION ALL
  SELECT m.match_id, m.match_date, m.team2 AS team, m.match_winner FROM tournament_matches m
),
ordered AS (
  SELECT
    team,
    match_id,
    match_date,
    CASE WHEN match_winner = team THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS win_flag,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY team ORDER BY match_date, match_id) AS rn,
    SUM(CASE WHEN match_winner = team THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY team ORDER BY match_date, match_id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cum_wins
  FROM team_games
),
wins AS (
  SELECT team, match_id, match_date, win_flag, rn, cum_wins, (rn - cum_wins) AS grp
  FROM ordered
  WHERE win_flag = 1
),
streaks AS (
  SELECT team, grp, COUNT(*) AS streak_len
  FROM wins
  GROUP BY team, grp
),
team_max AS (
  SELECT team, MAX(streak_len) AS max_consecutive_wins
  FROM streaks
  GROUP BY team
)
SELECT t.team AS team, COALESCE(tm.max_consecutive_wins, 0) AS max_consecutive_wins
FROM (SELECT DISTINCT team FROM team_games) t

ORDER BY max_consecutive_wins DESC, team;

gold_sql: WITH wc_teams AS ( SELECT m.match_winner AS team, m.match_date, m.match_id, 1 AS won FROM Matches m WHERE m.match_winner IS NOT NULL AND m.result_type != 'tie' UNION ALL SELECT CASE WHEN m.team1 = m.match_winner THEN m.team2 ELSE m.team1 END, m.match_date, m.match_id, 0 FROM Matches m WHERE m.match_winner IS NOT NULL AND m.result_type != 'tie' ), numbered AS ( SELECT team, match_date, match_id, won, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY team ORDER BY match_date, match_id) AS rn FROM wc_teams ), grouped AS ( SELECT team, won, rn, rn - ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY team, won ORDER BY rn) AS grp FROM numbered ), streaks AS ( SELECT team, won, grp, COUNT(*) AS streak_len FROM grouped WHERE won = 1 GROUP BY team, won, grp ) SELECT team, MAX(streak_len) AS max_consecutive_wins FROM streaks GROUP BY team ORDER BY max_consecutive_wins DESC LIMIT 10;

WITH team_matches AS (
  SELECT match_id, match_date, match_winner, team1 AS team
  FROM Matches
  WHERE season LIKE '%T20 World Cup%'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT match_id, match_date, match_winner, team2 AS team
  FROM Matches
  WHERE season LIKE '%T20 World Cup%'
),
ordered AS (
  SELECT
    team,
    match_id,
    match_date,
    CASE WHEN match_winner = team THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS win,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY team ORDER BY match_date, match_id) AS rn,
    SUM(CASE WHEN match_winner = team THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY team ORDER BY match_date, match_id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cum_wins
  FROM team_matches
),
win_groups AS (
  SELECT team, (rn - cum_wins) AS grp
  FROM ordered
  WHERE win = 1
),
streaks AS (
  SELECT team, COUNT(*) AS streak
  FROM win_groups
  GROUP BY team, grp
)
SELECT team, MAX(streak) AS max_consecutive_wins
FROM streaks
GROUP BY team;

),

question: What is the highest boundary count in a match in season 2026?
gold_sql: SELECT m.team1, m.team2, m.season, COUNT(CASE WHEN d.runs_scored = 4 AND d.wides = 0 THEN 1 END) AS fours, COUNT(CASE WHEN d.runs_scored = 6 AND d.wides = 0 THEN 1 END) AS sixes, COUNT(CASE WHEN d.runs_scored IN (4,6) AND d.wides = 0 THEN 1 END) AS total_boundaries FROM Deliveries d JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id WHERE m.season = '2026' GROUP BY m.match_id, m.team1, m.team2, m.season ORDER BY total_boundaries DESC LIMIT 5;

    m.team2 AS team2,
    m.season AS season,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d.runs_scored = 4 AND d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS fours,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d.runs_scored = 6 AND d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS sixes,
    (COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d.runs_scored = 4 AND d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0)

WHERE m.season = '2026'

  FROM Matches m

  WHERE m.season = '2026'
  GROUP BY m.match_id
)

  UNION ALL
  SELECT match_id, inning, non_striker_id AS player_id, over_number, ball_number FROM deliveries_legal

question: What are the fastest team 100s in T20 World Cup knockouts?
gold_sql: WITH knockout_cte AS ( SELECT m.match_id FROM Matches m WHERE m.season IN ('2007','2009','2010','2012','2014','2016','2021/22','2022/23','2024','2025/26') AND m.team1 IN ('Afghanistan','Australia','Bangladesh','England','India','Ireland','New Zealand','Pakistan','South Africa','Sri Lanka','West Indies','Zimbabwe') AND m.team2 IN ('Afghanistan','Australia','Bangladesh','England','India','Ireland','New Zealand','Pakistan','South Africa','Sri Lanka','West Indies','Zimbabwe') AND m.stage IN ('Semi Final', 'Final') ), cumulative AS ( SELECT d.match_id, d.inning, d.batting_team, d.over_number, d.ball_number, d.delivery_id, SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) OVER (PARTITION BY d.match_id, d.inning ORDER BY d.delivery_id ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS running_total FROM Deliveries d JOIN knockout_cte kc ON d.match_id = kc.match_id ), first_100 AS ( SELECT match_id, inning, batting_team, MIN(over_number) AS over_when_100, MIN(ball_number) AS ball_when_100 FROM cumulative WHERE running_total >= 100 GROUP BY match_id, inning, batting_team ) SELECT f.batting_team, f.over_when_100, f.ball_when_100, m.team1, m.team2, m.season FROM first_100 f JOIN Matches m ON f.match_id = m.match_id WHERE f.batting_team IN ('Afghanistan','Australia','Bangladesh','England','India','Ireland','New Zealand','Pakistan','South Africa','Sri Lanka','West Indies','Zimbabwe') ORDER BY f.over_when_100, f.ball_when_100 LIMIT 10;

WITH knockouts AS (
  SELECT * FROM Matches
  WHERE lower(stage) LIKE '%knock%'
     OR lower(stage) IN (
       'quarter-final','quarter final','quarterfinal',
       'semi-final','semi final','semifinal',
       'final','eliminator','qualifier',
       'play-off','playoff','play off'
     )
),
legal_deliveries AS (
  SELECT d.match_id,
         d.inning,
         d.over_number,
         d.ball_number,
         d.batting_team,
         (d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) AS runs,
         (d.over_number * 10 + d.ball_number) AS ball_index,
         k.team1,
         k.team2,
         k.season
  FROM Deliveries d
  JOIN knockouts k ON d.match_id = k.match_id
  WHERE d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0
),
cum AS (
  SELECT ld.*,
         SUM(runs) OVER (
           PARTITION BY match_id, inning
           ORDER BY over_number, ball_number
           ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
         ) AS cum_runs
  FROM legal_deliveries ld
),
reached AS (
  SELECT match_id, inning, batting_team, over_number, ball_number, ball_index, team1, team2, season
  FROM cum
  WHERE cum_runs >= 100
),
firsts AS (
  SELECT match_id, inning, MIN(ball_index) AS ball_index
  FROM reached
  GROUP BY match_id, inning
)
SELECT r.batting_team AS batting_team,

       r.team1 AS team1,

       r.season AS season
FROM reached r
JOIN firsts f ON r.match_id = f.match_id AND r.inning = f.inning AND r.ball_index = f.ball_index
ORDER BY over_when_100, ball_when_100;

    CASE

        OR (LOWER(COALESCE(season, '')) LIKE '%t20%' AND LOWER(COALESCE(season, '')) LIKE '%world%')

    (LOWER(COALESCE(stage, '')) LIKE '%t20%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(season, '')) LIKE '%t20%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(stage, '')) LIKE '%t20i%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(season, '')) LIKE '%t20i%') AS looks_like_t20

gold_answer: ["('Ishan Kishan', 103)", "('SV Samson', 97)", "('SA Yadav', 84)", "('Abhishek Sharma', 84)", "('S Mandhana', 82)", "('Shafali Verma', 79)", "('Tilak Varma', 73)", "('JI Rodrigues', 69)", "('H Kaur', 68)", "('S Dube', 66)"]

  FROM Deliveries d
  JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
  WHERE m.season = 'T20 World Cup 2026'

    AND d.noballs = 0
    AND d.batting_team = 'India'

innings AS (

         match_id,
         inning,
         SUM(runs_scored - extra_runs) AS innings_runs

  GROUP BY striker_id, match_id, inning

totals AS (

),

       MAX(pi.runs) AS hs

question: T20 World Cup ఒక ఎడిషన్‌లో అత్యధిక Player of the Match అవార్డులు గెలుచుకున్న ఆటగాళ్ళు ఎవరు?
gold_sql: SELECT p.player_name, m.season, COUNT(*) AS potm_awards FROM Matches m JOIN Players p ON m.player_of_match_id = p.player_id WHERE m.player_of_match_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY m.player_of_match_id, p.player_name, m.season ORDER BY potm_awards DESC LIMIT 10;
generated_sql:
SELECT p.player_name AS player_name,
       mcounts.season AS season,
       mcounts.potm_awards AS potm_awards
FROM (
    SELECT season, player_of_match_id AS player_id, COUNT(*) AS potm_awards
    FROM Matches
    WHERE player_of_match_id IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY season, player_of_match_id
) AS mcounts
JOIN (
    SELECT season, MAX(potm_awards) AS max_awards
    FROM (
        SELECT season, player_of_match_id, COUNT(*) AS potm_awards
        FROM Matches
        WHERE player_of_match_id IS NOT NULL
        GROUP BY season, player_of_match_id
    )
    GROUP BY season
) AS maxes ON mcounts.season = maxes.season AND mcounts.potm_awards = maxes.max_awards
JOIN Players p ON p.player_id = mcounts.player_id
ORDER BY mcounts.season, p.player_name;

question: T20 World Cups లో Full Member జట్లపై అత్యధిక విజయ వ్యత్యాసాలు ఏవి?
gold_sql: SELECT m.match_winner, CASE WHEN m.team1 = m.match_winner THEN m.team2 ELSE m.team1 END AS loser, m.result_type, m.result_margin, m.season FROM Matches m WHERE m.match_winner IS NOT NULL AND m.result_type IN ('runs', 'wickets') AND CASE WHEN m.team1 = m.match_winner THEN m.team2 ELSE m.team1 END IN ( 'Afghanistan','Australia','Bangladesh','England','India','Ireland', 'New Zealand','Pakistan','South Africa','Sri Lanka','West Indies','Zimbabwe' ) ORDER BY m.result_margin DESC LIMIT 10;
gold_answer: ["('India', 'New Zealand', 'runs', 168, '2022/23')", "('India', 'England', 'runs', 150, '2024/25')", "('England', 'South Africa', 'runs', 146, '2025')", "('Pakistan', 'West Indies', 'runs', 143, '2018')", "('India', 'Ireland', 'runs', 143, '2018')", "('England', 'West Indies', 'runs', 137, '2018/19')", "('India', 'South Africa', 'runs', 135, '2024/25')", "('Australia', 'Sri Lanka', 'runs', 134, '2019/20')", "('India', 'Bangladesh', 'runs', 133, '2024/25')", "('Australia', 'Sri Lanka', 'runs', 132, '2019/20')"]
generated_sql:
SELECT
  match_winner AS match_winner,
  CASE WHEN match_winner = team1 THEN team2 ELSE team1 END AS loser,
  result_type AS result_type,
  result_margin AS result_margin,
  season AS season
FROM Matches
WHERE season LIKE '%T20 World Cup%'
  AND match_winner IS NOT NULL
  AND (match_winner = team1 OR match_winner = team2)
  AND (CASE WHEN match_winner = team1 THEN team2 ELSE team1 END) IN (
    'Afghanistan','Australia','Bangladesh','England','India','Ireland',
    'New Zealand','Pakistan','South Africa','Sri Lanka','West Indies','Zimbabwe'
  )
ORDER BY result_margin DESC;

question: What are the highest match aggregates in T20 World Cup knockouts?
gold_sql: WITH knockout_cte AS ( SELECT m.match_id FROM Matches m WHERE m.season IN ('2007','2009','2010','2012','2014','2016','2021/22','2022/23','2024','2025/26') AND m.team1 IN ('Afghanistan','Australia','Bangladesh','England','India','Ireland','New Zealand','Pakistan','South Africa','Sri Lanka','West Indies','Zimbabwe') AND m.team2 IN ('Afghanistan','Australia','Bangladesh','England','India','Ireland','New Zealand','Pakistan','South Africa','Sri Lanka','West Indies','Zimbabwe') AND m.stage IN ('Semi Final', 'Final') ) SELECT m.team1, m.team2, m.season, SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) AS total_runs FROM Deliveries d JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id JOIN knockout_cte kc ON m.match_id = kc.match_id GROUP BY m.match_id, m.team1, m.team2, m.season ORDER BY total_runs DESC LIMIT 10;
gold_answer: ["('India', 'England', '2025/26', 499)", "('India', 'New Zealand', '2025/26', 414)", "('Australia', 'Pakistan', '2010', 388)", "('Pakistan', 'Australia', '2021/22', 353)", "('New Zealand', 'Australia', '2021/22', 345)", "('India', 'South Africa', '2024', 345)", "('South Africa', 'New Zealand', '2025/26', 342)", "('Australia', 'India', '2022/23', 339)", "('India', 'England', '2022/23', 338)", "('England', 'New Zealand', '2021/22', 333)"]
generated_sql:
SELECT m.team1 AS team1, m.team2 AS team2, m.season AS season, SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) AS total_runs
FROM Matches m
JOIN Deliveries d ON m.match_id = d.match_id
WHERE (
    m.season LIKE '%T20 World Cup%' OR
    m.season LIKE '%World T20%' OR
    m.season LIKE '%World Twenty20%' OR
    m.season LIKE '%T20 World%'
)
AND (
    m.stage IN (
        'Quarter-Final','Quarter Final','Quarterfinal','Quarterfinals',
        'Semi-Final','Semi Final','Semifinal','Semifinals',
        'Final','Eliminator','Play-off','Play Off','Playoff','Knockout','Knock-Out','Knock Out'
    )
    OR m.stage LIKE '%Knock%' OR m.stage LIKE '%Quarter%' OR m.stage LIKE '%Semi%' OR m.stage LIKE '%Final%' OR m.stage LIKE '%Eliminator%' OR m.stage LIKE '%Play%'
)
GROUP BY m.match_id, m.team1, m.team2, m.season
ORDER BY total_runs DESC;

question: Which teams have lost multiple T20 World Cup finals?
gold_sql: WITH finals_cte AS ( SELECT m.match_id, m.season FROM Matches m WHERE m.season IN ('2007','2009','2010','2012','2014','2016','2021/22','2022/23','2024','2025/26') AND m.team1 IN ('Afghanistan','Australia','Bangladesh','England','India','Ireland','New Zealand','Pakistan','South Africa','Sri Lanka','West Indies','Zimbabwe') AND m.team2 IN ('Afghanistan','Australia','Bangladesh','England','India','Ireland','New Zealand','Pakistan','South Africa','Sri Lanka','West Indies','Zimbabwe') AND m.stage = 'Final' ) SELECT CASE WHEN m.team1 = m.match_winner THEN m.team2 ELSE m.team1 END AS loser, COUNT(*) AS final_losses, GROUP_CONCAT(m.season, ', ') AS seasons FROM finals_cte f JOIN Matches m ON f.match_id = m.match_id WHERE m.match_winner IS NOT NULL GROUP BY loser HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2 ORDER BY final_losses DESC;
generated_sql:
SELECT loser AS loser,
       COUNT(*) AS final_losses,
       group_concat(DISTINCT season, ', ') AS seasons
FROM (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN match_winner = team1 THEN team2
      WHEN match_winner = team2 THEN team1
      ELSE NULL
    END AS loser,
    season
  FROM Matches
  WHERE lower(stage) = 'final'
    AND match_winner IS NOT NULL
    AND match_winner != ''
) sub
WHERE loser IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY loser
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1;
generated_answer: DISTINCT aggregates must have exactly one argument

question: T20 World Cup नॉकआउट में सबसे अधिक मैच कुल (दोनों टीमों का कुल) कौन से हैं?
gold_sql: WITH knockout_cte AS ( SELECT m.match_id FROM Matches m WHERE m.season IN ('2007','2009','2010','2012','2014','2016','2021/22','2022/23','2024','2025/26') AND m.team1 IN ('Afghanistan','Australia','Bangladesh','England','India','Ireland','New Zealand','Pakistan','South Africa','Sri Lanka','West Indies','Zimbabwe') AND m.team2 IN ('Afghanistan','Australia','Bangladesh','England','India','Ireland','New Zealand','Pakistan','South Africa','Sri Lanka','West Indies','Zimbabwe') AND m.stage IN ('Semi Final', 'Final') ) SELECT m.team1, m.team2, m.season, SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) AS total_runs FROM Deliveries d JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id JOIN knockout_cte kc ON m.match_id = kc.match_id GROUP BY m.match_id, m.team1, m.team2, m.season ORDER BY total_runs DESC LIMIT 10;
gold_answer: ["('India', 'England', '2025/26', 499)", "('India', 'New Zealand', '2025/26', 414)", "('Australia', 'Pakistan', '2010', 388)", "('Pakistan', 'Australia', '2021/22', 353)", "('New Zealand', 'Australia', '2021/22', 345)", "('India', 'South Africa', '2024', 345)", "('South Africa', 'New Zealand', '2025/26', 342)", "('Australia', 'India', '2022/23', 339)", "('India', 'England', '2022/23', 338)", "('England', 'New Zealand', '2021/22', 333)"]

WITH match_totals AS (
  SELECT match_id,
         SUM(runs_scored + extra_runs) AS total_runs
  FROM Deliveries
  GROUP BY match_id
),
filtered AS (
  SELECT M.match_id, M.team1, M.team2, M.season, mt.total_runs
  FROM Matches M
  JOIN match_totals mt ON M.match_id = mt.match_id
  WHERE LOWER(M.season) LIKE '%t20 world cup%'
    AND LOWER(M.stage) LIKE '%knockout%'
)
SELECT team1 AS team1, team2 AS team2, season AS season, total_runs AS total_runs
FROM filtered
WHERE total_runs = (SELECT MAX(total_runs) FROM filtered);

question: బహుళ T20 World Cup ఫైనల్స్ ఓడిపోయిన జట్లు ఏవి?
gold_sql: WITH finals_cte AS ( SELECT m.match_id, m.season FROM Matches m WHERE m.season IN ('2007','2009','2010','2012','2014','2016','2021/22','2022/23','2024','2025/26') AND m.team1 IN ('Afghanistan','Australia','Bangladesh','England','India','Ireland','New Zealand','Pakistan','South Africa','Sri Lanka','West Indies','Zimbabwe') AND m.team2 IN ('Afghanistan','Australia','Bangladesh','England','India','Ireland','New Zealand','Pakistan','South Africa','Sri Lanka','West Indies','Zimbabwe') AND m.stage = 'Final' ) SELECT CASE WHEN m.team1 = m.match_winner THEN m.team2 ELSE m.team1 END AS loser, COUNT(*) AS final_losses, GROUP_CONCAT(m.season, ', ') AS seasons FROM finals_cte f JOIN Matches m ON f.match_id = m.match_id WHERE m.match_winner IS NOT NULL GROUP BY loser HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2 ORDER BY final_losses DESC;

    END AS loser,

    AND lower(stage) IN ('final','finals','grand final')
) sub

GROUP BY loser
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1;

  UNION ALL
  SELECT season, team2 AS team FROM Matches WHERE season >= '2023'
),
multi_seasons AS (
  SELECT season FROM season_teams GROUP BY season HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT team) > 2
),
t20_matches AS (
  SELECT match_id FROM Deliveries GROUP BY match_id HAVING MAX(over_number) <= 20
),
target_matches AS (
  SELECT m.* FROM Matches m
  JOIN multi_seasons ms ON m.season = ms.season
  JOIN t20_matches t ON m.match_id = t.match_id
  WHERE m.team1 = 'India' OR m.team2 = 'India'
)
SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS total_matches,
  SUM(CASE WHEN match_winner = 'India' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wins,
  SUM(CASE WHEN match_winner IS NOT NULL AND match_winner != 'India' AND COALESCE(result_type, '') != 'no result' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS losses,
  SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(result_type, '') = 'no result' OR match_winner IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS no_results
FROM target_matches;

question: What are the T20 World Cup knockout trends since 2016?
gold_sql: WITH knockout_cte AS ( SELECT m.match_id FROM Matches m WHERE m.season IN ('2007','2009','2010','2012','2014','2016','2021/22','2022/23','2024','2025/26') AND m.team1 IN ('Afghanistan','Australia','Bangladesh','England','India','Ireland','New Zealand','Pakistan','South Africa','Sri Lanka','West Indies','Zimbabwe') AND m.team2 IN ('Afghanistan','Australia','Bangladesh','England','India','Ireland','New Zealand','Pakistan','South Africa','Sri Lanka','West Indies','Zimbabwe') AND m.stage IN ('Semi Final', 'Final') ), ko_matches AS ( SELECT m.match_id, m.match_winner, m.toss_winner, m.toss_decision, m.team1, m.team2 FROM Matches m JOIN knockout_cte kc ON m.match_id = kc.match_id WHERE m.match_winner IS NOT NULL AND m.season >= '2016' ), second_bat AS ( SELECT DISTINCT match_id, batting_team AS chasing_team FROM Deliveries WHERE inning = 2 ) SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_matches, SUM(CASE WHEN km.match_winner = sb.chasing_team THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS chasing_won, SUM(CASE WHEN km.match_winner != sb.chasing_team THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS batting_first_won FROM ko_matches km JOIN second_bat sb ON km.match_id = sb.match_id;

SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS total_matches,
  SUM(CASE WHEN m.match_winner = innings.second_team THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS chasing_won,
  SUM(CASE WHEN m.match_winner = innings.first_team THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS batting_first_won
FROM Matches m
JOIN (
  SELECT
    match_id,
    MAX(CASE WHEN inning = 1 THEN batting_team END) AS first_team,
    MAX(CASE WHEN inning = 2 THEN batting_team END) AS second_team
  FROM Deliveries
  WHERE wides = 0 AND noballs = 0
  GROUP BY match_id
) innings ON innings.match_id = m.match_id
WHERE CAST(m.season AS INTEGER) >= 2016
  AND m.stage IS NOT NULL
  AND (
    m.stage LIKE '%Final%' OR
    m.stage LIKE '%Semi%' OR
    m.stage LIKE '%Quarter%' OR
    m.stage LIKE '%Eliminator%' OR
    m.stage LIKE '%Qualifier%' OR
    m.stage LIKE '%Playoff%' OR
    m.stage LIKE '%Knockout%' OR
    m.stage LIKE '%Round%'
  )
  AND m.match_winner IS NOT NULL
  AND (m.result_type IS NULL OR lower(m.result_type) NOT LIKE '%no result%');

question: What are the highest boundary counts in a team innings in season 2026?
gold_sql: SELECT d.batting_team, COUNT(CASE WHEN d.runs_scored IN (4,6) AND d.wides = 0 THEN 1 END) AS total_boundaries, m.season, CASE WHEN m.team1 = d.batting_team THEN m.team2 ELSE m.team1 END AS opponent FROM Deliveries d JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id WHERE m.season = '2026' GROUP BY d.match_id, d.batting_team, m.season, opponent ORDER BY total_boundaries DESC LIMIT 10;
generated_sql:
SELECT p.batting_team AS batting_team, p.total_boundaries AS total_boundaries, p.season AS season, p.opponent AS opponent
FROM (
  SELECT d.match_id, d.inning, d.batting_team,
         m.season,
         CASE WHEN d.batting_team = m.team1 THEN m.team2 ELSE m.team1 END AS opponent,
         SUM(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 AND (d.runs_scored = 4 OR d.runs_scored = 6) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_boundaries
  FROM Deliveries d
  JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
  WHERE m.season = '2026'
  GROUP BY d.match_id, d.inning, d.batting_team
) p
WHERE p.total_boundaries = (
  SELECT MAX(total_boundaries) FROM (
    SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN d2.wides = 0 AND d2.noballs = 0 AND (d2.runs_scored = 4 OR d2.runs_scored = 6) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_boundaries
    FROM Deliveries d2
    JOIN Matches m2 ON d2.match_id = m2.match_id
    WHERE m2.season = '2026'
    GROUP BY d2.match_id, d2.inning, d2.batting_team
  )

question: Which players have scored 50+ in both the semifinal and final of a T20 World Cup edition?
gold_sql: WITH km AS ( SELECT m.match_id, m.season, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY m.season ORDER BY m.match_date DESC) AS rnk FROM Matches m WHERE m.season IN ('2007','2009','2010','2012','2014','2016','2021/22','2022/23','2024','2025/26') AND m.team1 IN ('Afghanistan','Australia','Bangladesh','England','India','Ireland','New Zealand','Pakistan','South Africa','Sri Lanka','West Indies','Zimbabwe') AND m.team2 IN ('Afghanistan','Australia','Bangladesh','England','India','Ireland','New Zealand','Pakistan','South Africa','Sri Lanka','West Indies','Zimbabwe') ), final_scores AS ( SELECT d.striker_id, km.season, SUM(d.runs_scored) AS runs FROM Deliveries d JOIN km ON d.match_id = km.match_id WHERE km.rnk = 1 GROUP BY d.match_id, d.inning, d.striker_id, km.season HAVING SUM(d.runs_scored) >= 50 ), semi_scores AS ( SELECT d.striker_id, km.season, SUM(d.runs_scored) AS runs FROM Deliveries d JOIN km ON d.match_id = km.match_id WHERE km.rnk IN (2,3) GROUP BY d.match_id, d.inning, d.striker_id, km.season HAVING SUM(d.runs_scored) >= 50 ) SELECT p.player_name, ss.season FROM semi_scores ss JOIN final_scores fs ON ss.striker_id = fs.striker_id AND ss.season = fs.season JOIN Players p ON ss.striker_id = p.player_id ORDER BY ss.season;

WITH player_runs AS (

)

generated_sql:
WITH per_player_match AS (
  SELECT
    d.match_id,
    d.striker_id AS player_id,
    m.season AS season,
    CASE
      WHEN upper(m.stage) LIKE '%SEMI%' THEN 'SEMI'
      WHEN upper(m.stage) LIKE '%FINAL%' AND upper(m.stage) NOT LIKE '%SEMI%' THEN 'FINAL'
      ELSE NULL
    END AS m_stage,
    SUM(d.runs_scored) AS runs
  FROM Deliveries d
  JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
  WHERE d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0
  GROUP BY d.match_id, d.striker_id
)

FROM (
  SELECT player_id, season,
         MAX(CASE WHEN m_stage = 'SEMI' THEN runs ELSE 0 END) AS semi_runs,
         MAX(CASE WHEN m_stage = 'FINAL' THEN runs ELSE 0 END) AS final_runs
  FROM per_player_match
  WHERE m_stage IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY player_id, season
  HAVING semi_runs > 50 AND final_runs > 50
) t
JOIN Players p ON p.player_id = t.player_id;

question: Who has the most consecutive 50+ scores in T20 World Cups?
gold_sql: WITH innings_scores AS ( SELECT d.striker_id, d.match_id, d.inning, m.match_date, SUM(d.runs_scored) AS runs FROM Deliveries d JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id WHERE m.season IN ('2007','2009','2010','2012','2014','2016','2021/22','2022/23','2024','2025/26') GROUP BY d.striker_id, d.match_id, d.inning, m.match_date ), numbered AS ( SELECT striker_id, match_id, inning, match_date, runs, CASE WHEN runs >= 50 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS fifty_plus, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY striker_id ORDER BY match_date, match_id, inning) AS rn FROM innings_scores ), grouped AS ( SELECT striker_id, fifty_plus, rn, rn - ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY striker_id, fifty_plus ORDER BY rn) AS grp FROM numbered ), streaks AS ( SELECT striker_id, grp, COUNT(*) AS streak_len FROM grouped WHERE fifty_plus = 1 GROUP BY striker_id, grp ) SELECT p.player_name, MAX(streak_len) AS max_consecutive_50_plus FROM streaks s JOIN Players p ON s.striker_id = p.player_id GROUP BY s.striker_id, p.player_name ORDER BY max_consecutive_50_plus DESC LIMIT 10;
gold_answer: ["('S Ravichandran', 4)", "('P Baron', 4)", "('BJ Bennett', 4)", "('HAM Shah', 3)", "('Asif Khan', 3)", "('Shahid Afridi', 3)", "('DS Airee', 3)", "('Sahibzada Farhan', 3)", "('SA Yadav', 3)", "('N Pooran', 3)"]

WITH innings AS (
  SELECT d.match_id,
         m.match_date,
         d.inning,
         d.striker_id AS player_id,
         SUM(d.runs_scored) AS runs
  FROM Deliveries d
  JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
  WHERE (m.stage LIKE '%World Cup%' OR m.season LIKE '%T20 World Cup%' OR m.season LIKE '%World Cup%')
  GROUP BY d.match_id, d.inning, d.striker_id
),
player_innings AS (
  SELECT *,
         CASE WHEN runs >= 50 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is50
  FROM innings
),
ordered AS (
  SELECT pi.*,
         SUM(CASE WHEN is50 = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (
           PARTITION BY player_id
           ORDER BY match_date, match_id, inning
           ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
         ) AS grp
  FROM player_innings pi
),
streaks AS (
  SELECT player_id,
         grp,
         COUNT(*) AS streak_len
  FROM ordered
  WHERE is50 = 1
  GROUP BY player_id, grp
),
player_max AS (
  SELECT player_id,
         MAX(streak_len) AS max_consecutive_50_plus
  FROM streaks
  GROUP BY player_id
),
global_max AS (
  SELECT MAX(max_consecutive_50_plus) AS gm FROM player_max
)
SELECT p.player_name AS player_name,

FROM player_max pm
JOIN Players p ON p.player_id = pm.player_id
WHERE pm.max_consecutive_50_plus = (SELECT gm FROM global_max)
ORDER BY p.player_name;

gold_sql: WITH innings_scores AS ( SELECT d.striker_id, d.match_id, d.inning, m.match_date, SUM(d.runs_scored) AS runs FROM Deliveries d JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id WHERE m.season IN ('2007','2009','2010','2012','2014','2016','2021/22','2022/23','2024','2025/26') GROUP BY d.striker_id, d.match_id, d.inning, m.match_date ), numbered AS ( SELECT striker_id, match_id, inning, match_date, runs, CASE WHEN runs >= 50 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS fifty_plus, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY striker_id ORDER BY match_date, match_id, inning) AS rn FROM innings_scores ), grouped AS ( SELECT striker_id, fifty_plus, rn, rn - ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY striker_id, fifty_plus ORDER BY rn) AS grp FROM numbered ), streaks AS ( SELECT striker_id, grp, COUNT(*) AS streak_len FROM grouped WHERE fifty_plus = 1 GROUP BY striker_id, grp ) SELECT p.player_name, MAX(streak_len) AS max_consecutive_50_plus FROM streaks s JOIN Players p ON s.striker_id = p.player_id GROUP BY s.striker_id, p.player_name ORDER BY max_consecutive_50_plus DESC LIMIT 10;

  SELECT
    d.match_id,
    d.striker_id AS player_id,
    m.match_date,

  JOIN Matches m ON m.match_id = d.match_id
  WHERE d.wides = 0
    AND d.noballs = 0
    AND m.season LIKE '%T20 World Cup%'
  GROUP BY d.match_id, d.striker_id

numbered AS (
  SELECT
    pi.player_id,
    pl.player_name,
    pi.match_date,
    pi.match_id,
    pi.runs,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY pi.player_id ORDER BY pi.match_date, pi.match_id) AS rn,
    SUM(CASE WHEN pi.runs >= 50 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) OVER (PARTITION BY pi.player_id ORDER BY pi.match_date, pi.match_id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS zeros_cum
  FROM per_innings pi
  JOIN Players pl ON pl.player_id = pi.player_id
),

  SELECT player_id, player_name, (rn - zeros_cum) AS grp
  FROM numbered
  WHERE runs >= 50

  FROM groups
  GROUP BY player_id, player_name, grp

gold_sql: WITH innings_scores AS ( SELECT d.striker_id, d.match_id, d.inning, m.match_date, SUM(d.runs_scored) AS runs FROM Deliveries d JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id WHERE m.season IN ('2007','2009','2010','2012','2014','2016','2021/22','2022/23','2024','2025/26') GROUP BY d.striker_id, d.match_id, d.inning, m.match_date ), numbered AS ( SELECT striker_id, match_id, inning, match_date, runs, CASE WHEN runs >= 50 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS fifty_plus, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY striker_id ORDER BY match_date, match_id, inning) AS rn FROM innings_scores ), grouped AS ( SELECT striker_id, fifty_plus, rn, rn - ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY striker_id, fifty_plus ORDER BY rn) AS grp FROM numbered ), streaks AS ( SELECT striker_id, grp, COUNT(*) AS streak_len FROM grouped WHERE fifty_plus = 1 GROUP BY striker_id, grp ) SELECT p.player_name, MAX(streak_len) AS max_consecutive_50_plus FROM streaks s JOIN Players p ON s.striker_id = p.player_id GROUP BY s.striker_id, p.player_name ORDER BY max_consecutive_50_plus DESC LIMIT 10;
gold_answer: ["('S Ravichandran', 4)", "('P Baron', 4)", "('BJ Bennett', 4)", "('HAM Shah', 3)", "('Asif Khan', 3)", "('Shahid Afridi', 3)", "('DS Airee', 3)", "('Sahibzada Farhan', 3)", "('SA Yadav', 3)", "('N Pooran', 3)"]

WITH player_innings AS (
  SELECT
    d.match_id,
    d.inning,
    p.player_id,
    p.player_name,
    m.match_date,
    SUM(d.runs_scored - d.extra_runs) AS batsman_runs
  FROM Deliveries d
  JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
  JOIN Players p ON p.player_id = d.striker_id
  WHERE m.season LIKE '%T20 World Cup%'
  GROUP BY d.match_id, d.inning, p.player_id, p.player_name, m.match_date
),
ordered AS (
  SELECT
    pi.*,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY player_id ORDER BY match_date, match_id, inning) AS rn,
    CASE WHEN batsman_runs >= 50 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is50
  FROM player_innings pi
),
success_rows AS (
  SELECT
    player_id,
    player_name,
    rn,
    rn - ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY player_id ORDER BY rn) AS grp
  FROM ordered
  WHERE is50 = 1
),
streaks AS (
  SELECT
    player_id,
    player_name,
    COUNT(*) AS streak_length
  FROM success_rows
  GROUP BY player_id, grp
),
player_max AS (
  SELECT
    o.player_id,
    o.player_name,
    COALESCE(MAX(s.streak_length), 0) AS max_consecutive_50_plus
  FROM (SELECT DISTINCT player_id, player_name FROM ordered) o
  LEFT JOIN streaks s ON o.player_id = s.player_id
  GROUP BY o.player_id, o.player_name
),
max_overall AS (
  SELECT MAX(max_consecutive_50_plus) AS m FROM player_max

SELECT player_name, max_consecutive_50_plus
FROM player_max
WHERE max_consecutive_50_plus = (SELECT m FROM max_overall)
ORDER BY player_name;

gold_answer: ["(19, 17, 3, 39, '2007/08 Johannesburg, 2009 Nottingham, 2008/09 Wellington, 2008/09 Christchurch, 2012 Chennai, 2015/16 Nagpur, 2017/18 Delhi, 2017/18 Rajkot, 2017/18 Thiruvananthapuram, 2018/19 Guyana, 2018/19 Wellington, 2018/19 Auckland, 2018/19 Hamilton, 2018/19 Wellington, 2018/19 Auckland, 2018/19 Hamilton, 2019/20 Melbourne, 2019/20 Auckland, 2019/20 Auckland, 2019/20 Hamilton, 2019/20 Wellington, 2019/20 Mount Maunganui, 2021/22 Dubai, 2021/22 Jaipur, 2021/22 Ranchi, 2021/22 Kolkata, 2021/22 Queenstown, 2022/23 Mount Maunganui, 2022/23 Napier, 2022/23 Ranchi, 2022/23 Lucknow, 2022/23 Ahmedabad, 2024/25 Dubai, 2025/26 Nagpur, 2025/26 Raipur, 2025/26 Guwahati, 2025/26 Visakhapatnam, 2025/26 Thiruvananthapuram, 2025/26 Ahmedabad')"]
generated_sql:
SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Matches m WHERE ((m.team1='India' AND m.team2='New Zealand') OR (m.team1='New Zealand' AND m.team2='India')) AND (LOWER(m.season) LIKE '%t20%' OR LOWER(m.season) LIKE '%twenty20%' OR LOWER(m.season) LIKE '%world t20%' OR LOWER(m.season) LIKE '%t20 world%' OR LOWER(m.stage) LIKE '%t20%' OR LOWER(m.stage) LIKE '%world t20%' OR LOWER(m.stage) LIKE '%t20 world%' OR LOWER(m.stage) LIKE '%t20 world cup%' OR LOWER(m.season) LIKE '%world cup%') AND LOWER(COALESCE(m.match_winner,''))='india') AS india_wins,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Matches m WHERE ((m.team1='India' AND m.team2='New Zealand') OR (m.team1='New Zealand' AND m.team2='India')) AND (LOWER(m.season) LIKE '%t20%' OR LOWER(m.season) LIKE '%twenty20%' OR LOWER(m.season) LIKE '%world t20%' OR LOWER(m.season) LIKE '%t20 world%' OR LOWER(m.stage) LIKE '%t20%' OR LOWER(m.stage) LIKE '%world t20%' OR LOWER(m.stage) LIKE '%t20 world%' OR LOWER(m.stage) LIKE '%t20 world cup%' OR LOWER(m.season) LIKE '%world cup%') AND LOWER(COALESCE(m.match_winner,''))='new zealand') AS nz_wins,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Matches m WHERE ((m.team1='India' AND m.team2='New Zealand') OR (m.team1='New Zealand' AND m.team2='India')) AND (LOWER(m.season) LIKE '%t20%' OR LOWER(m.season) LIKE '%twenty20%' OR LOWER(m.season) LIKE '%world t20%' OR LOWER(m.season) LIKE '%t20 world%' OR LOWER(m.stage) LIKE '%t20%' OR LOWER(m.stage) LIKE '%world t20%' OR LOWER(m.stage) LIKE '%t20 world%' OR LOWER(m.stage) LIKE '%t20 world cup%' OR LOWER(m.season) LIKE '%world cup%') AND (m.match_winner IS NULL OR LOWER(COALESCE(m.result_type,'')) IN ('no result','tie'))) AS no_result_tie,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Matches m WHERE ((m.team1='India' AND m.team2='New Zealand') OR (m.team1='New Zealand' AND m.team2='India')) AND (LOWER(m.season) LIKE '%t20%' OR LOWER(m.season) LIKE '%twenty20%' OR LOWER(m.season) LIKE '%world t20%' OR LOWER(m.season) LIKE '%t20 world%' OR LOWER(m.stage) LIKE '%t20%' OR LOWER(m.stage) LIKE '%world t20%' OR LOWER(m.stage) LIKE '%t20 world%' OR LOWER(m.stage) LIKE '%t20 world cup%' OR LOWER(m.season) LIKE '%world cup%')) AS total_matches,
  (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(detail, '; ') FROM (SELECT m.season || ' | ' || m.match_date || ' | ' || m.team1 || ' vs ' || m.team2 || ' | Winner: ' || COALESCE(m.match_winner,'No Result') || COALESCE(' (' || m.result_type || ')','') AS detail FROM Matches m WHERE ((m.team1='India' AND m.team2='New Zealand') OR (m.team1='New Zealand' AND m.team2='India')) AND (LOWER(m.season) LIKE '%t20%' OR LOWER(m.season) LIKE '%twenty20%' OR LOWER(m.season) LIKE '%world t20%' OR LOWER(m.season) LIKE '%t20 world%' OR LOWER(m.stage) LIKE '%t20%' OR LOWER(m.stage) LIKE '%world t20%' OR LOWER(m.stage) LIKE '%t20 world%' OR LOWER(m.stage) LIKE '%t20 world cup%' OR LOWER(m.season) LIKE '%world cup%') ORDER BY m.match_date)) AS matches_detail;

question: What is the chasing vs defending record in T20 World Cup finals?
gold_sql: WITH finals_cte AS ( SELECT m.match_id, m.season FROM Matches m WHERE m.season IN ('2007','2009','2010','2012','2014','2016','2021/22','2022/23','2024','2025/26') AND m.team1 IN ('Afghanistan','Australia','Bangladesh','England','India','Ireland','New Zealand','Pakistan','South Africa','Sri Lanka','West Indies','Zimbabwe') AND m.team2 IN ('Afghanistan','Australia','Bangladesh','England','India','Ireland','New Zealand','Pakistan','South Africa','Sri Lanka','West Indies','Zimbabwe') AND m.stage = 'Final' ), second_bat AS ( SELECT DISTINCT match_id, batting_team AS chasing_team FROM Deliveries WHERE inning = 2 ) SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN m.match_winner = sb.chasing_team THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS chasing_wins, SUM(CASE WHEN m.match_winner != sb.chasing_team THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS defending_wins, COUNT(*) AS total_finals FROM finals_cte f JOIN Matches m ON f.match_id = m.match_id JOIN second_bat sb ON f.match_id = sb.match_id WHERE m.match_winner IS NOT NULL;
generated_sql:
SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN match_winner = (CASE WHEN LOWER(toss_decision) = 'bat' THEN CASE WHEN toss_winner = team1 THEN team2 ELSE team1 END ELSE toss_winner END) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS chasing_wins,
  SUM(CASE WHEN match_winner = (CASE WHEN LOWER(toss_decision) = 'bat' THEN toss_winner ELSE CASE WHEN toss_winner = team1 THEN team2 ELSE team1 END END) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS defending_wins,
  COUNT(*) AS total_finals
FROM Matches
WHERE LOWER(COALESCE(stage,'')) = 'final' AND match_winner IS NOT NULL;

question: T20 World Cup फाइनल में चेजिंग बनाम बचाव का रिकॉर्ड क्या है?
gold_sql: WITH finals_cte AS ( SELECT m.match_id, m.season FROM Matches m WHERE m.season IN ('2007','2009','2010','2012','2014','2016','2021/22','2022/23','2024','2025/26') AND m.team1 IN ('Afghanistan','Australia','Bangladesh','England','India','Ireland','New Zealand','Pakistan','South Africa','Sri Lanka','West Indies','Zimbabwe') AND m.team2 IN ('Afghanistan','Australia','Bangladesh','England','India','Ireland','New Zealand','Pakistan','South Africa','Sri Lanka','West Indies','Zimbabwe') AND m.stage = 'Final' ), second_bat AS ( SELECT DISTINCT match_id, batting_team AS chasing_team FROM Deliveries WHERE inning = 2 ) SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN m.match_winner = sb.chasing_team THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS chasing_wins, SUM(CASE WHEN m.match_winner != sb.chasing_team THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS defending_wins, COUNT(*) AS total_finals FROM finals_cte f JOIN Matches m ON f.match_id = m.match_id JOIN second_bat sb ON f.match_id = sb.match_id WHERE m.match_winner IS NOT NULL;
generated_sql:
SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN m.match_winner IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM Deliveries d WHERE d.match_id = m.match_id AND d.inning = 2 AND d.batting_team = m.match_winner) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS chasing_wins,
  SUM(CASE WHEN m.match_winner IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM Deliveries d WHERE d.match_id = m.match_id AND d.inning = 1 AND d.batting_team = m.match_winner) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS defending_wins,
  SUM(CASE WHEN m.match_winner IS NOT NULL AND (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM Deliveries d WHERE d.match_id = m.match_id AND d.inning = 2 AND d.batting_team = m.match_winner) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM Deliveries d WHERE d.match_id = m.match_id AND d.inning = 1 AND d.batting_team = m.match_winner)) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_finals
FROM Matches m
WHERE m.season = 'T20 World Cup' AND lower(m.stage) = 'final';

question: T20 World Cup ਫਾਈਨਲ ਵਿੱਚ ਚੇਜ਼ਿੰਗ ਬਨਾਮ ਬਚਾਅ ਦਾ ਰਿਕਾਰਡ ਕੀ ਹੈ?
gold_sql: WITH finals_cte AS ( SELECT m.match_id, m.season FROM Matches m WHERE m.season IN ('2007','2009','2010','2012','2014','2016','2021/22','2022/23','2024','2025/26') AND m.team1 IN ('Afghanistan','Australia','Bangladesh','England','India','Ireland','New Zealand','Pakistan','South Africa','Sri Lanka','West Indies','Zimbabwe') AND m.team2 IN ('Afghanistan','Australia','Bangladesh','England','India','Ireland','New Zealand','Pakistan','South Africa','Sri Lanka','West Indies','Zimbabwe') AND m.stage = 'Final' ), second_bat AS ( SELECT DISTINCT match_id, batting_team AS chasing_team FROM Deliveries WHERE inning = 2 ) SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN m.match_winner = sb.chasing_team THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS chasing_wins, SUM(CASE WHEN m.match_winner != sb.chasing_team THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS defending_wins, COUNT(*) AS total_finals FROM finals_cte f JOIN Matches m ON f.match_id = m.match_id JOIN second_bat sb ON f.match_id = sb.match_id WHERE m.match_winner IS NOT NULL;
generated_sql:
SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN m.match_winner = d2.batting_team THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS chasing_wins,
  SUM(CASE WHEN m.match_winner <> d2.batting_team THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS defending_wins,
  COUNT(*) AS total_finals
FROM Matches m
JOIN (
  SELECT match_id, batting_team
  FROM Deliveries
  WHERE inning = 2
  GROUP BY match_id
) d2 ON d2.match_id = m.match_id
WHERE lower(m.season) LIKE '%t20 world cup%'
  AND lower(m.stage) LIKE '%final%'
  AND m.match_winner IS NOT NULL;

question: T20 World Cup ఫైనల్స్‌లో చేజింగ్ vs డిఫెండింగ్ రికార్డు ఏమిటి?
gold_sql: WITH finals_cte AS ( SELECT m.match_id, m.season FROM Matches m WHERE m.season IN ('2007','2009','2010','2012','2014','2016','2021/22','2022/23','2024','2025/26') AND m.team1 IN ('Afghanistan','Australia','Bangladesh','England','India','Ireland','New Zealand','Pakistan','South Africa','Sri Lanka','West Indies','Zimbabwe') AND m.team2 IN ('Afghanistan','Australia','Bangladesh','England','India','Ireland','New Zealand','Pakistan','South Africa','Sri Lanka','West Indies','Zimbabwe') AND m.stage = 'Final' ), second_bat AS ( SELECT DISTINCT match_id, batting_team AS chasing_team FROM Deliveries WHERE inning = 2 ) SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN m.match_winner = sb.chasing_team THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS chasing_wins, SUM(CASE WHEN m.match_winner != sb.chasing_team THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS defending_wins, COUNT(*) AS total_finals FROM finals_cte f JOIN Matches m ON f.match_id = m.match_id JOIN second_bat sb ON f.match_id = sb.match_id WHERE m.match_winner IS NOT NULL;
generated_sql:
SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN m.match_winner IS NOT NULL AND m.match_winner <> (SELECT d.batting_team FROM Deliveries d WHERE d.match_id = m.match_id AND d.inning = 1 LIMIT 1) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS chasing_wins,
  SUM(CASE WHEN m.match_winner IS NOT NULL AND m.match_winner = (SELECT d.batting_team FROM Deliveries d WHERE d.match_id = m.match_id AND d.inning = 1 LIMIT 1) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS defending_wins,
  SUM(CASE WHEN m.match_winner IS NOT NULL AND (SELECT d.batting_team FROM Deliveries d WHERE d.match_id = m.match_id AND d.inning = 1 LIMIT 1) IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_finals
FROM Matches m
WHERE LOWER(m.stage) = 'final' OR LOWER(m.stage) LIKE '%final%';
